description.en:
•Camphoplex Massage Gel is a topical gel designed to provide targeted relief for joint and muscle discomfort. Formulated with a combination of active ingredients and easily absorbed formula, making it convenient for application and effective treatment.Additionally, it contains a piece used for massage to increase effectiveness and further relieve pain.

description.en:
• Acyclovir 5% 10gm Skin Cream is used for the treatment of skin symptoms caused by the herpes virus. 
• Active ingredient: Acyclovir. 
• Indication: Relief of conditions such as cold sores on the lips and face, and genital herpes lesions. It can speed up healing of the sores and decrease symptoms (such as tingling, pain, burning, itching). 
• Dose: Apply 5 times a day for 4 days. Therapy should be initiated as early as possible following the onset of signs or symptoms of herpes.
description.ar:
• كريم أسيكلوفير 5% 10 جم يستخدم لعلاج أعراض الجلد الناجمة عن فيروس الهربس. 
• المادة الفعالة : أسيكلوفير. 
• الأستخدام : لتخفيف الحالات مثل القروح الباردة على الشفاه والوجه، والقروح الناتجة عن الهربس التناسلي. يمكن أن يسرع شفاء القروح ويقلل الأعراض (مثل الوخز، الألم، الحرق، الحكة).

• Dose: Apply a thin layer to the affected area of the scalp once daily or as prescribed by the physician.

name.en: See Lit  Anti Wrinkle Eye Contour Serum 30ml
name.ar: سي ليت سيروم مضاد للتجاعيد لمحيط العين 30 مل

description.en:
The ultimate solution for tackling dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines around the eyes. This serum rejuvenates and refreshes the delicate eye area, promoting a youthful, vibrant look.
Apply a small amount of serum to your fingertips. Gently massage the serum around the eye area in a circular motion until fully absorbed. Use in morning and night for best results.

Key Features:

- Caffeine and green tea extract brighten the under-eye area, improving skin tone and reducing puffiness and dark circles.
- Anti-Aging serum that targets fine lines and wrinkles, leaving the eye contour looking youthful and smooth.
- Hyaluronic acid and Vitamin C deeply hydrate and improve skin elasticity for a refreshed appearance.
- Paraben-free and suitable for all skin types.
- Size: 30 ml
description.ar:
سي ليت سيروم مضاد للتجاعيد لمحيط العين هو الحل النهائي للتعامل مع الهالات السوداء، الانتفاخات، والخطوط الدقيقة حول العينين. يعمل على تجديد وتنشيط منطقة العين الحساسة، مما يعزز مظهرًا شابًا ومشرقًا.

ضعي كمية صغيرة من السيروم على أطراف الأصابع. يتم تدليك السيروم برفق حول منطقة العين بحركات دائرية حتى يتم امتصاصه بالكامل  يُفضل استخدامه صباحًا ومساءً للحصول على أفضل النتائج.

مواصفات المنتج:

- مستخلص من الكافيين والشاي الأخضر يضيء منطقة تحت العين ويحسن لون البشرة مع تقليل الانتفاخ والهالات السوداء.
- سيروم مضاد للتقدم في العمر يستهدف الخطوط الدقيقة والتجاعيد، مما يجعل محيط العين يبدو شابًا وناعمًا.
- حمض الهيالورونيك وفيتامين C يرطبان البشرة بعمق ويحسنان مرونتها للحصول على مظهر منعش.
- خالي من البارابين ومناسب لجميع أنواع البشرة.
- الحجم: 30 مل

description.en:
• Isoromyderm Gel is a combination treatment containing Erythromycin and Isotretinoin. It is used for the treatment of moderate to severe acne. Erythromycin is a topical antibiotic that helps reduce acne-causing bacteria, while Isotretinoin reduces oil production and helps prevent clogged pores.
• Active ingredients:

Erythromycin 2%
Isotretinoin 0.05%
• Indication: Used to treat moderate to severe forms of acne by reducing inflammation, bacteria, and excess oil production. It helps reduce the appearance of acne lesions and prevents new ones from forming.
• Dose: Apply a thin layer to the affected area once or twice daily, or as prescribed by the physician. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes.

• المواد الفعالة:

• الاستخدام: يستخدم لعلاج حالات حب الشباب المتوسطة إلى الشديدة عن طريق تقليل الالتهابات والبكتيريا وإنتاج الدهون الزائدة. يساعد في تقليل اثار حب الشباب ومنع ظهورها من جديد.
• الجرعة: يوضع طبقة رقيقة على المنطقة المصابة مرة أو مرتين يوميًا، أو حسب توجيهات الطبيب. تجنب ملامسة العينين والأغشية المخاطية.

description.en:
• Meloquin 4% 20gm Cream is a topical medication used for the treatment of hyperpigmentation, 
• Active ingredient: Hydroquinone 4%
• Indication: It is used to lighten the dark patches of skin (also called hyperpigmentation, melasma, “liver spots,” “age spots,” freckles) caused by pregnancy, birth control pills, hormone medicine, or injury to the skin. 
• Dose: Apply Meloquin to the affected areas of skin, usually twice daily or as directed by your doctor.
description.ar:
• الوصف: ميلوكوين 4٪ 20 جرام كريم هو دواء موضعي يستخدم لعلاج زيادة التصبغ.
• المادة الفعالة: هيدروكينون 4٪
• دواعي الاستخدام: يُستخدم لتفتيح البقع الداكنة في الجلد (المعروفة أيضًا باسم زيادة التصبغ، الكلف، "بقع الكبد"، "بقع الشيخوخة"، النمش) الناتجة عن الحمل، أو حبوب منع الحمل، أو الأدوية الهرمونية، أو إصابة الجلد.
• الجرعة: يُستخدم ميلوكوين على المناطق المصابة من الجلد، عادةً مرتين يوميًا أو حسب توجيهات الطبيب.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ondansetron Cancer chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting:
IV: Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of emetogenic cancer chemotherapy (including high-dose cisplatin)
Oral:
Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with highly emetogenic cancer chemotherapy (including cisplatin ≥50 mg/m2).
Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of moderately emetogenic cancer chemotherapy.
Radiotherapy-associated nausea and vomiting: Oral: Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with radiotherapy in patients receiving either total body irradiation, single high-dose fraction to the abdomen, or daily fractions to the abdomen.
Postoperative nausea and/or vomiting: IV and Oral: Prevention of postoperative nausea and/or vomiting (PONV). If nausea/vomiting occur in a patient who had not received prophylactic ondansetron, IV ondansetron may be administered to prevent further episodes.
Limitations of use: Routine prophylaxis for PONV in patients with minimal expectation of nausea and/or vomiting is not recommended, although use is recommended in patients when nausea and vomiting must be avoided in the postoperative period, even if the incidence of PONV is low.
description.ar: الماده الفعاله: اوندانسيترون

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ceftazidime Bacterial septicemia: Treatment of septicemia caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Klebsiella spp., Haemophilus influenzae, Escherichia coli, Serratia spp., Streptococcus pneumoniae, and Staphylococcus aureus (methicillin-susceptible strains).
Bone and joint infections: Treatment of bone and joint infections caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Klebsiella spp., Enterobacter spp., and Staphylococcus aureus (methicillin-susceptible strains).
CNS infections: Treatment of meningitis caused by Haemophilus influenzae and Neisseria meningitidis. Ceftazidime has also been used successfully in cases of meningitis due to Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Streptococcus pneumoniae.
Empiric therapy in the immunocompromised patient: Empiric treatment of infections in immunocompromised patients.
Gynecologic infections: Treatment of endometritis, pelvic cellulitis, and other infections of the female genital tract caused by Escherichia coli.
Intra-abdominal infections: Treatment of peritonitis caused by Escherichia coli, Klebsiella spp., and Staphylococcus aureus (methicillin-susceptible strains) and polymicrobial intra-abdominal infections caused by aerobic and anaerobic organisms and some Bacteroides spp. (many strains of Bacteroides fragilis are resistant).
Lower respiratory tract infections: Treatment of lower respiratory tract infections, including pneumonia, caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa and other Pseudomonas spp.; Haemophilus influenzae, including ampicillin-resistant strains; Klebsiella spp.; Enterobacter spp.; Proteus mirabilis; Escherichia coli; Serratia spp.; Citrobacter spp.; Streptococcus pneumoniae; and Staphylococcus aureus (methicillin-susceptible strains).
Skin and skin-structure infections: Treatment of skin and skin-structure infections caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa; Klebsiella spp.; Escherichia coli; Proteus spp.; including Proteus mirabilis and indole-positive Proteus; Enterobacter spp.; Serratia spp.; Staphylococcus aureus (methicillin-susceptible strains); and Streptococcus pyogenes (group A beta-hemolytic streptococci).
Urinary tract infections (UTI): Treatment of complicated and uncomplicated UTIs caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa; Enterobacter spp.; Proteus spp., including Proteus mirabilisand indole-positive Proteus; Klebsiella spp.; and Escherichia coli.
description.ar: الماده الفعاله: سيفتازيديم

description.en:
SPASMOFREE 5MG/2ML 3 AMPOULES is an antispasmodic medication used for the symptomatic treatment of acute pain related to functional disorders of the digestive tract, biliary system, urinary tract, and gynecology. It is also indicated for renal colic and spasmodic dysmenorrhea.

How to use and dosage:
•Adults: The usual dosage is one ampoule administered intramuscularly (IM) or intravenously (IV) as directed by a physician.

Warnings and precautions:
•Use with caution in patients with hypersensitivity to Tiemonium or any of the components.
•Consult a physician if symptoms persist or worsen.
•Keep out of reach of children.

Active ingredient: Tiemonium Methylsulfate.
description.ar:
سبازموفري 5 مجم/2 مل أمبولات مضادة للتقلصات يُستخدم لعلاج الألم الحاد الناتج عن اضطرابات وظيفية في الجهاز الهضمي، الجهاز البولي، وأمراض النساء. كما يُستخدم في حالات المغص الكلوي وتقلصات الدورة الشهرية المؤلمة.

• يُستخدم بحذر في المرضى الذين لديهم تحسس تجاه التيمونيوم أو أي من مكونات الدواء.
• استشر الطبيب إذا استمرت الأعراض أو ساءت.
• يُحفظ بعيدًا عن متناول الأطفال.

المادة الفعالة:

description.en:
VEE FOUND Anti-Aging Lotion is an advanced formula combines the power of high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid for a skin booster-like effect without the needles. Enriched with Squalene, Glycine, Proline, and other key ingredients, it stimulates collagen production, enhances skin elasticity, and provides deep hydration, leaving you with a smoother, firmer, and more radiant complexion.
Apply it n to the affected areas of your skin.  Gently massage into the skin until fully absorbed. 

Key Features:

- High molecular weight hyaluronic acid helps to tighten and firm the skin.
- Glycine and Proline stimulate collagen production for enhanced skin elasticity.
- Arginine helps to boost blood circulation, promoting a healthy, glowing complexion.
- Size: 30 ml
description.ar:
في فوند لوشن مكافح للشيخوخة هو تركيبة متطورة تجمع بين قوة حمض الهيالورونيك لما له من تأثير يشبه تأثير مركّبات تحفيز الكولاجين وتجديد الخلايا، دون الحاجة إلى إجراءات تجميلية بالحقن. غني بالسكوالين، الجليسين، البرولين، ويعزز إنتاج الكولاجين، ويزيد من مرونة الجلد، ويوفر ترطيبًا عميقًا، مما يترك بشرتك أكثر نعومة وثباتًا وإشراقًا.
ضعه على المناطق المرادة من بشرتك. دلك بلطف حتى يتم امتصاصه بالكامل

description.en:
NORMO TEARS 15ML EYE DROP is a sterile and lubricating eye solution used as an artificial substitute for tears. It provides relief from symptoms such as dryness, irritation, and burning caused by decreased tear production or environmental factors.

How to Use and Dosage:
•Instill 1 or 2 drops in the affected eye(s) as needed or as directed by a physician.
•Wash hands before use and avoid touching the dropper tip to any surface to prevent contamination.
•Close the eye and apply gentle pressure to the inside corner for 1-2 minutes after application.

Warnings and Precautions:
•Do not use if allergic to any of the ingredients.
•Avoid use with contact lenses; wait at least 15 minutes after application before reinserting lenses.
•Discontinue use and consult a physician if irritation, pain, or changes in vision occur.
•Store below 25°C and discard if the solution becomes cloudy or changes color.

Active Ingredients: Dextran 70 - Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose
description.ar:
نورمو تيرز 15 مل – قطرات عين محلول معقم ومرطّب للعين يُستخدم كبديل صناعي للدموع يساعد في تخفيف أعراض مثل جفاف العين، التهيج، والحرقان الناتجة عن قلة إفراز الدموع أو العوامل البيئية.

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعة:
•ضع 1 إلى 2 نقطة في العين/العيون المصابة حسب الحاجة أو حسب تعليمات الطبيب.
•يجب غسل اليدين جيدًا قبل الاستخدام، وتجنب ملامسة طرف القطارة لأي سطح لتفادي التلوث.
•بعد الاستخدام، أغلق العين واضغط بلطف على الزاوية الداخلية للعين لمدة 1–2 دقيقة.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
•لا تستخدم القطرات إذا كنت تعاني من حساسية تجاه أي من المكونات.
•تُجنب استخدامها مع العدسات اللاصقة، ويُنصح بالانتظار 15 دقيقة على الأقل بعد الاستخدام قبل إعادة وضع العدسات.
•توقف عن الاستخدام واستشر الطبيب إذا شعرت بألم، تهيج، أو تغير في الرؤية.
•يُخزن تحت درجة حرارة أقل من 25 درجة مئوية، ويُتخلص منه إذا أصبح المحلول عكرًا أو تغير لونه.

description.en:
OCTOVENT PLUS 100ML SYRUP is a bronchodilator and expectorant used for th symptomatic relief of acute productive cough. It helps relieve bronchospasm and supports easier breathing by loosening mucus and clearing airways.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults: 5 ml - 10 ml three times daily. 
• Children 6-12 years: 5 ml three times daily.
• Treatment duration should not exceed 5 days without doctor advice.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Not suitable for children under 6 years.
• Avoid use if cough is accompanied by excessive secretions unless directed by a physician.
• Potential side effects include tremor, headache, tachycardia, and gastrointestinal symptoms.
• Contains guaifenesin, which is excreted in breast milk—consult doctor if breastfeeding.
• Consult a doctor if symptoms worsen or persist beyond 5 days.

Active Ingredients: Salbutamol sulphate - Guaifenesin
description.ar:
أوكتوفنت بلس شراب 100 مل موسّع للشعب الهوائية وطارد للبلغم يُستخدم للتخفيف من السعال المصحوب ببلغم في الحالات الحادة. يساعد في تخفيف التشنجات القصبة الهوائية ويسهّل عملية التنفس من خلال اذابه المخاط.

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعة:
• البالغين: 5 – 10 مل ثلاث مرات يوميًا.
• الأطفال من 6 إلى 12 سنة: 5 مل ثلاث مرات يوميًا.
• لا تتجاوز مدة العلاج 5 أيام دون استشارة الطبيب.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• غير مناسب للأطفال أقل من 6 سنوات.
• يُتجنّب استخدامه إذا كان السعال مصحوبًا بإفرازات مفرطة إلا تحت إشراف الطبيب.
• قد يسبب آثارًا جانبية مثل: رجفة، صداع، تسارع ضربات القلب، وأعراض بالجهاز الهضمي.
• يحتوي على جوافينيزين الذي يُفرز في لبن الأم؛ لذا يجب استشارة الطبيب في حالة الرضاعة الطبيعية.
• استشر الطبيب إذا ساءت الأعراض أو استمرت أكثر من 5 أيام.

المواد الفعّالة:
• سالبوتامول سلفات 
• جوافينيزين

description.en:
DERMO CALM LOTION 120ML is a soothing topical lotion used to relieve simple skin irritations such as sweat rash, sunburn, minor burns, cuts, and insect bites. It helps calm itching, reduce redness, and protect the skin by forming a gentle barrier.

Dosage and How to Use:
• Shake well before use.
• Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin twice daily or as directed by your physician.
• Gently rub until evenly spread; allow to absorb.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For external use only—avoid contact with eyes, mouth, and mucous membranes.
• Do not apply to deep or infected wounds.
• Discontinue if severe irritation or allergic reaction occurs.

Active Ingredients:
• Zinc Oxide,Menthol,Camphor,Glycerol.
description.ar:

الجرعة وطريقة الاستخدام:
• رج العبوة جيدًا قبل الاستخدام.
• ضع طبقة رقيقة على بشرة نظيفة وجافة مرتين يوميًا أو حسب توصية الطبيب.
• دلّك بلطف حتى ثم اتركه حتي يمتصه الجلد.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• للاستخدام الخارجي فقط—تجنب ملامسة العينين والفم والأغشية المخاطية.
• لا يُطبق على الجروح العميقة أو المصابة بالعدوى.
• أوقف الاستخدام إذا حدث تهيج شديد أو رد فعل تحسسي.

المواد الفعالة:
•  أكسيد الزنك, المنثول, الكافور والجلسرين.

25 mg/kg/day in mild to moderate infections

description.en:
MUCOSOL INFANT SYRUP is a pediatric mucolytic containing carbocisteine, formulated to thin and liquefy bronchial secretions, facilitating productive cough relief. It aids in clearing chest congestion and improving respiratory comfort in conditions such as bronchitis, bronchiolitis, and other lower respiratory tract infections.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Children 2–6 years: 2–4 ml every 6 hours.
• Children 6–12 years: 8 ml every 8 hours.
• Shake well before use and the treatment duration should not exceed 8–10 days without medical advice.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Not to be used in children under 2 years without medical supervision.
• Avoid concomitant use with other carbocisteine-containing products.

Active Ingredient: Carbocisteine: 125 mg per 5 ml.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Clarithromycin Bronchitis, acute bacterial exacerbation: Treatment of acute bacterial exacerbation of chronic bronchitis in adults due to susceptible Haemophilus influenzae, H. parainfluenzae, Moraxella catarrhalis, or Streptococcus pneumoniae.
Helicobacter pylori eradication: Eradication of Helicobacter pylori to reduce the risk of duodenal ulcer recurrence as a component of combination therapy (triple therapy) in adults with H. pylori infection and duodenal ulcer disease (active or 5 year history of duodenal ulcer).
Limitations of use: Regimens that contain clarithromycin as the single antibacterial agent are more likely to be associated with the development of clarithromycin resistance. Clarithromycin-containing regimens should not be used in patients with known or suspected clarithromycin-resistant isolates (efficacy is reduced).
Mycobacterial infections, disseminated: Prophylaxis and treatment of disseminated mycobacterial infections due to Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) in patients with advanced HIV infection.
Otitis media: Treatment of acute otitis media in pediatric patients due to susceptible H. influenzae, M. catarrhalis, or S. pneumoniae.
Pharyngitis/tonsillitis: Treatment of pharyngitis/tonsillitis due to susceptible Streptococcus pyogenes (alternative agent).
Pneumonia, community-acquired: Treatment of community-acquired pneumonia due to susceptible Mycoplasma pneumoniae, S. pneumoniae, or Chlamydophila pneumoniae (adult and pediatric patients) and H. influenzae, H. parainfluenzae, or M. catarrhalis (adults).
Sinusitis: Treatment of acute maxillary sinusitis due to susceptible H. influenzae, S. pneumoniae, or M. catarrhalis.
Skin/skin structure infections: Treatment of uncomplicated skin/skin structure infection due to susceptible Staphylococcus aureus or S. pyogenes.

description.en:
XILONE FORTE SYRUP is a corticosteroid oral syrup used in the treatment of various inflammatory and autoimmune conditions. It is commonly prescribed to manage allergic disorders, skin diseases, asthma, and rheumatic problems by reducing inflammation and suppressing immune responses.

How to use:
• Take exactly as prescribed by the doctor.
• Usually taken in the morning after food.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not exceed the prescribed dose.
• Use with caution in chronic conditions like diabetes, hypertension, or glaucoma.
• Long-term use requires regular follow-up.
• Do not stop treatment suddenly without medical advice.

Active Ingredient:
• Prednisolone: 15 mg per 5 ml.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Children (1-3 years): 5 ml syrup daily.
• Children (3-6 years): 10 ml syrup daily.
• Children (6-12 years): 15 ml syrup daily.
• Adults and adolescents (≥12 years): 20 ml syrup daily.

• Keep out of reach of children.
• Use only as directed. Do not exceed the recommended dose.
• Consult a healthcare professional before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

MOBITIL 15MG 6 SUPPOSITORIES is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to treat pain and inflammation caused by arthritis.

How to use and dosage:
•Adults: Take one suppository (15mg) once daily.
•Do not exceed the prescribed dose, and follow your physician's instructions.
•If the suppository is too soft for insertion, chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes or run cold water over it before use .

Warnings and precautions:
•Avoid use if allergic to Meloxicam or other NSAIDs.
•Consult your physician if you have a history of stomach ulcers, kidney or liver disease, or heart conditions.
•Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless prescribed by a doctor.

Active ingredient: Meloxicam.

description.en:
FELDENE injection ampoule is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) for deep intramuscular use, indicated to relieve acute and chronic pain and inflammation in musculoskeletal disorders, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, bursitis, and tendonitis. Also indicated for management of moderate to severe postoperative pain, improving patient comfort and mobility.

How to use & Dosage:
• Adults and elderly (≥18 years): Administer 20 mg (1 ml) deep intramuscularly once daily; do not exceed one ampoule per day.
• Not recommended for children and adolescents under 18 years.

Warnings & Precautions:
• Contraindicated in known hypersensitivity to piroxicam or other NSAIDs, active peptic ulcer disease, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe heart failure, or significant hepatic or renal impairment.
• Use with caution in patients with hypertension, fluid retention, or coagulation disorders; monitor renal and liver function periodically.
• Avoid use in the third trimester of pregnancy due to risk of premature ductus arteriosus closure.
• Concurrent use with anticoagulants, corticosteroids, or other NSAIDs increases risk of serious bleeding.

Active Ingredient:
• Piroxicam: equivalent to 20 mg per 1 ml ampoule

description.en:
GYNO DAKTARIN 40GM VAGINAL CREAM is an antifungal medication used for the treatment of vaginal yeast infections (vaginal candidiasis) and other fungal infections of the vulva and vagina. 

How to use and dosage:
•Administer the contents of one applicator (approximately 5g of cream) deeply into the vagina once daily before bedtime for 7 consecutive days.
•For external vulvitis, apply the cream topically twice daily.

Warnings and precautions:
•For vaginal use only. Avoid contact with eyes, mouth, or other mucous membranes.
•Consult a physician before use if pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other medications.
•Do not use tampons, douches, or spermicides during treatment.
•Keep out of reach of children.

Active ingredient: Miconazole.

description.en:
FELDENE 20mg/1ml ampoles is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) for deep intramuscular use, indicated to relieve acute and chronic pain and inflammation in musculoskeletal disorders, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, bursitis, and tendonitis. Also indicated for management of moderate to severe postoperative pain, improving patient comfort and mobility.

How to use & Dosage:
• Adults and elderly (≥18 years): Administer 20 mg (1 ml) deep intramuscularly once daily; do not exceed one ampoule per day.
• Not recommended for children and adolescents under 18 years.

Warnings & Precautions:
• Contraindicated in known hypersensitivity to piroxicam or other NSAIDs, active peptic ulcer disease, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe heart failure, or significant hepatic or renal impairment.
• Use with caution in patients with hypertension, fluid retention, or coagulation disorders; monitor renal and liver function periodically.
• Avoid use in the third trimester of pregnancy due to risk of premature ductus arteriosus closure.
• Concurrent use with anticoagulants, corticosteroids, or other NSAIDs increases risk of serious bleeding.

Active Ingredient:
• Piroxicam: equivalent to 20 mg per 1 ml ampoule

• لا يستخدم مع الأدوية المضادة لتجلط الدم والكورتيكوستيرويدات أو الأدوية المضادات للاتهاب الأخرى.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Ceftriaxone 1gm

●Intramuscular

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Third Generation Cephalosporin Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose
For Adults:
1-Moderate And Severe Infections:
-1gm Or 2gm Every 24 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
-500mg Or 1g Every 12 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
2-Uncomplicated Gonorrhea:
250mg As A Single Dose Intramuscular.
*There Is Limited Experience With Daily Doses Of 3-4gm Administered As A Single Dose Or Two Equally Divided Doses.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4gm.
For Infants And Children (One Month To 12 Years Of Age):
1-Serious Miscellaneous Infections: 25 Or 37.5 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 2 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.
2-Meningitis: 50 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.

●Special Notes
-Hypersensitivity Test Must Be Made.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Dose To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Reconstitution Tips
-For Intramuscular Use: Solutions Should Be Reconstituted Immediately Before Use. If Storage Is Required, These Solutions May Be Stored Under Refrigeration(Between 2 And 8°C) And Should Be Used Within 48 Hours.
-For Intravenous Bolus Injection (Without Further Dilution): Reconstituted Solutions Should Be Administered Within 24 Hours When Stored At Room Temperature And Within 72 Hours When Refrigerated (Between 2 And 8°C).

Broad Spectrum Third Generation Cephalosporin Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose
For Adults:
1-Moderate And Severe Infections:
-1gm Or 2gm Every 24 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
-500mg Or 1g Every 12 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
2-Uncomplicated Gonorrhea:
250mg As A Single Dose Intramuscular.
*There Is Limited Experience With Daily Doses Of 3-4gm Administered As A Single Dose Or Two Equally Divided Doses.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4gm.
For Infants And Children (One Month To 12 Years Of Age):
1-Serious Miscellaneous Infections: 25 Or 37.5 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 2 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.
2-Meningitis: 50 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.

●Special Notes
-Hypersensitivity Test Must Be Made.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Dose To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Reconstitution Tips
-For Intramuscular Use: Solutions Should Be Reconstituted Immediately Before Use. If Storage Is Required, These Solutions May Be Stored Under Refrigeration(Between 2 And 8°C) And Should Be Used Within 48 Hours.
-For Intravenous Bolus Injection (Without Further Dilution): Reconstituted Solutions Should Be Administered Within 24 Hours When Stored At Room Temperature And Within 72 Hours When Refrigerated (Between 2 And 8°C).

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ceftriaxone 
Acute bacterial otitis media: Caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae (including beta-lactamase-producing strains), or Moraxella catarrhalis (including beta-lactamase-producing strains).
Bacterial septicemia: Caused by Staphylococcus aureus, S. pneumoniae, Escherichia coli, H. influenzae, or Klebsiella pneumoniae.
Bone and joint infections: Caused by S. aureus, S. pneumoniae, E. coli, Proteus mirabilis, K. pneumoniae, or Enterobacter spp.
Intra-abdominal infections: Caused by E. coli, K. pneumoniae, Bacteroides fragilis, Clostridium spp., or Peptostreptococcus spp.
Lower respiratory tract infections: Caused by S. pneumoniae, S. aureus, H. influenzae, Haemophilus parainfluenzae, K. pneumoniae, E. coli, Enterobacter aerogenes, P. mirabilis, or Serratia marcescens.
Meningitis: Caused by H. influenzae, Neisseria meningitidis, or S. pneumoniae. Ceftriaxone has also been used successfully in a limited number of cases of meningitis and shunt infection caused by Staphylococcus epidermidis and E. coli (efficacy for these 2 organisms in this organ system was studied in fewer than 10 infections).
Pelvic inflammatory disease: Caused by N. gonorrhoeae. Ceftriaxone, like other cephalosporins, has no activity against Chlamydia trachomatis. Therefore, when cephalosporins are used in the treatment of patients with pelvic inflammatory disease and C. trachomatis is one of the suspected pathogens, appropriate antichlamydial coverage should be added.
Skin and skin structure infections: Caused by S. aureus, S. epidermidis, Streptococcus pyogenes, viridans group streptococci, E. coli, Enterobacter cloacae, Klebsiella oxytoca, K. pneumoniae, P. mirabilis, Morganella morganii (efficacy for this organism in this organ system was studied in fewer than 10 infections), Pseudomonas aeruginosa, S. marcescens, Acinetobacter calcoaceticus, or B. fragilis (efficacy for this organism in this organ system was studied in fewer than 10 infections), or Peptostreptococcus spp.
Surgical prophylaxis: Reduce the incidence of postoperative infections in patients undergoing surgical procedures classified as contaminated or potentially contaminated (eg, vaginal or abdominal hysterectomy or cholecystectomy for chronic calculous cholecystitis in high-risk patients, such as those older than 70 years, with acute cholecystitis not requiring therapeutic antimicrobials, obstructive jaundice, or common duct bile stones) and in surgical patients for whom infection at the operative site would present serious risk (eg, during coronary artery bypass surgery).
Uncomplicated gonorrhea (cervical/urethral and rectal): Caused by N. gonorrhoeae, including both penicillinase- and nonpenicillinase-producing strains, and pharyngeal gonorrhea caused by nonpenicillinase-producing strains of N. gonorrhoeae.
Urinary tract infections (complicated and uncomplicated): Caused by E. coli, P. mirabilis, Proteus vulgaris, M. morganii, or K. pneumoniae.

description.en:
CANDICURE CREAM is used for the treatment of superficial fungal skin infections. It supports antifungal skin therapy by reducing infection symptoms in affected areas, including the hands, feet, trunk, or folds.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults and children over 2 years: Apply a thin layer to the affected area twice daily (morning and evening).
• Duration of treatment ranges from 2 to 4 weeks depending on severity and location.
• Always clean and dry the area before application.
• Do not use around the eyes or mucous membranes.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For external use only.
• Avoid contact with eyes.
• Use with caution in cases of known hypersensitivity to imidazoles.
• Do not use during pregnancy unless clearly needed.

Active Ingredient:
• Isoconazole nitrate 10 mg per 1 g cream

كانديكيور كريم يُستخدم لعلاج العدوى الفطرية السطحية في الجلد. يُساعد في القضاء على الفطريات الجلدية مثل التينيا، الكانديدا، ويُخفف من أعراض الالتهاب والحكة المصاحبة لها، خصوصًا في اليدين والقدمين وثنايات الجلد.

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعة:
• للبالغين والأطفال فوق عمر سنتين: يُوضع طبقة رقيقة على المنطقة المصابة مرتين يوميًا (صباحًا ومساءً).
• تتراوح مدة العلاج من 2 إلى 4 أسابيع حسب الحالة وشدتها.
• يجب تنظيف وتجفيف المنطقة جيدًا قبل وضع الكريم.
• يُمنع الاستخدام حول العينين أو على الأغشية المخاطية.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• للاستعمال الخارجي فقط.
• يُمنع ملامسة العينين.
• يُستخدم بحذر في حالات التحسس المعروفة لمركبات الإيميدازول.
• في حال حدوث تهيّج جلدي أو عدم تحسن الحالة، يُوقف العلاج ويُستشار الطبيب.
• لا يُستخدم أثناء الحمل إلا إذا كان ضروريًا تحت إشراف طبي.

المادة الفعالة:
• أيزوكونازول نترات بتركيز 10 مجم لكل 1 جرام من كريم

description.en:
FASTUM 2.5% 60GM GELl is a topical anti-inflammatory and analgesic preparation containing Ketoprofen. It is used for short-term treatment of pain and inflammation associated with acute strains, sprains, tendinitis, edema, bruises, and sports injuries .

How to Use and Dosage:
• Apply a thin layer of the gel to the affected area.
• Gently massage until fully absorbed.
• Use 2-3 times daily or as directed by a physician .

Warnings and Precautions:
• For external use only.
• Avoid contact with eyes, mucous membranes, or broken skin.
• Discontinue use if any skin reactions occur .
• Consult a healthcare professional if symptoms persist .

Active Ingredient: Ketoprofen 2.5% .

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Cefotaxime Bacteremia/Septicemia: Treatment of bacteremia/septicemia caused by Escherichia coli, Klebsiella species, and Serratia marcescens, Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcusspecies (including Streptococcus pneumoniae).
Bone or joint infections: Treatment of bone or joint infections caused by S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing strains), Streptococcus species (including Streptococcus pyogenes), Pseudomonas species (including Pseudomonas aeruginosa), and Proteus mirabilis.
CNS infections: Treatment of CNS infections (eg, meningitis, ventriculitis) caused by Neisseria meningitidis, Haemophilus influenzae, S. pneumoniae, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and E. coli.
Genitourinary infections: Treatment of genitourinary infections, including urinary tract infections (UTIs), caused by Enterococcus species, Staphylococcus epidermidis, S. aureus(penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), Citrobacter species, Enterobacter species, E. coli, Klebsiella species, P. mirabilis, Proteus vulgaris, Providencia stuartii, Morganella morganii, Providencia rettgeri, S. marcescens, and Pseudomonas species (including P. aeruginosa). Also, uncomplicated gonorrhea (cervical/urethral and rectal) caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, including penicillinase-producing strains. Note: CDC STD guidelines do not recommend cefotaxime as a treatment option for uncomplicated gonorrhea; ceftriaxone is the preferred cephalosporin (CDC [Workowski 2015]).
Gynecologic infections: Treatment of gynecologic infections, including pelvic inflammatory disease, endometritis, and pelvic cellulitis, caused by S. epidermidis, Streptococcusspecies, Enterococcus species, Enterobacter species, Klebsiella species, E. coli, P. mirabilis, Bacteroides species (including Bacteroides fragilis), Clostridium species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcus and Peptococcus species) and Fusobacterium species (including Fusobacterium nucleatum).
Intra-abdominal infections: Treatment of intra-abdominal infections, including peritonitis caused by Streptococcus species, E. coli, Klebsiella species, Bacteroides species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcus species and Peptococcus species), P. mirabilis, and Clostridium species.
Lower respiratory tract infections: Treatment of lower respiratory tract infections, including pneumonia, caused by S. pneumoniae, S. pyogenes (group A streptococci) and other streptococci (excluding enterococci, [eg, Enterococcus faecalis]), S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), E. coli, Klebsiella species, H. influenzae (including ampicillin-resistant strains), H. parainfluenzae, P. mirabilis, S. marcescens, Enterobacter species, and indole-positive Proteus and Pseudomonas species (including P. aeruginosa).
Skin and skin structure infections: Treatment of skin and skin structure infections caused by S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), S. epidermidis, S. pyogenes(group A streptococci) and other streptococci, Enterococcus species, Acinetobacter species, E. coli, Citrobacter species (including Citrobacter freundii), Enterobacter species, Klebsiella species, P. mirabilis, P. vulgaris, M. morganii, P. rettgeri, Pseudomonas species, S. marcescens, Bacteroides species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcusspecies and Peptococcus species).
Surgical prophylaxis: Reduce the incidence of certain infections in patients undergoing surgical procedures (eg, abdominal or vaginal hysterectomy, GI and GU tract surgery) that may be classified as contaminated or potentially contaminated; reduce the incidence of certain postoperative infections in patients undergoing cesarean section.

Skin and skin structure infections: Treatment of moderate to severe uncomplicated skin and skin structure infections caused by Staphylococcus aureus (methicillin-susceptible isolates only) or Streptococcus pyogenes.
Urinary tract infections (including pyelonephritis): Treatment of complicated and uncomplicated urinary tract infections, including pyelonephritis, caused by E. coli or K. pneumoniae, when the infection is severe, or caused by E. coli, K. pneumoniae, or Proteus mirabilis, when the infection is mild to moderate, including cases associated with concurrent bacteremia with these microorganisms.

AMBROXOL ORAL DROPS is a mucolytic used to loosen and clear mucus in the airways, making it easier to cough up phlegm in both acute and chronic bronchial conditions.

How to use:
• Children 2–5 years: 1 ml twice daily (≈20-25 drops each).
• Children 6–12 years: 2 ml two to three times daily (≈50 drops each).
• Take drops diluted in a little water, or juice, with or without food.
• Do not use for more than 14 days without medical review.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Contains sorbitol (may cause stomach upset or laxative effect) — avoid if you have hereditary fructose intolerance.
• Contains propylene glycol — avoid alcohol during treatment and use medical supervision in infants.
• Not routinely for children under 2 years without medical advice.

LACTEOL FORT 6 SACHETS is a probiotic dietary supplement containing Lactobacillus. It is used for the dietary management of pouchitis, ulcerative colitis, irritable bowel syndrome, and acute diarrhea. It helps restore the natural intestinal flora and supports digestive health.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Infants: 1 sachet twice daily.
• Children: 1-2 sachets on the first day, followed by 1 sachet twice daily.
• Adults: 2 sachets on the first day, followed by 1 sachet twice daily.
• Dissolve the sachet contents in a small amount of water before use.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not use in premature infants in the NICU.
• Avoid use if allergic to milk proteins.
• Consult a physician if symptoms persist or worsen.
• Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

Active Ingredients: Lactobacillus LB (10 billion CFU per sachet).

description.en:
Symbicort Turbuhaler 320/9mcg/Dose Is An Inhaler Medication Designed To Help Manage Asthma And Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). 
-It Contains Budesonide 320mcg/Inhalation & Formoterol Fumarate 9mcg/Inhalation
-This Inhaler Is Used As A Maintenance Treatment To Control Symptoms And Prevent Asthma Attacks Or COPD Exacerbations. 
-It Is Not A Rescue Inhaler And Should Not Be Used For Sudden Breathing Problems. 
-The Turbuhaler Device Delivers A Precise Dose Of Medication When The Patient Inhales Through It, Making It Convenient And Easy To Use For Individuals Who Need Regular Medication To Manage Their Respiratory Conditions.

-When Using The Inhaler It Is Advised To:
•Breathe In Forcefully And Deeply Through The Mouthpiece To Ensure That An Optimal Dose Is Delivered To The Lungs. 
•Never To Breathe Out Through The Mouthpiece. 
•Replace The Cover Of The Symbicort Turbuhaler After Use. 
• Rinse The Mouth Out With Water After Inhaling The Maintenance Dose To Minimise The Risk Of Oropharyngeal Thrush. 
-The Patient May Not Taste Or Feel Any Medication When Using Turbuhaler Due To The Small Amount Of Drug Dispensed.

سيمبيكورت توربوهالر 320/9 ميكروغرام/جرعة هو عبارة عن جهاز استنشاق يهدف إلى مساعدة في تخفيف اعراض الربو ومرض الانسداد الرئوي المزمن (COPD).

-يحتوي على بوديسونيد 320 ميكروغرام/استنشاق وفورموتيرول فومارات 9 ميكروغرام/استنشاق.
-يُستخدم هذا كعلاج للسيطرة على الأعراض ومنع نوبات الربو أو تفاقم COPD.
-لا يجب استخدامه ك جهاز استنشاق للطواريء ويجب عدم استخدامه لمشاكل التنفس المفاجئة.
-يوفر جهاز توربوهالر جرعة دقيقة من الدواء عندما يتنفس المريض من خلاله، مما يجعله مريحًا وسهل الاستخدام للأفراد الذين يحتاجون إلى دواء منتظم لإدارة حالاتهم التنفسية.
-عند استخدام المرذاذ يُنصح بما يلي:
• استنشق بقوة وعمق عبر فوهة الفم لضمان توصيل جرعة مثلى إلى الرئتين.
• لا تتنفس أبدًا من خلال فوهة الفم.
• اغلق غطاء سيمبيكورت توربوهالر بعد الاستخدام.
• اغسل الفم بالماء بعد استنشاق الجرعة الصيانية لتقليل خطر عدوي الف و اللثة.
-قد لا يشعر المريض بأي طعم أو شعور بأي دواء عند استخدام توربوهالر بسبب الكمية الدقيقة من الدواء المستخرج.

Specially formulated for young and sensitive skin, Clean & Clear Natural Bright Daily Wash is enriched with rose water and honey that gently cleanses away dirt, excess oil and impurities to bring out your skin’s natural brightness and help prevent the appearance of blackheads and spots.

Apply every day onto wet hands and rub until it forms a light foam. Gently massage all over wet face and rinse.

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Store away in a cool, dry place and away from direct sunlight.

About the brand:
CLEAN & CLEAR, a part of the Johnson & Johnson Family of Consumer Companies, is a global skin care brand solely dedicated to teen girls. The brand believes that beauty comes from being confident, comfortable and secure in your own skin. 

Founded in 1957, CLEAN & CLEAR was the first brand to deliver skin care designed specifically for the needs of young women and continues today to deliver effective and fun solutions for clean, clear beautiful skin. Clean & Clear offers a wide range of products that will help enhance your skin care routine and keep your skin looking radiant.

تم تأسيس كلين & كلير عام 1957، وهي أول علامة توفر عناية بالبشرة مصممة خصيصاُ لتلبي احتياجات الفتيات اليافعات وتستمر اليوم بتوفير حلول فعالة وممتعة للحصول على بشرة جميلة نظيفة وصافية. تقدم كلين & كلير مجموعة واسعة من المنتجات التي تساعد على تعزيز روتين عنايتك اليومية ببشرتك وتحافظ على إشراقتها.

غسول الفم ليسترين حماية الأسنان واللثة بالنعناع الناعم بطعمه الأقل حدة، ثبت مفعوله الثلاثي علمياً. فهو يحتوي على الفلورايد الذي يقوي الأسنان ليساعد في حمايتها من التسوس ويخفف الجيري للحفاظ على صحة اللثة وهو فعال حتى أسفل خط اللثة، كما أنه يمنع حدوث مشاكل اللثة فتبقى الأنفاس منعشة.

احصل على أسنان ولثة أكثر صحة نظافة أعمق من تنظيف الفرشاة وحدها مع غسول الفم ليسترين حماية الأسنان واللثة بالنعناع الناعم!

• يخفف الجيري: يخفف الجيري بشكل أفضل من استخدام فرشاة الأسنان وحدها ويزيل بقع الأسنان 
• يمنع التهاب اللثة: يقتل البكتيريا من أجل لثة أكثر صحة ويمنع حدوث مشاكل اللثة
• يحمي من التسوس: يحتوي على الفلورايد الذي يقوي مينا الأسنان فيحمي من نخر الأسنان وتآكلها
•  خالٍ من الكحول

نبذة عن العلامة: 
ليسترين هو غسول الفم الرائد في الأسواق ضمن فئة العناية الوقائية اليومية للفم.

تعود علامة ليسترين إلى بدايات الطب الحديث، أي إلى أكتر من ١٣٠ عاماً، وقد  غيّر هذا المنتج مفهوم العناية بالفهم منذ عام ١٨٩٥ بفضل تركيبته الفريدة والغنية بالزيوت العطرية الأساسية الفعالة.

وقت وكيفية الاستخدام:
يكون فعالاً للغاية عند استخدامه صباحاً ومساءً بعد تنظيف الأسنان بالفرشاة. صب كمية ٢٠ مل في كوب، تمضمض جيداً ممرراً لتسول حول الأسنان واللثة لمدة ٣٠ ثانية، ثم ابصقه.
 
نصيحة للسلامة:
للاستعمال الخارجي فقط. ،يرجى الامتناع عن بلعه غير مناسب للأطفال دون ٦ سنوات. يُحفظ بعيداً عن الحرارة الشديدة وأشعة الشمس المباشرة.

Active Ingredient: Ciprofloxacin Systemic: Children and Adolescents: Treatment of complicated urinary tract infections and pyelonephritis due to E. coli. Note: Although effective, ciprofloxacin is not the drug of first choice in children.
Infants, Children, Adolescents, and Adults: Prophylaxis to reduce incidence or progression of disease following inhalation exposure to Bacillus anthracis; prophylaxis and treatment of plague (Yersinia pestis).
Adults: Treatment of the following infections when caused by susceptible bacteria: Urinary tract infections; acute uncomplicated cystitis in females, chronic bacterial prostatitis, bone and joint infections, complicated intra-abdominal infections (in combination with metronidazole), infectious diarrhea, typhoid fever (Salmonella typhi), hospital-acquired (nosocomial) pneumonia.
Limitations of use: Because fluoroquinolones have been associated with disabling and potentially irreversible serious adverse reactions (eg, tendinitis and tendon rupture, peripheral neuropathy, CNS effects), reserve ciprofloxacin for use in patients who have no alternative treatment options for acute uncomplicated cystitis.
Ophthalmic: Ocular infections:
Ointment: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Solution: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (corneal ulcers, conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Otic: Acute otitis externa (0.2% solution): Treatment of acute otitis externa caused by susceptible isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa or Staphylococcus aureus
Otitis media (6% suspension): Treatment of bilateral otitis media in pediatric patients with effusion undergoing tympanostomy tube placement

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Perindopril Hypertension: Management of hypertension.
Stable coronary artery disease: To reduce the risk of cardiovascular mortality or nonfatal myocardial infarction in patients with stable coronary artery disease (CAD).
Guideline recommendations:
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients:
• Patients ≥60 years of age with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP is ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
CAD and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology, and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with CAD recommends the use of an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina if there is prior MI, LV systolic dysfunction, diabetes mellitus, or CKD. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents (AHA/ACC/ASH [Rosendorff 2015]).
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines recommend an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) for patients with HTN and diabetes with albuminuria (urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio [UACR] ≥30 mg/g). For patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the four classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, thiazide-like diuretics, or dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).

description.en:
CORNETEARS EYE GEL is a moisturizing ophthalmic gel indicated to support healing of burns, ulcers, and erosions of the cornea and conjunctiva, and to relieve dry eye by promoting regeneration of the surface cells. 

How to Use & Dosage:
• Adults: Place a thin layer of the gel into the lower eyelid sac 2–4 times daily. 
• Not recommended for children and adolescents. 

Warnings & Precautions:
• For external ophthalmic use only; avoid contact with the iris (colored part) or cornea.
• Remove soft contact lenses during treatment and clean thoroughly before reinserting.
• Vision may blur immediately after application—avoid driving or operating machinery for at least 20 minutes.
• Do not use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
• Store unopened at 2–8 °C; after opening, use within 30 days and store below 25 °C.

Active Ingredient:
• Vitamin A palmitate.
description.ar:
كورنيتيرز جل للعين مائي، يزيد من سرعه التئام القرح والتآكلات في ملتحمة وقرنية العين، ويخفف جفاف العين عبر تحفيز تجدد خلايا السطح.

• غير موصى به للأطفال والمراهقين.

• للاستعمال الخارجي في العين فقط؛ تجنّب ملامسة الجزء الملون (القزحية) أو القرنية.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ondansetron Cancer chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting:
IV: Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of emetogenic cancer chemotherapy (including high-dose cisplatin)
Oral:

Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of moderately emetogenic cancer chemotherapy.
Radiotherapy-associated nausea and vomiting: Oral: Prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with radiotherapy in patients receiving either total body irradiation, single high-dose fraction to the abdomen, or daily fractions to the abdomen.
Postoperative nausea and/or vomiting: IV and Oral: Prevention of postoperative nausea and/or vomiting (PONV). If nausea/vomiting occur in a patient who had not received prophylactic ondansetron, IV ondansetron may be administered to prevent further episodes.
Limitations of use: Routine prophylaxis for PONV in patients with minimal expectation of nausea and/or vomiting is not recommended, although use is recommended in patients when nausea and vomiting must be avoided in the postoperative period, even if the incidence of PONV is low.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Methylprednisolone Oral, IM, and IV administration:
Allergic: Control of severe or incapacitating allergic conditions intractable to adequate trials of conventional treatment in atopic dermatitis, drug hypersensitivity reactions, seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis, serum sickness, and/or transfusion reactions.
Dermatologic: Bullous dermatitis herpetiformis; contact dermatitis; exfoliative dermatitis; exfoliative erythroderma; mycosis fungoides; pemphigus; erythema multiforme (Stevens-Johnson syndrome); severe psoriasis; severe seborrheic dermatitis.
Endocrine: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia; hypercalcemia associated with cancer; nonsuppurative thyroiditis; primary or secondary adrenocortical insufficiency (hydrocortisone or cortisone is the first choice; synthetic analogs may be used in conjunction with mineralocorticoids where applicable).
GI: To tide the patient over a critical period of the disease in Crohn disease or ulcerative colitis.
Hematologic: Acquired (autoimmune) hemolytic anemia; congenital (erythroid) hypoplastic anemia (Diamond Blackfan anemia); erythroblastopenia (RBC anemia; oral only); immune thrombocytopenia (formerly known as idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura) (adults; oral and IV only); pure red cell aplasia (excluding oral); secondary thrombocytopenia.
Neoplastic: Palliative management of leukemias and lymphomas.
Nervous system: Acute exacerbations of multiple sclerosis; cerebral edema associated with primary or metastatic brain tumor, craniotomy, or head injury (excluding oral).
Ophthalmic:
Oral: Severe acute and chronic allergic and inflammatory processes involving the eye and its adnexa such as allergic conjunctivitis; allergic corneal marginal ulcers; anterior segment inflammation; chorioretinitis; diffuse posterior uveitis and choroiditis; herpes zoster ophthalmicus; iritis and iridocyclitis; keratitis; optic neuritis; sympathetic ophthalmia; uveitis.
Injection: Sympathetic ophthalmia; temporal arteritis, uveitis and other ocular inflammatory conditions unresponsive to topical corticosteroids.
Renal: To induce diuresis or remission of proteinuria in nephrotic syndrome, with or without uremia, of the idiopathic type or that due to lupus erythematosus.
Respiratory: Aspiration pneumonitis (oral only); asthma; berylliosis; fulminating or disseminated pulmonary tuberculosis when used concurrently with appropriate antituberculous chemotherapy; idiopathic eosinophilic pneumonias; symptomatic sarcoidosis.
Rheumatic: As adjunctive therapy for short-term administration in acute rheumatic carditis, acute gouty arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, dermatomyositis, polymyositis, psoriatic arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (including juvenile rheumatoid arthritis), systemic lupus erythematosus; as adjunctive therapy for short-term administration in acute and subacute bursitis, acute nonspecific tenosynovitis, epicondylitis, posttraumatic osteoarthritis, relapsing polychondritis, synovitis of osteoarthritis (oral only).
Miscellaneous: Trichinosis with neurologic or myocardial involvement; tuberculous meningitis with subarachnoid block or impending block when used concurrently with appropriate antituberculous chemotherapy.
Intra-articular or soft tissue administration (methylprednisolone acetate only): As adjunctive therapy for short-term administration in acute gouty arthritis, acute and subacute bursitis, acute nonspecific tenosynovitis, epicondylitis, rheumatoid arthritis, and/or synovitis of osteoarthritis.
Intralesional administration (methylprednisolone acetate only): Alopecia areata; discoid lupus erythematosus; keloids; localized hypertrophic; infiltrated, inflammatory lesions of granuloma annulare; lichen planus; lichen simplex chronicus (neurodermatitis); psoriatic plaques; necrobiosis lipoidica diabeticorum. May be useful in cystic tumor of an aponeurosis or tendon (ganglia).

description.en:
• Marcal 30 Tablets are used to treat calcium deficiency and support bone health. 
• Active ingredient: Calcium Acetate 700mg. 
• Indication: Used for the treatment and prevention of calcium deficiency, management of hyperphosphatemia in patients with chronic kidney disease, and support of bone health. It is suitable for use in cases of increased calcium needs, such as during pregnancy, lactation, and for adolescents and the elderly. 
• Dose: 1 tablet daily, or as prescribed by the physician.

description.en:
FUSI 2% 15GM CREAM is used for the treatment of bacterial skin infections, such as impetigo, infected dermatitis, and infected cuts or wounds. It helps to reduce redness, swelling, and discomfort caused by bacterial infections.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Apply a thin layer of Fusi 2% Cream to the affected area 2-3 times daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional.
• Wash and dry the skin thoroughly before use.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, or mouth.
• Do not use on large areas of the body or on deep wounds.

Active Ingredient:
• Fusidic Acid
description.ar:
فيوسي 2% كريم يُستخدم لعلاج العدوى البكتيرية في الجلد مثل الدمامل ، التهاب الجلد المصابة، والجروح الملوثة. يساعد في تقليل الاحمرار والتورم الناتجين عن هذه العدوى.

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعه :
• ضع طبقة رقيقة من فيوسي 2% كريم على المنطقة المصابة من مرتين إلي ثلاث مرات يوميًا.
• يتم غسل الجلد و تجفيفه جيدًا قبل استخدام الكريم.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• تجنب ملامسة العين أو الأنف أو الفم.
• لا يُستخدم على مساحات كبيرة من الجسم أو على الجروح العميقة دون إشراف طبي.

المادة الفعالة:
• حمض الفيوسيديك 2%.

description.en:
• Tablets for the Treatment of Osteoporosis
• Each tablet contains 70 mg of alendronate and 2800 international units of vitamin D.
• The usual dose: one tablet once a week.
• It should be used on an empty stomach (at least half an hour before the first meal) and drink with it a large glass of water (at least 200 mL). Avoid sleeping or lying down after taking the medicine for at least half an hour.

•        FOSAMAX 70mg tablet is a bisphosphonates prescription medication primarily used to prevent or treat osteoporosis in.
•        Ingredients: 70mg of Alendronate.
•        Indications:
o        Osteoporosis in females who’ve gone through menopause.
o        Osteoporosis in males.
o        Osteoporosis caused by using a type of medication called glucocorticoid
o        Paget’s disease of bone (a condition that causes weak, soft bones).
•        Dosage/Usage Instructions: The usual effective dose is one tablet (70mg) once a week. 
•        Stand or sit upright for at least 30 minutes
•        The tablet should be taken after getting up for the day and before taking your first food, beverage, or other medication.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Felodipine Hypertension: Treatment of hypertension
Guideline recommendations:
The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (JNC 8) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC8 [James, 2013]):
• Patients ≥ 60 years, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension: In patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general nonblack population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines suggest that for patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, thiazide-like diuretics, dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Atorvastatin Dyslipidemias:
Dysbetalipoproteinemia: Treatment of primary dysbetalipoproteinemia (Fredrickson type III).
Heterozygous familial and nonfamilial hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia: To reduce elevated total cholesterol (total-C), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), apolipoprotein B (apo B), and triglyceride levels, and to increase HDL-C in patients with primary hypercholesterolemia (heterozygous familial and nonfamilial) and mixed dyslipidemia (Fredrickson type IIa and IIb).
Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C, LDL-C, and apo B levels in boys and postmenarche girls 10 to 17 years of age with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia with LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL, LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with positive family history of premature cardiovascular disease (CVD), or LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with two or more other CVD risk factors.
Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C and LDL-C in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia as an adjunct to other lipid-lowering treatments (eg, LDL apheresis) or if such treatments are unavailable.
Hypertriglyceridemia: Treatment of elevated serum triglyceride levels (Fredrickson type IV).
Limitations of use: Has not been studied in conditions where the major lipid abnormality is elevation of chylomicrons (Fredrickson types I and V).
Prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD):
Primary prevention of cardiovascular disease (high-risk for CVD): To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and revascularization procedures and angina in adult patients without clinically evident coronary heart disease (CHD) who have multiple CHD risk factors (eg, age, smoking, hypertension, low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol [HDL-C], family history of early CHD); to reduce the risk of MI and stroke in patients with type 2 diabetes and without clinically evident CHD but with multiple risk factors for CHD (eg, retinopathy, albuminuria, smoking, hypertension).
Secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease: To reduce the risk of nonfatal MI, fatal and nonfatal stroke, revascularization procedures, hospitalization for decompensated heart failure, and angina in patients with clinically evident CHD.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Ceftriaxone 2gm

●Intravenous

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Third Generation Cephalosporin Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose
For Adults:
1-Moderate And Severe Infections:
-1gm Or 2gm Every 24 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
-500mg Or 1g Every 12 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
2-Uncomplicated Gonorrhea:
250mg As A Single Dose Intramuscular.
*There Is Limited Experience With Daily Doses Of 3-4gm Administered As A Single Dose Or Two Equally Divided Doses.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4gm.
For Infants And Children (One Month To 12 Years Of Age):
1-Serious Miscellaneous Infections: 25 Or 37.5 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 2 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.
2-Meningitis: 50 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.

●Special Notes
-Hypersensitivity Test Must Be Made.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Dose To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Reconstitution Tips
-For Intramuscular Use: Solutions Should Be Reconstituted Immediately Before Use. If Storage Is Required, These Solutions May Be Stored Under Refrigeration(Between 2 And 8°C) And Should Be Used Within 48 Hours.
-For Intravenous Bolus Injection (Without Further Dilution): Reconstituted Solutions Should Be Administered Within 24 Hours When Stored At Room Temperature And Within 72 Hours When Refrigerated (Between 2 And 8°C).
description.ar:
●المادة الفعالة
سيفترياكسون 2جم

●للحقن الوريدي
●دواعي الاستعمال
مضاد حيوي واسع المجال من الجيل الثالث من فئة السيفالوسبورين

●كيفية عمل الدواء
مضاد للبكتريا مثبط لبناء الجدار الخلوي للبكتيريا

●الجرعة
للبالغين:
الالتهابات البكتيرية المتوسطة والشديدة:
1- 1 جم أو 2 جم كل 24 ساعة في العضل أو في الوريد.
2- 500 مجم أو 1 جم كل 12 ساعة فى العضل أو فى الوريد.
السيلان:
250 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في العضل.
* هناك جرعات يومية من 3-4 جم تعطى كجرعة وحيدة أو جرعتين مقسمتين بالتساوي وذلك لبعض الحالات بالرجوع للطبيب.
* يجب ألا تتجاوز الجرعة اليومية الإجمالية 4 جرام.
للرضع والأطفال (من شهر إلى 12 سنة):
1-حالات العدوى البكتيرية الخطيرة: 25 أو 37.5 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 2 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.
2-التهاب السحايا: 50 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 4 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.

● ملاحظات هامة:
- يجب إجراء اختبار حساسية.
- اتبع تعليمات طبيبك حول الجرعة التي يجب استخدامها وأيام العلاج.

● ملحوظات تخص تحليل الحقنة:
- للاستخدام العضلي: يجب تحليل الحقنة مباشرة قبل الاستخدام. إذا كان التخزين مطلوبًا ، يمكن تخزين هذه المحاليل تحت التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات سيليزية) ويجب استخدامها في غضون 48 ساعة.
- بالنسبة للحقن الوريدي:يجب إعطاء الحقنة بعد تحليلها في غضون 24 ساعة عند تخزينها في درجة حرارة الغرفة وخلال 72 ساعة عند التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات مئوية).

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Amlodipine Coronary artery disease (CAD):
Chronic stable angina: Treatment of symptomatic chronic stable angina. May be used alone or in combination with other antianginal agents.
Vasospastic angina (Prinzmetal or variant angina): Treatment of confirmed or suspected vasospastic angina. May be used alone or in combination with other antianginal agents.
Angiographically documented CAD: Reduce the risk of hospitalization secondary to angina and to reduce the risk of a coronary revascularization procedure in patients with recently documented CAD by angiography (without heart failure or an ejection fraction of <40%).
The ACCF/AHA 2013 guidelines for management of heart failure state that, with the exception of amlodipine, calcium channel blockers should be avoided and withdrawn whenever possible in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). While amlodipine, like other calcium channel blockers, has no benefit on functioning or survival, it may be used for the treatment of hypertension or ischemic heart disease in patients with HFrEF (ACCF/AHA [Yancy 2013]).
Hypertension: Treatment of hypertension. May be used alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents.
Guideline recommendations:
The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (JNC 8) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC8 [James 2013]):
• Patients ≥60 years, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension: In patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general nonblack population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines suggest that for patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, thiazide-like diuretics, dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).

description.en:
MELOCAM 15MG 30 TABLETS is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to treat pain and inflammation caused by arthritis.

How to use and dosage:
•Adults: Take one tablet (15mg) once daily, preferably with food to reduce stomach upset.
•Do not exceed the prescribed dose, and follow your physician's instructions.

Warnings and precautions:
•Avoid use if allergic to Meloxicam or other NSAIDs.
•Consult your physician if you have a history of stomach ulcers, kidney or liver disease, or heart conditions.
•Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless prescribed by a doctor.

Active ingredient: Meloxicam.

• لا يُستخدم في حالة وجود حساسية من ميلوكسيكام أو أي من مضادات الالتهاب غير الستيرويدية الأخرى.

description.en:
Pantoprazole
 
●Concentration: 40 milligram Tablet
●Uses and Indication
Peptic and Duodenal ulcer
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
Heart burn
Adjuvant therapy in Treatment of H. pylori infection
Long-term treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, multiple endocrine adenomas and systemic mastocytosis
●Mode of action
Esomeprazole belongs to a class of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors (PPIs) that reduce stomach acid production
●Dosage and administration
Adult dose: used on empty stomach one hour before breakfast but maybe used twice daily not more than 2 months
Children dose : ages between 1-16 years may take a dose 5-20 Milligram/day prescribed by the physician
●Precautions
consult your physician or the pharmacist if you take another medications especially for chronic diseases
Long time use may lead to long-term inflammation of the stomach called atrophic gastritis
description.ar:
بانتوبرازول
●التركيز 40 ملليجرام قرص
●دواعى الإستخدام:
قرحة المعدة والإثتنى عشر
الحموضة الزائدة
عامل مساعد فى علاج البكتريا الحلزونية
فى بعض الأمراض مثل متلازمة زولينجر إليسون ومرض كثرة الخلية البدينة
●طريقة عمل الدواء:
بانتوبرازول هو أحد مشتقات مجموعة مايعرف بمثبطات مضخات الحمض بالمعدة او Proton pump Inhibitors التى تقلل من انتاج الحمض بالمعدة
●الجرعة :
للبالغين يأخذ قرص مرة قبل الفطار بساعة ويمكن أخذ قرص مرتين يوميا قبل الفطار وقبل العشاء بساعة وينصح بعدم إستخدامها أكثر من أسبوعين
من عمر1-16 سنة يؤخذ جرعة من 5-20 ملليجرام يوميا وتوصف بواسطة الطبيب 
●التحذيرات :
أستشر طبيبك أو الصيدلى إذا كنت تأخذ أدوية أخرى خاصة للأمراض المزمنة 
الإستخدام المفرط للدواء قد يسبب ضمور بالمعدة

How to Use and Dosage:
• Apply the gel to the affected area and massage gently until completely absorbed.
• Can be used up to 3 times daily .
• Can be used during or immediately after exercise .

Warnings and Precautions:
• Consult your physician before use, especially if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other medications.
• Suitable for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding for back discomfort, but always consult your doctor first .
• Keep out of reach of children .

ديب فريز جل مسكن للتبريد سريع المفعول يُستخدم لتخفيف آلام العضلات، الالتواءات، الشد العضلي، آلام الظهر، التهابات المفاصل، والإصابات الرياضية البسيطة. يعمل كبديل للثلج من خلال تبريد فوري ومركز للمنطقة المصابة.

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعة:
• يُوضع الجل على المنطقة المصابة ويُدلّك بلطف حتى يتم امتصاصه بالكامل.
• يمكن استخدامه حتى 3 مرات يوميًا.
• يُمكن استخدامه أثناء التمارين أو بعدها مباشرة.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Apixaban Deep vein thrombosis: Treatment of deep vein thrombosis; to reduce the risk of recurrent deep vein thrombosis following initial therapy
Note: The American College of Chest Physicians (ACCP) guidelines for VTE suggest apixaban (or dabigatran, rivaroxaban, or edoxaban) over a vitamin K antagonist as long-term anticoagulant therapy in patients with DVT of the leg and without cancer (Kearon 2012; Kearon 2016).
Nonvalvular atrial fibrillation: To reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation (AF)
Note: The 2014 American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology/Heart Rhythm Society guidelines for the management of AF recommend oral anticoagulation for patients with nonvalvular AF or atrial flutter with prior stroke, TIA, or a CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥2. As an alternative to warfarin, apixaban may also be used for at least 3 weeks prior and 4 weeks after cardioversion in patients with AF or atrial flutter of ≥48 hours duration or when the duration is unknown 
Postoperative venous thromboprophylaxis following hip or knee replacement surgery: Prophylaxis of deep vein thrombosis, which may lead to pulmonary embolism, in patients who have undergone hip or knee replacement surgery
Pulmonary embolism: Treatment of pulmonary embolism; to reduce the risk of recurrent pulmonary embolism following initial therapy
Note: The American College of Chest Physicians (ACCP) guidelines for VTE suggest apixaban (or dabigatran, rivaroxaban, or edoxaban) over a vitamin K antagonist as long-term anticoagulant therapy in patients with PE and without cancer

description.en:
• A test to detect pregnancy
• Pregnancy can be detected in the blood within 24-48 hours.
• Pregnancy can be detected in urine 3-5 days after a missed period.
• Sample could be urine/serum/plasma or blood
How to use:
-        Place it on a level, dry surface. 
-        Release three drops of urine into the sample well. 
-        After the urine has moved across the testing window, set your timer for ten minutes and wait for the results. 
-        Do not immediately dispose of the urine in case there is any need to redo the test. 
-        Within three minutes the control line "c" will begin to turn pink. 
-        If the test is positive, another pink line will appear under the "t" or test zone. 
-        If the test is negative, the zone under the "t" will not change color. 
-        The test line may show a variety of shades of pink from light to bright depending on the levels of hcg. 
-        If any shade of pink appears, even a very slight line, the test should be considered positive. 
-        If no pink line occurs in the control zone "c" the test is invalid. 
-        High sensitivity urine-based pregnancy tests performed on specimens containing levels of hcg below 20miu may show color development over time, indicating the need to retest in 48 hours. 
-        Do not read the test after ten minutes.
description.ar:
• اختبار للكشف عن الحمل
• يمكن كشف الحمل في الدم خلال 24-48 ساعة.
• يمكن كشف الحمل في البول بعد 3-5 أيام من تأخر الدورة.
• يمكن وضع عينة بول/سيرم/بلازما او دم
كيفية الاستخدام:
- ضعيه على سطح مستوٍ وجاف.
- ضعي ثلاث قطرات من البول في مكان العينة
- بعد أن ينتقل البول عبر نافذة الاختبار، انتظري لمدة عشر دقائق وانتظري النتائج.
- لا تتخلص فورًا من البول في حالة الحاجة إلى إعادة الاختبار.
- خلال ثلاث دقائق، سيبدأ خط التحكم "c" في التحول إلى اللون الوردي.
- إذا كان الاختبار إيجابيًا، سيظهر خط آخر وردي تحت "t" أو منطقة الاختبار.
- إذا كان الاختبار سلبيًا، فإن المنطقة تحت "t" لن تتغير اللون.
- قد يظهر خط الاختبار مجموعة متنوعة من الدرجات الوردية من الفاتحة إلى الزاهية اعتمادًا على مستويات الهرمون المشيمي التكويني (hcg).
- إذا ظهرت أي درجة من اللون الوردي، حتى خط بسيط جدًا، يجب اعتبار الاختبار إيجابيًا.
- إذا لم يظهر خط وردي في منطقة التحكم "c"، فإن الاختبار غير صالح.
- قد تظهر اختبارات الحمل البولية ذات الحساسية العالية التي تتم على عينات تحتوي على مستويات hcg دون 20 ميللي وحدة دولية في اللتر تطورًا في اللون مع مرور الوقت، مما يشير إلى الحاجة إلى إعادة الاختبار في 48 ساعة.
- لا تقرأ الاختبار بعد مرور عشر دقائق.

description.en:

Amebiasis: 
Oral immediate-release tablet and capsule: Treatment of acute intestinal amebiasis (amebic dysentery) and amebic liver abscess
Limitations of use: When used for amebic liver abscess, may be used concurrently with percutaneous needle aspiration when it is clinically indicated.

Anaerobic bacterial infections (caused by Bacteroides spp., including the B. fragilis group): 
Oral immediate-release tablet, capsule, and injection:

Bacterial septicemia: 
Treatment of bacterial septicemia (also caused by Clostridium spp.)

Bone and joint infections: 
Treatment (adjunctive therapy) of bone and joint infections

CNS Infections: 
Treatment of CNS infections, including meningitis and brain abscess

Endocarditis: 
Treatment of endocarditis

Gynecologic infections: 
Treatment of gynecologic infections including endometritis, endomyometritis, tubo-ovarian abscess, or postsurgical vaginal cuff infection (also caused by Clostridium spp., Peptococcus spp., Peptostreptococcus spp., and Fusobacterium spp.)

Intra-abdominal infections: 
Treatment of intra-abdominal infections, including peritonitis, intra-abdominal abscess and liver abscess (also caused by Clostridium spp., Eubacterium spp., Peptococcus spp., and Peptostreptococcus spp.)

Lower respiratory tract infections: 
Treatment of lower respiratory tract infections, including pneumonia, empyema and lung abscess
Skin and skin structure infections: 
Treatment of skin and skin structure infections (also caused by Clostridium spp., Peptococcus spp., Peptostreptococcus spp., and Fusobacterium spp.)

Bacterial vaginosis: 
Oral extended-release tablet: Treatment of bacterial vaginosis in nonpregnant women

Surgical prophylaxis (colorectal surgery): 
Injection: Preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative prophylaxis to reduce the incidence of postoperative infection in patients undergoing elective colorectal surgery classified as contaminated or potentially contaminated

Trichomoniasis: 
Oral immediate-release tablet, capsule: Treatment of infections caused by Trichomonas vaginalis, including treatment of asymptomatic sexual partners

• Colona film-coated tablets are used for the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders characterized by spasms and anxiety.
• Active Ingredients: Mebeverine hydrochloride 100mg, sulpiride 25mg.
• Indication: Treatment of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other gastrointestinal disorders involving spasms, pain, and anxiety. Mebeverine hydrochloride acts as an antispasmodic to relieve muscle spasms in the gastrointestinal tract, while sulpiride helps manage anxiety and related symptoms.
• Dosage: 1 tablet 3 to 4 times daily before meals, or as prescribed by the physician.
description.ar:
• أقراص كولونا المغلفة تُستخدم لعلاج اضطرابات الجهاز الهضمي التي تتميز بالتشنجات والقلق. 
• المكونات الفعالة: ميبيفيرين هيدروكلوريد 100 مجم، سلبيريد 25 مجم. 
• الاستخدام: علاج متلازمة القولون العصبي واضطرابات الجهاز الهضمي الأخرى التي تنطوي على التشنجات، الألم، والقلق. يعمل ميبيفيرين هيدروكلوريد كمضاد للتشنجات لتخفيف تشنجات العضلات في الجهاز الهضمي، بينما يساعد سلبيريد في تقليل القلق والأعراض المرتبطة به. 
• الجرعة: 1 قرص ثلاث إلى أربع مرات يوميًا قبل الوجبات، أو كما يصف الطبيب.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Ceftriaxone 500mg

●Intramuscular

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Third Generation Cephalosporin Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose
For Adults:
1-Moderate And Severe Infections:
-1gm Or 2gm Every 24 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
-500mg Or 1g Every 12 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
2-Uncomplicated Gonorrhea:
250mg As A Single Dose Intramuscular.
*There Is Limited Experience With Daily Doses Of 3-4gm Administered As A Single Dose Or Two Equally Divided Doses.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4gm.
For Infants And Children (One Month To 12 Years Of Age):
1-Serious Miscellaneous Infections: 25 Or 37.5 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 2 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.
2-Meningitis: 50 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.

●Special Notes
-Hypersensitivity Test Must Be Made.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Dose To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Reconstitution Tips
-For Intramuscular Use: Solutions Should Be Reconstituted Immediately Before Use. If Storage Is Required, These Solutions May Be Stored Under Refrigeration(Between 2 And 8°C) And Should Be Used Within 48 Hours.
-For Intravenous Bolus Injection (Without Further Dilution): Reconstituted Solutions Should Be Administered Within 24 Hours When Stored At Room Temperature And Within 72 Hours When Refrigerated (Between 2 And 8°C).
description.ar:
●المادة الفعالة
سيفترياكسون 500مجم

●للحقن العضلي
●دواعي الاستعمال
مضاد حيوي واسع المجال من الجيل الثالث من فئة السيفالوسبورين

●كيفية عمل الدواء
مضاد للبكتريا مثبط لبناء الجدار الخلوي للبكتيريا

●الجرعة
للبالغين:
الالتهابات البكتيرية المتوسطة والشديدة:
1- 1 جم أو 2 جم كل 24 ساعة في العضل أو في الوريد.
2- 500 مجم أو 1 جم كل 12 ساعة فى العضل أو فى الوريد.
السيلان:
250 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في العضل.
* هناك جرعات يومية من 3-4 جم تعطى كجرعة وحيدة أو جرعتين مقسمتين بالتساوي وذلك لبعض الحالات بالرجوع للطبيب.
* يجب ألا تتجاوز الجرعة اليومية الإجمالية 4 جرام.
للرضع والأطفال (من شهر إلى 12 سنة):
1-حالات العدوى البكتيرية الخطيرة: 25 أو 37.5 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 2 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.
2-التهاب السحايا: 50 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 4 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.

● ملاحظات هامة:
- يجب إجراء اختبار حساسية.
- اتبع تعليمات طبيبك حول الجرعة التي يجب استخدامها وأيام العلاج.

● ملحوظات تخص تحليل الحقنة:
- للاستخدام العضلي: يجب تحليل الحقنة مباشرة قبل الاستخدام. إذا كان التخزين مطلوبًا ، يمكن تخزين هذه المحاليل تحت التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات سيليزية) ويجب استخدامها في غضون 48 ساعة.
- بالنسبة للحقن الوريدي:يجب إعطاء الحقنة بعد تحليلها في غضون 24 ساعة عند تخزينها في درجة حرارة الغرفة وخلال 72 ساعة عند التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات مئوية).
