●Uses and Indication
Peptic and Duodenal ulcer
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
Heart burn
Adjuvant therapy in Treatment of H. pylori infection
Long-term treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, multiple endocrine adenomas and systemic mastocytosis
●Mode of action
Esomeprazole belongs to a class of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors (PPIs) that reduce stomach acid production
●Dosage and administration
Adult dose: used on empty stomach one hour before breakfast but maybe used twice daily not more than 2 months
Children dose : ages between 1-16 years may take a dose 5-20 Milligram/day prescribed by the physician
●Precautions
consult your physician or the pharmacist if you take another medications especially for chronic diseases
Long time use may lead to long-term inflammation of the stomach called atrophic gastritis

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Ceftriaxone 500mg

●Intramuscular

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Third Generation Cephalosporin Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose
For Adults:
1-Moderate And Severe Infections:
-1gm Or 2gm Every 24 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
-500mg Or 1g Every 12 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
2-Uncomplicated Gonorrhea:
250mg As A Single Dose Intramuscular.
*There Is Limited Experience With Daily Doses Of 3-4gm Administered As A Single Dose Or Two Equally Divided Doses.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4gm.
For Infants And Children (One Month To 12 Years Of Age):
1-Serious Miscellaneous Infections: 25 Or 37.5 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 2 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.
2-Meningitis: 50 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.

●Special Notes
-Hypersensitivity Test Must Be Made.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Dose To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Reconstitution Tips
-For Intramuscular Use: Solutions Should Be Reconstituted Immediately Before Use. If Storage Is Required, These Solutions May Be Stored Under Refrigeration(Between 2 And 8°C) And Should Be Used Within 48 Hours.
-For Intravenous Bolus Injection (Without Further Dilution): Reconstituted Solutions Should Be Administered Within 24 Hours When Stored At Room Temperature And Within 72 Hours When Refrigerated (Between 2 And 8°C).

السيلان:
250 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في العضل.
* هناك جرعات يومية من 3-4 جم تعطى كجرعة وحيدة أو جرعتين مقسمتين بالتساوي وذلك لبعض الحالات بالرجوع للطبيب.
* يجب ألا تتجاوز الجرعة اليومية الإجمالية 4 جرام.
للرضع والأطفال (من شهر إلى 12 سنة):
1-حالات العدوى البكتيرية الخطيرة: 25 أو 37.5 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 2 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.
2-التهاب السحايا: 50 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 4 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.

● ملاحظات هامة:
- يجب إجراء اختبار حساسية.
- اتبع تعليمات طبيبك حول الجرعة التي يجب استخدامها وأيام العلاج.

● ملحوظات تخص تحليل الحقنة:
- للاستخدام العضلي: يجب تحليل الحقنة مباشرة قبل الاستخدام. إذا كان التخزين مطلوبًا ، يمكن تخزين هذه المحاليل تحت التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات سيليزية) ويجب استخدامها في غضون 48 ساعة.
- بالنسبة للحقن الوريدي:يجب إعطاء الحقنة بعد تحليلها في غضون 24 ساعة عند تخزينها في درجة حرارة الغرفة وخلال 72 ساعة عند التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات مئوية).

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Apixaban Deep vein thrombosis: Treatment of deep vein thrombosis; to reduce the risk of recurrent deep vein thrombosis following initial therapy
Note: The American College of Chest Physicians (ACCP) guidelines for VTE suggest apixaban (or dabigatran, rivaroxaban, or edoxaban) over a vitamin K antagonist as long-term anticoagulant therapy in patients with DVT of the leg and without cancer (Kearon 2012; Kearon 2016).
Nonvalvular atrial fibrillation: To reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation (AF)
Note: The 2014 American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology/Heart Rhythm Society guidelines for the management of AF recommend oral anticoagulation for patients with nonvalvular AF or atrial flutter with prior stroke, TIA, or a CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥2. As an alternative to warfarin, apixaban may also be used for at least 3 weeks prior and 4 weeks after cardioversion in patients with AF or atrial flutter of ≥48 hours duration or when the duration is unknown 
Postoperative venous thromboprophylaxis following hip or knee replacement surgery: Prophylaxis of deep vein thrombosis, which may lead to pulmonary embolism, in patients who have undergone hip or knee replacement surgery
Pulmonary embolism: Treatment of pulmonary embolism; to reduce the risk of recurrent pulmonary embolism following initial therapy
Note: The American College of Chest Physicians (ACCP) guidelines for VTE suggest apixaban (or dabigatran, rivaroxaban, or edoxaban) over a vitamin K antagonist as long-term anticoagulant therapy in patients with PE and without cancer

description.en:
Omeprazol
●Concentration: 20 milligram Capsule
●Uses and Indication
Peptic and Duodenal ulcer
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
Heart burn
Adjuvant therapy in Treatment of H. pylori infection
Long-term treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, multiple endocrine adenomas and systemic mastocytosis
●Mode of action
Omeprazol belongs to a class of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors (PPIs) that reduce stomach acid production
●Dosage and administration
Adult dose: used on empty stomach one hour before breakfast but maybe used twice daily not more than 2 months
Children dose : ages between 1-16 years may take a dose 5-20 Milligram/day prescribed by the physician
●Precautions
consult your physician or the pharmacist if you take another medications especially for chronic diseases
Long time use may lead to long-term inflammation of the stomach called atrophic gastritis

o        Inhaler Capsules have a long-acting bronchodilator.
o        Indication: used as a long-term treatment to prevent or decrease wheezing and trouble breathing caused by asthma or ongoing lung disease. It is also used to prevent bronchospasm in adults with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including emphysema and chronic bronchitis.
o        Dosage/Usage Instructions: The usual dosage is the inhalation of the contents of one 12 mcg FORADIL capsule every 12 hours. 
o        Precautions:
o        This product is intended for adults and children who are at least 5 years old. 
o        FORADIL is not a rescue medicine. It will not work fast enough to treat a bronchospasm attack. Use only a fast-acting inhalation medicine for an attack.
o        Administration/Method of Use: Inhale the contents of the capsule by mouth using the inhaler device.Do not swallow these capsules by mouth.
o        The active ingredient in FORADIL is formoterol 12 mcg.

Amebiasis: 
Oral immediate-release tablet and capsule: Treatment of acute intestinal amebiasis (amebic dysentery) and amebic liver abscess
Limitations of use: When used for amebic liver abscess, may be used concurrently with percutaneous needle aspiration when it is clinically indicated.

Anaerobic bacterial infections (caused by Bacteroides spp., including the B. fragilis group): 
Oral immediate-release tablet, capsule, and injection:

Bacterial septicemia: 
Treatment of bacterial septicemia (also caused by Clostridium spp.)

Bone and joint infections: 
Treatment (adjunctive therapy) of bone and joint infections

CNS Infections: 
Treatment of CNS infections, including meningitis and brain abscess

Endocarditis: 
Treatment of endocarditis

Gynecologic infections: 
Treatment of gynecologic infections including endometritis, endomyometritis, tubo-ovarian abscess, or postsurgical vaginal cuff infection (also caused by Clostridium spp., Peptococcus spp., Peptostreptococcus spp., and Fusobacterium spp.)

Intra-abdominal infections: 
Treatment of intra-abdominal infections, including peritonitis, intra-abdominal abscess and liver abscess (also caused by Clostridium spp., Eubacterium spp., Peptococcus spp., and Peptostreptococcus spp.)

Lower respiratory tract infections: 
Treatment of lower respiratory tract infections, including pneumonia, empyema and lung abscess
Skin and skin structure infections: 
Treatment of skin and skin structure infections (also caused by Clostridium spp., Peptococcus spp., Peptostreptococcus spp., and Fusobacterium spp.)

Bacterial vaginosis: 
Oral extended-release tablet: Treatment of bacterial vaginosis in nonpregnant women

Surgical prophylaxis (colorectal surgery): 
Injection: Preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative prophylaxis to reduce the incidence of postoperative infection in patients undergoing elective colorectal surgery classified as contaminated or potentially contaminated

Trichomoniasis: 
Oral immediate-release tablet, capsule: Treatment of infections caused by Trichomonas vaginalis, including treatment of asymptomatic sexual partners

description.en:
LOPRANEST 2 MG ORODISPERSIBLE FILMS are used to treat acute diarrhea and control symptoms of chronic diarrhea, including diarrhea associated with irritable bowel syndrome. 

How to Use and Dosage:
• Tablets are orodispersible—place on tongue to dissolve before swallowing.
• Adults and children ≥ 12 years:
Initial dose: 2 tablets (4 mg) orally, followed by 1 tablet (2 mg) after each loose stool.
Maximum dose: 8 tablets (16 mg) per day.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Not to be used in children under 12 years without medical advice.
• Avoid use in cases of infectious diarrhea caused by invasive organisms.
• Discontinue if constipation or abdominal distension occurs.
• Avoid use if fever or blood in stool is present.
• Consult doctor if symptoms persist beyond 48 hours or worsen.

Active Ingredient:
• Loperamide hydrochloride 2 mg per film.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Candesartan Heart failure: Treatment of heart failure (NYHA class II-IV)
Hypertension: Alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents in treating hypertension
Guideline recommendations:
Heart failure: The ACCF/AHA 2013 heart failure guidelines recommend the use of ARBs (ie, candesartan, losartan, and valsartan) in patients with HF with reduced ejection fraction who cannot tolerate ACE inhibitors (due to cough) to reduce morbidity and mortality. They also suggest that ARBs are reasonable first-line alternatives to ACE inhibitors in patients already maintained on an ARB for other indications (ACCF/AHA [Yancy 2013]).
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8; James 2013]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients:
• Patients ≥60 years with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with diabetes and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Coronary artery disease and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) recommends the use of an ARB (or ACE inhibitor) as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina if there is prior MI, LV systolic dysfunction, diabetes mellitus, or CKD. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents (AHA/ACC/ASH [Rosendorff 2015]).
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines recommend an ARB (or an ACE inhibitor) for patients with hypertension and diabetes with albuminuria (urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio [UACR] ≥30 mg/g). For patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, thiazide-like diuretics, dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).

description.en:
LUBRIVISC Eye Drop is an ophthalmic suspension used to relieve symptoms of dry eyes such as irritation, burning, and discomfort. It acts as a lubricant to moisturize and protect the ocular surface, improving comfort for patients with dry eye syndrome.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Instill 1-2 drops in the affected eye(s) as needed, up to 4 times daily.
• Shake well before use.
• Remove contact lenses before application and wait at least 15 minutes before reinserting lenses.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For ophthalmic use only.
• Do not touch the tip of the dropper to any surface to avoid contamination.
• Avoid using if solution changes color or becomes cloudy.
• Store below 30°C, away from direct sunlight.

description.en:
• LUNGOTROPIUM 500µ/1ML INH.20/AMP is a medication used for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD
• Active ingredient: Each single dose unit contains 0.050 % w/v ipratropium bromide i.e. 500 micrograms in 2 ml.
• Indication: 
o For treatment of reversible bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). 
o When used concomitantly with other inhaler, for treatment of reversible airways obstruction as in acute and chronic asthma.
• Dose: as prescribed by the physician.
o Adults (including the elderly) and adolescents > 12 years of age: 250 - 500 micrograms (i.e. one vial of 250 micrograms in 1 ml or 1 vial of 500 micrograms in 2 ml) 3 to 4 times daily.
o Children 6 - 12 years of age: 250 micrograms (i.e. one vial of 250 micrograms in 1ml) up to a total daily dose of 1mg (4 vials).
o Children 0 – 5 years of age (for treatment of acute asthma only): 125 – 250 micrograms (i.e. half to one vial of 250 micrograms in 1 ml) up to a total daily dose of 1 mg (4 vials).
description.ar:
• أمبولات استنشاق LUNGOTROPIUM 500µ/1ML هو دواء يُستخدم لعلاج الانسداد الرئوي المزمن (COPD).
• المادة الفعالة: تحتوي كل وحدة جرعة فردية على 0.050٪ من بروميد الإبراتروبيوم، أي 500 ميكروجرام في 2 مل.
• دواعي الاستعمال:
- لمرض الانسداد الرئوي المزمن (COPD).
- استخدامه بالتزامن مع ادوية الاستشاق ، لعلاج انسداد الشعب الهوائية العكسي كما في الربو الحاد والمزمن.
• الجرعة:كما يصف الطبيب
البالغين (بما في ذلك كبار السن) والمراهقين أكبر من 12 عامًا: 250 - 500 ميكروجرام (أي قنينة واحدة من 250 ميكروجرام في 1 مل أو قنينة واحدة من 500 ميكروجرام في 2 مل) 3 إلى 4 مرات يوميًا.
الأطفال من 6 إلى 12 عامًا: 250 ميكروجرام (أي قنينة واحدة من 250 ميكروجرام في 1 مل) حتى جرعة يومية إجمالية 1 مجم (4 قنينات).
الأطفال من 0 إلى 5 سنوات (لعلاج الربو الحاد فقط): 125 - 250 ميكروجرام (أي نصف إلى قنينة واحدة من 250 ميكروجرام في 1 مل) حتى جرعة يومية إجمالية 1 مجم (4 قنينات).

description.en:
• CAPOTRIL® 25mg tablets are used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension).
• Each tablet contains 25mg of the active ingredient captopril.
• It is typically taken orally, with or without food, as directed by a healthcare provider.
• It is important to take CAPOTRIL® regularly as prescribed, even if you feel well.
• Possible side effects include dizziness, dry cough, low blood pressure, and kidney problems, among others. Consult your healthcare provider if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• CAPOTRIL® comes in a package of 20 tablets.
description.ar:
• تستخدم أقراص CAPOTRIL® 25 مجم لعلاج ارتفاع ضغط الدم.
• كل قرص يحتوي على 25 ملجم من المادة الفعالة كابتوبريل.
• يؤخذ عادة عن طريق الفم، مع أو بدون طعام ،حسب توجيهات الطبيب.
• من المهم تناول CAPOTRIL® بانتظام كما هو موصوف، حتى لو كنت تشعر بصحة جيدة.
• تشمل الآثار الجانبية المحتملة الدوخة، والسعال الجاف ، وانخفاض ضغط الدم ، ومشاكل الكلى ، من بين أمور أخرى. استشر الطبيب الخاص بك إذا واجهت أي أعراض مقلقة.
• كل عبوة تحتوي على 20 قرصًا.

description.en:
•  ABIMOL 500mg tablets are used for pain relief and fever reduction.
•Active ingredient: Paracetamol 500mg.
• Indication: Relief of mild to moderate pain such as headaches, muscle aches, arthritis, backache, toothaches, colds, and fever.
•  Dose: 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours, not exceeding 8 tablets in 24 hours, or as prescribed by the physician.
•  Consult your doctor before use in case of liver diseases.
description.ar:

description.en:
• SOFENACIN® 10mg tablets are used to treat symptoms associated with overactive bladder, including urinary urgency, frequency, and incontinence.
• Each tablet contains 10mg of the active ingredient solifenacin succinate.
• It is typically taken orally, with or without food, once daily as directed by a physician.
• Possible side effects include dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, and difficulty urinating, among others. Consult your physician if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• SOFENACIN® comes in a package of 20 tablets.
description.ar:
• أقراص سوفيناسين® 10 ملجم تستخدم لعلاج الأعراض المرتبطة بالمثانة النشطة بشكل زائد، بما في ذلك الحاجة الملحة للتبول، والتبول المتكرر، وعدم السيطرة على التبول.
• يحتوي كل قرص على 10 ملجم من المادة الفعالة سوليفيناسين سوكسينات.
• يتم تناولها عادة عن طريق الفم، مع أو بدون طعام، مرة واحدة يوميًا كما يوصي بها الطبيب.
• من المهم تناول سوفيناسين® بانتظام حسب الوصفة الطبية، حتى إذا شعرت بالتحسن.
• من الممكن حدوث آثار جانبية مثل الجفاف في الفم، الإمساك، الرؤية الغائمة، وصعوبة التبول، وغيرها. يجب استشارة الطبيب في حالة حدوث أي أعراض مقلقة.
• العبوة تحتوي على 20 قرصًا.

description.en:

• Each tablet contains 750mg of the active ingredient levofloxacin.
• It is typically taken orally, with or without food, once a day as directed by a physician.
• Possible side effects include nausea, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, and trouble sleeping, among others. Consult your physician if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• Package of 5 tablets.
description.ar:

• العبوة تحتوي على 5 أقراص.

description.en:
• ATOREZA 10/20MG tablets are used to treat high cholesterol and reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke.
• Each tablet contains a combination of two active ingredients: atorvastatin 20mg and ezetimibe 10mg.
• ATOREZA is taken orally, with or without food, as directed by a physician.
• Possible side effects include headache, diarrhea, muscle pain, and elevated liver enzymes, among others. Consult your physician if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• ATOREZA comes in a package of 21 film-coated tablets.
• Some studies suggest that taking coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) supplements to alleviate muscle pain and weakness.

description.en:
• FEBURIC® 80mg tablets contain febuxostat and are used to treat gout.
• It works by reducing the amount of uric acid in the body, which can help prevent gout attacks.
• The usual dose is one tablet daily, with or without food or as directed by physician.
• It may take several weeks for FEBURIC® to start working, so it's important to continue taking it as prescribed.
• Common side effects may include nausea, rash, and liver function abnormalities. Consult your physician if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• FEBURIC® comes in a package of 30 tablets.

• قد تشمل الآثار الجانبية الشائعة الغثيان والطفح الجلدي واضطرابات وظيفة الكبد. استشر طبيبك إذا شعرت بأي أعراض قلقة.

description.en:
• DECONADAL® 10mg tablets contain the active ingredient rosuvastatin, which is used to lower cholesterol levels in the blood.
• It is typically taken orally, with or without food, once daily as directed by a healthcare provider.
• Possible side effects include muscle pain, weakness, and tenderness, liver problems, and an increased risk of diabetes, among others. Consult your healthcare provider if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• DECONADAL® comes in a package of 21 tablets.
• Some studies suggest that taking coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) supplements to alleviate muscle pain and weakness.
description.ar:
• أقراص ديكونادال® 10 ملغ تحتوي على المادة الفعالة روزوفاستاتين، التي تستخدم لخفض مستويات الكوليسترول في الدم.
• يتم تناولها عن طريق الفم، مع أو بدون الطعام، مرة واحدة يومياً حسب توجيهات الطبيب.
• من الآثار الجانبية المحتملة الآلام العضلية والضعف والحساسية، مشاكل في الكبد، وزيادة خطر الإصابة بمرض السكري، وغيرها. يُرجى استشارة مقدم الرعاية الصحية إذا شعرت بأي أعراض قلقة.

description.en:
• DROSPADIOL is a combined oral contraceptive pill used mainly to prevent pregnancy.
• Each tablet contains 3 mg of the hormone drospirenone and 0.03 mg of the hormone ethinyl estradiol.
• It is typically taken orally, once daily, for 21 consecutive days, followed by a 7-day break.
• It is important to take DROSPADIOL regularly as prescribed, at the same time each day, to maintain its effectiveness.
• Possible side effects include nausea, breast tenderness, headache, and breakthrough bleeding, among others. Consult your physician if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• DROSPADIOL comes in a package of 21 film-coated tablets.
description.ar:
• هي حبوب لمنع الحمل.
• يحتوي كل قرص على 3 ملجم من هرمون دروسبيرون و 0.03 ملجم من هرمون الإيثينيل استراديول.
• يتم تناولها عن طريق الفم، مرة واحدة يوميًا، لمدة 21 يومًا متتاليًا، تليها فترة راحة لمدة 7 أيام.
• من المهم تناول DROSPADIOL بانتظام كما هو موصوف، في نفس الوقت كل يوم، للحفاظ على فعاليتها.
• من الممكن حدوث آثار جانبية مثل الغثيان وألم بالثدي والصداع ، وغيرها. استشر طبيبك في حالة حدوث أي أعراض مقلقة.
• العبوة تحتوي على 21 قرصًا.

description.en:
• DIGLIFLOZ 5mg tablets are used to treat type 2 diabetes mellitus.
• Each tablet contains 5mg of the active ingredient dapagliflozin.
• It is typically taken orally, with or without food, as directed by a physician.
• It helps lower blood sugar levels by increasing the excretion of glucose through the kidneys.
• It is important to take DIGLIFLOZ regularly as prescribed and to follow a healthy diet and exercise regimen.
• Possible side effects include urinary tract infections, and increased urination, among others. Consult your physician if you experience any concerning symptoms.
• DIGLIFLOZ comes in a package of 30 film-coated tablets.
description.ar:

• يتم تناولها عن طريق الفم، مع أو بدون الطعام، وفقًا لتوجيهات الطبيب.
• يساعد في خفض مستويات السكر في الدم عن طريق زيادة اخراج الجلوكوز من خلال الكلى.
• من المهم تناول DIGLIFLOZ بانتظام كما هو موصوف واتباع نظام غذائي صحي وممارسة الرياضة.
• من الممكن حدوث آثار جانبية مثل التهابات الجهاز البولي، وزيادة التبول، وغيرها. استشر طبيبك في حالة حدوث أي أعراض مقلقة.

 ●ملحوظات هامة
-العديد من المضادات الحيوية يمكن أن تسبب الإسهال. إذا كان الإسهال شديدًا أو استمر لأكثر من يومين أو ثلاثة أيام، فاتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -يمكن للعديد من المضادات الحيوية أن تسبب حساسية، إذا كان هناك أي رد فعل تحسسي، اتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -لم يتم إثبات الأمان والفعالية في علاج الأطفال الذين تقل أعمارهم عن 6 أشهر.
 -يمكن تناول الدواء مع أو بدون الطعام.
 -عدم تناول مضادات الحموضة المحتوية على الألمنيوم والمغنيسيوم والأزيثروميسين في وقت واحد.
 -اتبع تعليمات طبيبك الخاص لتحديد جرعة ومدة الدواء.

description.en: Neutrogena Bright Boost Gel Cream is a specially formulated lightweight, non-greasy gel cream that gives your skin a fresh start! It is powered with Neoglucosamine, a prestige ingredient that is scientifically proven to make the skin brighter, smoother and more even. Neutrogena Bright Boost Gel Cream helps activate the skin’s natural renewal process by 10X and reduces melanin production to improve the appearance of dark spots, uneven skin tone and fine lines. It also contains AHA and PHA to promote gentle exfoliation, getting rid of dull and tired cells. By activating the surface skin cells natural turnover, this gel cream helps to reveal a brighter, more radiant even skin tone. Neutrogena Bright Boost Gel Cream is suitable for all skin tones and all skin types.

description.en:
• Delayed release capsules contain: duloxetine hydrochloride 60mg.
• Indication:
- Major Depressive Disorder.
- Generalized Anxiety Disorder.
- Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathic Pain.
- Fibromyalgia.
- Chronic Musculoskeletal Pain 
• Dose: as directed by the physician.
• It should be swallowed whole and should not be chewed or crushed, nor should the capsule be opened and its contents sprinkled on food or mixed with liquids.
• Contraindications: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors and Uncontrolled Narrow-Angle Glaucoma
• Warnings and precautions:
o Clinical Worsening and Suicide Risk.
o Hepatotoxicity.
o Orthostatic Hypotension and Syncope.
o Serotonin Syndrome or Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)-like Reactions.
o Abnormal Bleeding.
o Activation of Mania/Hypomania.
o Seizures.
o Hyponatremia.
o Urinary Hesitation and Retention.

description.en:
• Tablets contain: Rosuvastatin 5 mg.
• Indication:
- Hyperlipidemia and Mixed Dyslipidemia.
- Pediatric Patients with Familial Hypercholesterolemia.
- Hypertriglyceridemia.
- Primary Dysbetalipoproteinemia (Type III Hyperlipoproteinemia). 
- Adult Patients with Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia.
- Slowing of the Progression of Atherosclerosis.
- Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease.
• Dose: 
- Recommended dose in adults is 5 to 40 mg orally once daily. 
- The usual starting dose is 10 to 20 mg once daily. 
- The usual starting dose in adult patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia is 20 mg once daily. 
- The maximum dose of 40 mg should be used only for those patients who have not achieved their LDL-C goal utilizing the 20 mg dose.
- It can be administered as a single dose at any time of day, with or without food. 
- The tablet should be swallowed whole.
- The recommended dose in pediatrics is 5 to 10 mg orally once daily in patients 8 to less than 10 years of age, and 5 to 20 mg orally once daily in patients 10 to 17 years of age. 
- In homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, the recommended dose is 20 mg orally once daily in patients 7 to 17 years of age.
• Contraindication:
- Patients with a known hypersensitivity to any component of this product.
- Patients with active liver disease.
- Pregnancy.
- Lactation.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Bisoprolol Hypertension: Treatment of hypertension, alone or in combination with other agents
Guideline recommendations:
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC8 [James, 2013]):
• Patients ≥60 years of age, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <150 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension: Regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general nonblack population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Coronary artery disease (CAD) and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) recommends the use of a beta blocker as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina with a history of prior MI. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents

Bone or joint infections: Treatment of bone or joint infections caused by S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing strains), Streptococcus species (including Streptococcus pyogenes), Pseudomonas species (including Pseudomonas aeruginosa), and Proteus mirabilis.
CNS infections: Treatment of CNS infections (eg, meningitis, ventriculitis) caused by Neisseria meningitidis, Haemophilus influenzae, S. pneumoniae, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and E. coli.
Genitourinary infections: Treatment of genitourinary infections, including urinary tract infections (UTIs), caused by Enterococcus species, Staphylococcus epidermidis, S. aureus(penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), Citrobacter species, Enterobacter species, E. coli, Klebsiella species, P. mirabilis, Proteus vulgaris, Providencia stuartii, Morganella morganii, Providencia rettgeri, S. marcescens, and Pseudomonas species (including P. aeruginosa). Also, uncomplicated gonorrhea (cervical/urethral and rectal) caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, including penicillinase-producing strains. Note: CDC STD guidelines do not recommend cefotaxime as a treatment option for uncomplicated gonorrhea; ceftriaxone is the preferred cephalosporin (CDC [Workowski 2015]).
Gynecologic infections: Treatment of gynecologic infections, including pelvic inflammatory disease, endometritis, and pelvic cellulitis, caused by S. epidermidis, Streptococcusspecies, Enterococcus species, Enterobacter species, Klebsiella species, E. coli, P. mirabilis, Bacteroides species (including Bacteroides fragilis), Clostridium species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcus and Peptococcus species) and Fusobacterium species (including Fusobacterium nucleatum).
Intra-abdominal infections: Treatment of intra-abdominal infections, including peritonitis caused by Streptococcus species, E. coli, Klebsiella species, Bacteroides species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcus species and Peptococcus species), P. mirabilis, and Clostridium species.
Lower respiratory tract infections: Treatment of lower respiratory tract infections, including pneumonia, caused by S. pneumoniae, S. pyogenes (group A streptococci) and other streptococci (excluding enterococci, [eg, Enterococcus faecalis]), S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), E. coli, Klebsiella species, H. influenzae (including ampicillin-resistant strains), H. parainfluenzae, P. mirabilis, S. marcescens, Enterobacter species, and indole-positive Proteus and Pseudomonas species (including P. aeruginosa).
Skin and skin structure infections: Treatment of skin and skin structure infections caused by S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), S. epidermidis, S. pyogenes(group A streptococci) and other streptococci, Enterococcus species, Acinetobacter species, E. coli, Citrobacter species (including Citrobacter freundii), Enterobacter species, Klebsiella species, P. mirabilis, P. vulgaris, M. morganii, P. rettgeri, Pseudomonas species, S. marcescens, Bacteroides species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcusspecies and Peptococcus species).
Surgical prophylaxis: Reduce the incidence of certain infections in patients undergoing surgical procedures (eg, abdominal or vaginal hysterectomy, GI and GU tract surgery) that may be classified as contaminated or potentially contaminated; reduce the incidence of certain postoperative infections in patients undergoing cesarean section.

description.en:
GYNOTRAZONAGEN 600MG VAGINAL OVULES are used for the local treatment of vaginal fungal infections (such as candidiasis).
They help eliminate the infection and relieve symptoms like itching, redness, and abnormal discharge.

Dosage and How to Use:
• Insert one vaginal ovule (600 mg) deeply into the vagina, preferably at bedtime, as a single dose or as prescribed by your doctor.
• Wash hands thoroughly before and after use.
• Complete the full course of treatment as directed, even if symptoms improve.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
• Discontinue use if irritation or sensitivity occurs.

Active Ingredient:
• Isoconazole 600 mg

XANTHISTOP 80MG TABLETS are used for the treatment of hyperuricemia (high levels of uric acid in the blood) in patients with gout. It helps in preventing the formation of urate crystals and gout flares.

How to Use and Dosage:
• As prescribed by the physician.
• Swallow the tablet whole with water, with or without food.
• Regular monitoring of uric acid levels is recommended during treatment.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Use with caution in patients with severe liver or kidney impairment, or those with a history of cardiovascular conditions.
• If symptoms persist or worsen, consult a healthcare professional.
• If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, unless it is close to the next dose. Do not double doses.

description.en:
KETOPREK capsules contain ketoprofen, an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties.
• Used to relieve signs and symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, and for management of mild to moderate pain.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults: Typical initial dose is 75 mg three times daily.maximum recommended daily dose is 300 mg.
• Use with food or milk to reduce gastrointestinal side effects.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Increased risk of serious cardiovascular thrombotic events (heart attack, stroke), especially with prolonged use or in patients with existing cardiovascular disease or risk factors.
• Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to ketoprofen or other NSAIDs, history of asthma, urticaria, or allergic reactions triggered by NSAIDs or aspirin.
• Increased risk of serious gastrointestinal adverse events including bleeding, ulceration, and perforation; elderly patients and those with prior GI events are at higher risk.
• Avoid during late pregnancy (after 20 weeks gestation) due to risk of fetal harm.

Active Ingredient:
• Ketoprofen 75 mg per capsule.

description.en:
RIGHT FREEZE GEL is a topical cooling gel designed to relieve muscle and joint pain. It provides a soothing cooling effect that helps reduce discomfort from strains, sprains, and minor injuries. Suitable for external use to enhance muscle relaxation and ease soreness.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Apply a thin layer of the gel to the affected area 2–3 times daily or as needed.
• Gently massage until fully absorbed.
• Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For external use only.
• Do not apply to broken or irritated skin.
• Avoid contact with eyes, mucous membranes, and sensitive areas.

description.en:
ALLERGICASONE (125µ+50µ) 140 DOSE NASAL SPRAY is designed to provide relief from symptoms of allergic rhinitis, such as nasal congestion, sneezing, and itching. The dual-action formula targets both histamine release and inflammation.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Shake well before use.
• Do not exceed 2 sprays per nostril in 24 hours.
• Administer one spray in each nostril twice daily or as directed by a physician.
• Avoid spraying into the eyes or mouth.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For intranasal use only.
• Consult a physician before use if pregnant, breastfeeding, or if you have any medical conditions.
• Keep out of reach of children .

Active Ingredients:
• Azelastine (Antihistamine)
• Fluticasone Propionate (Corticosteroid) .
description.ar:
اليرجيكازون 125/50 ميكروجرام بخاخ أنفي مزدوج المفعول يُستخدم لعلاج أعراض التهاب الأنف التحسسي مثل احتقان الأنف، العطس، والحكة. 

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعة:
• يُرج جيدًا قبل الاستخدام.
• يُستخدم بخة واحدة في كل فتحة أنف مرتين يوميًا أو حسب إرشادات الطبيب.
• لا تتجاوز بختين في كل فتحة أنف خلال 24 ساعة.
• تجنّب ملامسة العينين أو الفم أثناء الاستخدام.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• للاستخدام داخل الأنف فقط.
• يُستشار الطبيب قبل الاستخدام في حال الحمل، الرضاعة، أو وجود أمراض مزمنة.
• يُحفظ بعيدًا عن متناول الأطفال.

المكونات الفعالة:
• أزيلستين (مضاد هيستامين)
• فلوتيكازون بروبيونات (كورتيكوستيرويد)

description.en:
Dermovate Ointment is a topical corticosteroid used for the treatment of severe inflammatory skin disorders. It helps reduce symptoms such as redness, itching, swelling, and irritation associated with various conditions like eczema, psoriasis, and lupus erythematosus. 

How to use:
• Apply a thin layer to the affected area once or twice daily
• Gently rub into the skin until fully absorbed
• Do not use on the face for prolonged periods

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not apply to broken or infected skin
• Avoid prolonged use, especially under occlusion
• Not recommended for children under 1 year

Active Ingredient:
• Clobetasol Propionate 0.05%

ديرموفيت مرهم هو كورتيزون موضعي يُستخدم لعلاج الأمراض الجلدية الالتهابية الشديدة. يساعد على تقليل الأعراض مثل الاحمرار، الحكة، التورم، والتهيج الناتج عن حالات مثل الإكزيما، الصدفية، والذئبة الحمراء الجلدية.

طريقة الاستخدام:
• يُوضع طبقة رقيقة على المنطقة المصابة مرة أو مرتين يوميًا

• لا يُستخدم لفترات طويلة على الوجه
• للاستخدام الخارجي فقط

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:

description.en:
FLUCA  EYE DROPS are used to treat eye inflammation caused by allergies, such as keratoconjunctivitis and allergic conjunctivitis, and to relieve associated symptoms including eye irritation, redness, and itching.

How to use:
• Instill 1–2 drops into the affected eye two to four times daily.
• The dose should be gradually reduced based on the response or as prescribed by the physician.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For external use only.
• Avoid contact of the dropper tip with any surface to prevent contamination.
• Use with caution in patients with glaucoma or a history of elevated intraocular pressure.
• Discontinue use if signs of infection appear.
• Do not use for prolonged periods without medical supervision.
• Do not use while wearing contact lenses.

Active Ingredients: Fluorometholone 0.1% - Sodium Cromoglycate 2%
description.ar:

• توضع 1–2 نقطة في العين المصابة من مرتين إلى أربع مرات يوميًا

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Amoxicillin+Clavulanic Acid Pneumonia, community-acquired: Extended-release tablets only: Treatment of patients with community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) caused by confirmed or suspected beta-lactamase-producing pathogens (ie, Haemophilus influenzae, Moraxella catarrhalis, Haemophilus parainfluenzae, Klebsiella pneumoniae, methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus) and Streptococcus pneumoniae with reduced susceptibility to penicillin (penicillin minimum inhibitory concentration [MIC] = 2 mcg/mL).
Limitations of use: Augmentin XR is not indicated for the treatment of infections caused by S. pneumoniae with penicillin MIC of 4 mcg/mL or greater (limited data).
Otitis media, acute:
Immediate-release tablets, chewable tablets, oral suspension (400/57 mg per 5 mL, 250/62.5 mg per 5 mL, 200/28.5 mg per 5 mL, and 125/31.25 mg per 5 mL only): Treatment of otitis media caused by beta-lactamase-producing strains of H. influenzae and M. catarrhalis.
Oral suspension (600/42.9 mg per 5 mL concentration): Treatment of acute otitis media, recurrent or persistent, caused by S. pneumoniae (penicillin MIC = 2 mcg/mL or less), H. influenzae (including beta-lactamase-producing strains), and M. catarrhalis (including beta-lactamase-producing strains) in pediatric patients with a history of antibiotic exposure for acute otitis media in the preceding 3 months and who are either 2 years or younger or attend day care; treatment of otitis media caused by beta-lactamase-producing strains of H. influenzae and M. catarrhalis.
Respiratory tract infections, lower: Immediate-release tablets, chewable tablets, oral suspension (400/57 mg per 5 mL, 250/62.5 mg per 5 mL, 200/28.5 mg per 5 mL, and 125/31.25 mg per 5 mL only): Treatment of lower respiratory tract infection caused by beta-lactamase-producing strains of H. influenzae and M. catarrhalis.
Sinusitis, acute bacterial:
Extended-release tablets: Treatment of patients with acute bacterial sinusitis caused by confirmed or suspected beta-lactamase-producing pathogens (ie, H. influenzae, M. catarrhalis, H. parainfluenzae, K. pneumoniae, methicillin-susceptible S. aureus) and S. pneumoniae with reduced susceptibility to penicillin (penicillin MIC = 2 mcg/mL).
Limitations of use: Augmentin XR is not indicated for the treatment of infections caused by S. pneumoniae with penicillin MIC of 4 mcg/mL or greater (limited data).
Immediate-release tablets, chewable tablets, oral suspension (400/57 mg per 5 mL, 250/62.5 mg per 5 mL, 200/28.5 mg per 5 mL, and 125/31.25 mg per 5 mL only): Treatment of sinusitis caused by beta-lactamase-producing strains of H. influenzae and M. catarrhalis.
Skin and skin structure infections: Immediate-release tablets, chewable tablets, oral suspension (400/57 mg per 5 mL, 250/62.5 mg per 5 mL, 200/28.5 mg per 5 mL, and 125/31.25 mg per 5 mL only): Treatment of skin and skin structure infections caused by beta-lactamase-producing strains of S. aureus, Escherichia coli, and Klebsiella spp.
Urinary tract infections: Immediate-release tablets, chewable tablets, oral suspension (400/57 mg per 5 mL, 250/62.5 mg per 5 mL, 200/28.5 mg per 5 mL, and 125/31.25 mg per 5 mL only): Treatment of urinary tract infections caused by beta-lactamase-producing strains of E. coli, Klebsiella spp, and Enterobacter spp.

description.ar:

description.en:
MOBITIL 15MG AMPOULES is a potent nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used for the short-term symptomatic treatment of acute exacerbations of inflammatory rheumatism. It has anti-inflammatory, anti-rheumatic, and analgesic properties.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Administered via intramuscular injection.
• Follow the dosage and administration instructions provided by a healthcare professional.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Avoid use in patients with hypersensitivity to Meloxicam or other NSAIDs.
• Contraindicated in cases of bleeding disorders, severe liver or kidney impairment, and during the last trimester of pregnancy.

Active Ingredient:
• Meloxicam 15 mg per 1.5 ml ampoule.
description.ar:
موبيتيل 15 مجم أمبولات هو دواء مضاد للالتهاب و مسكن قوي يُستخدم لعلاج الأعراض الحادة لنوبات الالتهاب الروماتويدي المزمن كفترة علاج قصيرة الأمد. يتميز بخواص مضادة للالتهاب، مضادة للروماتيزم، ومسكنة للألم، مما يجعله فعالًا في تقليل التورم والآلام المصاحبة لحالات الالتهاب المفصلي.

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعة:
• يُعطى عن طريق الحقن العضلي فقط.
• يجب اتباع تعليمات الطبيب المختص بدقة فيما يخص الجرعة وطريقة الإعطاء.
• لا تتجاوز الجرعة المحددة أو مدة العلاج التي يحددها الطبيب لتجنب المضاعفات.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• لا يُستخدم في الحالات التي تعاني من اضطرابات النزيف أو القصور الشديد في وظائف الكبد أو الكلى.
• يُمنع استخدامه خلال الثلث الأخير من الحمل بسبب خطورة التأثير على الجنين.

المادة الفعالة:
• ميلوكسيكام 15 مجم لكل أمبول سعة 1.5 مل

description.en:
• Mucosol 375mg 20 Capsules is used to treat respiratory conditions associated with excessive mucus. 
• Active ingredient: Carbocisteine 375mg. 
• Indication: Helps to reduce and thin mucus in respiratory tract conditions such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), bronchitis, and asthma. 
• Dose: The usual adult dose is (1 capsule) twice daily after meals, or as directed by the physician.
description.ar:
• ميوكوسول 375 مجم 20 كبسولة يُستخدم لعلاج حالات الجهاز التنفسى المصحوبة بزيادة المخاط. 
• المادة الفعالة: كاربوسيستين 375 مجم. 
• الاستخدام: يساعد في تقليل وتخفيف المخاط (البلغم) في حالات الجهاز التنفسي مثل مرض الانسداد الرئوي المزمن، التهاب الشعب الهوائية، والربو. 
• الجرعة: الجرعة المعتادة للبالغين هي (كبسولة واحدة) مرتين يوميا بعد الأكل أو حسب توجيهات الطبيب.

description.en:
• MUCOTEC 300mg  is a mucolytic medication that helps dissolve and loosen mucus to facilitate its expulsion. It is indicated for respiratory conditions characterized by excessive mucus production, such as acute and chronic bronchitis and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

How to use:
• Adults: One capsule (300 mg) twice daily or as prescribed by the physician

Warnings and precautions:
• Use with caution in patients with gastric or duodenal ulcers
• Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless advised by a doctor
• Discontinue if signs of hypersensitivity appear

Active ingredient:
• Erdosteine 300 mg per capsule
description.ar:
ميوكوتك 300 مجم هو مذيب للبلغم و يساعد على تسهيل خروجه، ويُستخدم في حالات أمراض الجهاز التنفسي المصحوبة بإفرازات مخاطية زائدة مثل التهاب الشعب الهوائية الحاد والمزمن - مرض الانسداد الرئوي المزمن (COPD).


طريقة الاستخدام:

description.en:
POLYDERM 20GM CREAM is used for the treatment of bacterial and fungal skin infections. It helps reduce inflammation, redness, and suitable for managing conditions such as impetigo, infected eczema, and other inflammatory skin conditions.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Apply a thin layer of Polyderm Cream to the affected area 2-3 times daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional.
• Wash and dry the affected area before application.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Prolonged use may lead to skin thinning or other side effects associated with corticosteroids.
• If symptoms persist or worsen, consult a healthcare professional.
• Avoid contact with eyes, nose, or mouth.

Active Ingredients:
• Beclomethasone Dipropionate Anhydrous 0.025%.
 Miconazole Nitrate 2.0%.
 Neomycin Sulphate 0.5% .
description.ar:

• القوباء (هي عدوى جلدية بكتيرية مُعدية تسبب تقرحات وقشورًا صفراء وتنتشر غالبًا بين الأطفال)

description.en:
RECOXIBRIGHT 120MG TABLETS is a selective COX-2 inhibitor used in adults and adolescents to relieve pain and inflammation caused by osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, acute gout, and dental surgery.

How to use:
• As prescribed by the physician.
• For acute gout: 120 mg once daily for up to 8 days.
• May be taken with or without food.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Not for use in active ulcers, severe liver/kidney disease, pregnancy or breastfeeding.
• Use with caution in heart disease, hypertension, or elderly.
• May cause dizziness.

Active Ingredient:
• Etoricoxib

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• يُمنع في حالات قرحة المعدة النشطة، الفشل الكبدي أو الكلوي الشديد، الحمل والرضاعة.
• يُستخدم بحذر في أمراض القلب، ارتفاع الضغط أو مع كبار السن.
• قد يسبب دوخة.

How to Use & Dosage:
• < 3 years: 2.5 ml, 3–4 times/day
• 3–6 years: 5 ml, 3–4 times/day
• 7–9 years: 7.5 ml, 3–4 times/day
• ≥ 10 years: 10–15 ml, 3–4 times/day
• Shake well before use.

Warnings & Precautions:
• Contraindicated in active peptic ulcer disease, severe heart failure, or known NSAID hypersensitivity.
• Use with caution in renal or hepatic impairment; avoid other NSAIDs, anticoagulants, and alcohol.
• Not recommended in late pregnancy; keep out of reach of children.

• Ibuprofen: 100 mg per 5 ml

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 500mg

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Adults:
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Exacerbations Of Chronic Bronchitis (Mild To Moderate): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5 Or 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis: 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Genital Ulcer Disease (Chancroid)
Non-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 1 Gram Dose
-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 2 Gram Dose

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Geriatric Use: Elderly Patients May Be More Susceptible To Development Of Torsades De Pointes Arrhythmia.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Amlodipine Coronary artery disease (CAD):
Chronic stable angina: Treatment of symptomatic chronic stable angina. May be used alone or in combination with other antianginal agents.
Vasospastic angina (Prinzmetal or variant angina): Treatment of confirmed or suspected vasospastic angina. May be used alone or in combination with other antianginal agents.
Angiographically documented CAD: Reduce the risk of hospitalization secondary to angina and to reduce the risk of a coronary revascularization procedure in patients with recently documented CAD by angiography (without heart failure or an ejection fraction of <40%).
The ACCF/AHA 2013 guidelines for management of heart failure state that, with the exception of amlodipine, calcium channel blockers should be avoided and withdrawn whenever possible in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). While amlodipine, like other calcium channel blockers, has no benefit on functioning or survival, it may be used for the treatment of hypertension or ischemic heart disease in patients with HFrEF (ACCF/AHA [Yancy 2013]).
Hypertension: Treatment of hypertension. May be used alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents.
Guideline recommendations:
The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (JNC 8) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC8 [James 2013]):
• Patients ≥60 years, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension: In patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general nonblack population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines suggest that for patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, thiazide-like diuretics, dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ramipril Heart failure post-myocardial infarction: Treatment of heart failure (HF) after myocardial infarction (MI).
Hypertension: Management of hypertension (monotherapy or in combination with thiazide diuretics).
Reduction in risk of MI, stroke, and death from cardiovascular causes: To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and death in patients ≥55 years at high risk of developing major cardiovascular events.
Guideline recommendations:
Heart failure: The 2013 American College of Cardiology Foundation/American Heart Association (ACCF/AHA) heart failure guidelines recommend the use of ACE inhibitors, along with other guideline-directed medical therapies, to prevent HF in patients with a reduced ejection fraction who have a history of MI (stage B HF), to prevent HF in any patient with a reduced ejection fraction (stage B HF), or to treat those with HF and reduced ejection fraction (stage C HFrEF) (Yancy 2013)
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients:
• Patients ≥60 years of age with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥ 90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP is ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Coronary artery disease (CAD) and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with CAD recommends the use of an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina if there is prior MI, LV systolic dysfunction, diabetes mellitus, or CKD. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents (AHA/ACC/ASH [Rosendorff 2015]).
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines recommend an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) for patients with HTN and diabetes with albuminuria (urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio [UACR] ≥30 mg/g). For patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, thiazide-like diuretics, or dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).
STEMI: The 2013 ACCF/AHA guidelines for the management of patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) state that an ACE inhibitor should be initiated within the first 24 hours after STEMI in patients with anterior MI, heart failure, or left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤0.4. It is also reasonable to initiate an ACE inhibitor in all patients with STEMI (O'Gara 2013).

STEMI: The 2013 ACCF/AHA guidelines for the management of patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) state that an ACE inhibitor should be initiated within the first 24 hours after STEMI in patients with anterior MI, heart failure, or left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤0.4. It is also reasonable to initiate an ACE inhibitor in all patients with STEMI (O'Gara 2013).

description.en:
Pantoprazole
 
●Concentration: 40 milligram Tablet
●Uses and Indication
Peptic and Duodenal ulcer
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
Heart burn
Adjuvant therapy in Treatment of H. pylori infection
Long-term treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, multiple endocrine adenomas and systemic mastocytosis
●Mode of action
Esomeprazole belongs to a class of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors (PPIs) that reduce stomach acid production
●Dosage and administration
Adult dose: used on empty stomach one hour before breakfast but maybe used twice daily not more than 2 months
Children dose : ages between 1-16 years may take a dose 5-20 Milligram/day prescribed by the physician
●Precautions
consult your physician or the pharmacist if you take another medications especially for chronic diseases
Long time use may lead to long-term inflammation of the stomach called atrophic gastritis

description.en:
LOPRECOUGH Syrup is an oral formula that combines N-acetylcysteine with chlorpheniramine maleate. It works on thinning mucus in the airways, making it easier to expel while simultaneously alleviating symptoms of allergy such as sneezing, runny nose, and nasal congestion. It is especially helpful in cases of wet cough associated with cold, flu, bronchitis, or other upper respiratory tract infections.

How to use:
• Children 3–6 years: 5 ml, 3 times daily
• Children 6–12 years: 5–10 ml, 3 times daily
• Adults and children over 12 years: 10 ml, 3 times daily
• Use under medical supervision for children under 6 years

Warnings and Precautions:
• Not suitable for children under 3 years
• Use with caution in cases of asthma, glaucoma, heart disease, or peptic ulcer
• May cause drowsiness – avoid driving or operating machinery
• Consult your doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding

Active Ingredients (per 5 ml):
• N-acetylcysteine 100 mg
• Chlorpheniramine maleate 2 mg

ALERGOLIBER 10MG 20 FILM COATED TABLETr is a non-sedating antihistamine used to treat allergic rhinitis, urticaria, and other allergy symptoms such as sneezing, itching, and redness. It works by blocking the effects of histamine in the body.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults and children over 12 years: 1 tablet (10 mg) once daily, preferably at night after food.
• Follow your physician's instructions for the best results.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Avoid using if you are allergic to Rupatadine or any of its components.
• Consult your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking other medications.
• May cause mild side effects like somnolence, headache, or fatigue.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ramipril Heart failure post-myocardial infarction: Treatment of heart failure (HF) after myocardial infarction (MI).
Hypertension: Management of hypertension (monotherapy or in combination with thiazide diuretics).
Reduction in risk of MI, stroke, and death from cardiovascular causes: To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and death in patients ≥55 years at high risk of developing major cardiovascular events.
Guideline recommendations:
Heart failure: The 2013 American College of Cardiology Foundation/American Heart Association (ACCF/AHA) heart failure guidelines recommend the use of ACE inhibitors, along with other guideline-directed medical therapies, to prevent HF in patients with a reduced ejection fraction who have a history of MI (stage B HF), to prevent HF in any patient with a reduced ejection fraction (stage B HF), or to treat those with HF and reduced ejection fraction (stage C HFrEF) (Yancy 2013)
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients:
• Patients ≥60 years of age with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥ 90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP is ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Coronary artery disease (CAD) and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with CAD recommends the use of an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina if there is prior MI, LV systolic dysfunction, diabetes mellitus, or CKD. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents (AHA/ACC/ASH [Rosendorff 2015]).
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines recommend an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) for patients with HTN and diabetes with albuminuria (urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio [UACR] ≥30 mg/g). For patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, thiazide-like diuretics, or dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).
STEMI: The 2013 ACCF/AHA guidelines for the management of patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) state that an ACE inhibitor should be initiated within the first 24 hours after STEMI in patients with anterior MI, heart failure, or left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤0.4. It is also reasonable to initiate an ACE inhibitor in all patients with STEMI (O'Gara 2013).

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Cefotaxime Bacteremia/Septicemia: Treatment of bacteremia/septicemia caused by Escherichia coli, Klebsiella species, and Serratia marcescens, Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcusspecies (including Streptococcus pneumoniae).
Bone or joint infections: Treatment of bone or joint infections caused by S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing strains), Streptococcus species (including Streptococcus pyogenes), Pseudomonas species (including Pseudomonas aeruginosa), and Proteus mirabilis.
CNS infections: Treatment of CNS infections (eg, meningitis, ventriculitis) caused by Neisseria meningitidis, Haemophilus influenzae, S. pneumoniae, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and E. coli.
Genitourinary infections: Treatment of genitourinary infections, including urinary tract infections (UTIs), caused by Enterococcus species, Staphylococcus epidermidis, S. aureus(penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), Citrobacter species, Enterobacter species, E. coli, Klebsiella species, P. mirabilis, Proteus vulgaris, Providencia stuartii, Morganella morganii, Providencia rettgeri, S. marcescens, and Pseudomonas species (including P. aeruginosa). Also, uncomplicated gonorrhea (cervical/urethral and rectal) caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, including penicillinase-producing strains. Note: CDC STD guidelines do not recommend cefotaxime as a treatment option for uncomplicated gonorrhea; ceftriaxone is the preferred cephalosporin (CDC [Workowski 2015]).
Gynecologic infections: Treatment of gynecologic infections, including pelvic inflammatory disease, endometritis, and pelvic cellulitis, caused by S. epidermidis, Streptococcusspecies, Enterococcus species, Enterobacter species, Klebsiella species, E. coli, P. mirabilis, Bacteroides species (including Bacteroides fragilis), Clostridium species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcus and Peptococcus species) and Fusobacterium species (including Fusobacterium nucleatum).
Intra-abdominal infections: Treatment of intra-abdominal infections, including peritonitis caused by Streptococcus species, E. coli, Klebsiella species, Bacteroides species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcus species and Peptococcus species), P. mirabilis, and Clostridium species.
Lower respiratory tract infections: Treatment of lower respiratory tract infections, including pneumonia, caused by S. pneumoniae, S. pyogenes (group A streptococci) and other streptococci (excluding enterococci, [eg, Enterococcus faecalis]), S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), E. coli, Klebsiella species, H. influenzae (including ampicillin-resistant strains), H. parainfluenzae, P. mirabilis, S. marcescens, Enterobacter species, and indole-positive Proteus and Pseudomonas species (including P. aeruginosa).
Skin and skin structure infections: Treatment of skin and skin structure infections caused by S. aureus (penicillinase and nonpenicillinase producing), S. epidermidis, S. pyogenes(group A streptococci) and other streptococci, Enterococcus species, Acinetobacter species, E. coli, Citrobacter species (including Citrobacter freundii), Enterobacter species, Klebsiella species, P. mirabilis, P. vulgaris, M. morganii, P. rettgeri, Pseudomonas species, S. marcescens, Bacteroides species, and anaerobic cocci (including Peptostreptococcusspecies and Peptococcus species).
Surgical prophylaxis: Reduce the incidence of certain infections in patients undergoing surgical procedures (eg, abdominal or vaginal hysterectomy, GI and GU tract surgery) that may be classified as contaminated or potentially contaminated; reduce the incidence of certain postoperative infections in patients undergoing cesarean section.

Active Ingredient: Fluticasone Nasal
Rx products:
Allergic rhinitis (Veramyst, Avamys [Canadian product], Flonase [Canadian product]): Management of seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis in adults and children ≥2 years of age (Veramyst, Avamys) and in patients 4 to 17 years of age (Flonase)
Nasal polyps (Xhance): Treatment of nasal polyps in patients ≥18 years of age
Nonallergic rhinitis (Flonase): Management of the nasal symptoms of perennial nonallergic rhinitis in adults and pediatric patients ≥4 years of age
OTC products:
Upper respiratory allergies: Relief of hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies (eg, itchy and watery eyes, nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, itchy nose) in adults and children ≥4 years of age (Clarispray, Flonase Allergy Relief, Good Sense Nasoflow) or children ≥2 years of age (Flonase Sensimist)
Inhalation
Asthma:
ArmonAir Respiclick and Arnuity Ellipta: Maintenance treatment of asthma as prophylactic therapy in patients 12 years and older.
Flovent Diskus and Flovent HFA: Maintenance treatment of asthma as prophylactic therapy in patients 4 years and older.
Limitations of use: Not indicated for relief of acute bronchospasm.
Guideline recommendations: A low-dose inhaled corticosteroid (in addition to an as-needed short acting beta2-agonist) is the initial preferred long-term control medication for children, adolescents, and adult patients with persistent asthma who are candidates for treatment according to a step-wise treatment approach 
Topical
Dermatoses:
Lotion: For the relief of the inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of atopic dermatoses in patients 3 months of age or older.
Cream and ointment: For the relief of the inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses in patients 3 months of age or older. Ointment is indicated for use in adults only.

description.en:
ALGESAL SUREACTIVE CREAM is a topical treatment used to relieve muscle, joint, tendon, and nerve pain, as well as bruises, sprains, and strains. It helps reduce redness, swelling, and discomfort in the affected area.

How to use:
• Apply a thin layer of cream to the painful area up to 3 times daily.
• Massage gently until absorbed, then wash your hands.
• Do not use for more than 14 days without consulting a doctor.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not apply to open wounds, mucous membranes, or near eyes.
• Not recommended for children under 7 years of age.
• Discontinue if rash, irritation, or signs of hypersensitivity occur.
• Avoid use in patients with a history of seizures or asthma.

Active Ingredients:
• Diethylamine Salicylate 10%
• Myrtecaine (Nopoxamine) 1%

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Atorvastatin Dyslipidemias:
Dysbetalipoproteinemia: Treatment of primary dysbetalipoproteinemia (Fredrickson type III).
Heterozygous familial and nonfamilial hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia: To reduce elevated total cholesterol (total-C), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), apolipoprotein B (apo B), and triglyceride levels, and to increase HDL-C in patients with primary hypercholesterolemia (heterozygous familial and nonfamilial) and mixed dyslipidemia (Fredrickson type IIa and IIb).
Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C, LDL-C, and apo B levels in boys and postmenarche girls 10 to 17 years of age with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia with LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL, LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with positive family history of premature cardiovascular disease (CVD), or LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with two or more other CVD risk factors.
Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C and LDL-C in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia as an adjunct to other lipid-lowering treatments (eg, LDL apheresis) or if such treatments are unavailable.
Hypertriglyceridemia: Treatment of elevated serum triglyceride levels (Fredrickson type IV).
Limitations of use: Has not been studied in conditions where the major lipid abnormality is elevation of chylomicrons (Fredrickson types I and V).
Prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD):
Primary prevention of cardiovascular disease (high-risk for CVD): To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and revascularization procedures and angina in adult patients without clinically evident coronary heart disease (CHD) who have multiple CHD risk factors (eg, age, smoking, hypertension, low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol [HDL-C], family history of early CHD); to reduce the risk of MI and stroke in patients with type 2 diabetes and without clinically evident CHD but with multiple risk factors for CHD (eg, retinopathy, albuminuria, smoking, hypertension).
Secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease: To reduce the risk of nonfatal MI, fatal and nonfatal stroke, revascularization procedures, hospitalization for decompensated heart failure, and angina in patients with clinically evident CHD.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 500mg

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Adults:
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Exacerbations Of Chronic Bronchitis (Mild To Moderate): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5 Or 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis: 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Genital Ulcer Disease (Chancroid)
Non-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 1 Gram Dose
-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 2 Gram Dose

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Geriatric Use: Elderly Patients May Be More Susceptible To Development Of Torsades De Pointes Arrhythmia.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●الجرعة
للبالغين في حالات الاتهاب البكتيري التالية:
 -الالتهاب الرئوي (شدة خفيفة)
 التهاب القصبة الهوائية / التهاب اللوزتين
التهاب الجلد (غير معقد): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التفاقم البكتيري الحاد لالتهاب الشعب الهوائية المزمن (خفيف إلى متوسط): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام 2 إلى 5 أو 500 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا لمدة 3 أيام.
 -التهاب الجيوب الأنفية البكتيري الحاد: 500 مجم مرة واحدة يومياً لمدة 3 أيام.
 -مرض الالتهاب البكتيري التناسلي والتهاب عنق الرحم: جرعة واحدة 1 جرام.
 -التهاب عنق الرحم بالمكورات البنية (النَيْسَرِيّة البُنِّيّة): جرعة واحدة 2 جرام. 

●ملحوظات هامة
-العديد من المضادات الحيوية يمكن أن تسبب الإسهال. إذا كان الإسهال شديدًا أو استمر لأكثر من يومين أو ثلاثة أيام، فاتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -يمكن للعديد من المضادات الحيوية تفاعلات فرط الحساسية. إذا كان هناك أي رد فعل تحسسي لفرط الحساسية ، اتصل بطبيبك.

 -يمكن تنوال الدواء مع أو بدون الطعام.

 -اتبع تعليمات طبيبك الخاص لتحديد جرعة ومدة الدواء.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Carvedilol Hypertension: Management of hypertension.
The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC 8 [James, 2013]):
• Patients ≥60 years of age, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <150 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
In patients with CKD, regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general non-black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Heart failure: Mild to severe chronic heart failure of ischemic or cardiomyopathic origin (usually in addition to standard therapy [eg, diuretics, ACE inhibitors]).
The ACCF/AHA 2013 heart failure guidelines recommend the use of 1 of the 3 beta blockers (ie, bisoprolol, carvedilol, or extended-release metoprolol succinate) for all patients with recent or remote history of MI or ACS and reduced ejection fraction (rEF) to reduce mortality, for all patients with rEF to prevent symptomatic HF (even if no history of MI), and for all patients with current or prior symptoms of HF with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), unless contraindicated, to reduce morbidity and mortality (Yancy, 2013).
Left ventricular dysfunction following myocardial infarction (MI): Left ventricular dysfunction following MI (clinically stable with LVEF ≤40%)

• CETAL COLD & FLU 20Caplets is a medication used for the relief of symptoms of common cold & influenza. 
• Active ingredients: Paracetamol 500 mg, Pseudoephedrine hydrochloride 30 mg, Chlorpheniramine maleate 2 mg. 
• Indication: Used for the relief of symptoms of common cold & influenza such as fever, nasal congestion, sinus congestion, headache, sinus pain, sneezing, itchy and watery eye.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ciprofloxacin Systemic: Children and Adolescents: Treatment of complicated urinary tract infections and pyelonephritis due to E. coli. Note: Although effective, ciprofloxacin is not the drug of first choice in children.
Infants, Children, Adolescents, and Adults: Prophylaxis to reduce incidence or progression of disease following inhalation exposure to Bacillus anthracis; prophylaxis and treatment of plague (Yersinia pestis).
Adults: Treatment of the following infections when caused by susceptible bacteria: Urinary tract infections; acute uncomplicated cystitis in females, chronic bacterial prostatitis, bone and joint infections, complicated intra-abdominal infections (in combination with metronidazole), infectious diarrhea, typhoid fever (Salmonella typhi), hospital-acquired (nosocomial) pneumonia.
Limitations of use: Because fluoroquinolones have been associated with disabling and potentially irreversible serious adverse reactions (eg, tendinitis and tendon rupture, peripheral neuropathy, CNS effects), reserve ciprofloxacin for use in patients who have no alternative treatment options for acute uncomplicated cystitis.
Ophthalmic: Ocular infections:
Ointment: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Solution: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (corneal ulcers, conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Otic: Acute otitis externa (0.2% solution): Treatment of acute otitis externa caused by susceptible isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa or Staphylococcus aureus
Otitis media (6% suspension): Treatment of bilateral otitis media in pediatric patients with effusion undergoing tympanostomy tube placement

description.en:
• DAIVOBET 30gm Ointment is used as a treatment for plaque-type psoriasis vulgaris. 
• Active ingredients: Betamethasone (0.05% w/w) and Calcipotriol (0.005% w/w). 
• Indication: For the treatment of plaque psoriasis by providing relief from redness, itching, and swelling and decreasing the overproduction of skin cells.
• Dose: One fingertip unit completely cover the psoriasis plaques once a day (either morning or night). This medicine is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area and gently massage the ointment.

• المواد الفعالة: بيتاميثازون (0.05%) وكالسيبوتريول (0.005%).
• دواعى الاستعمال: لعلاج الصدفية (plaque psoriasis) من خلال تخفيف آلام الاحمرار، الحكة، والتورم، وتقليل فرط إنتاج خلايا الجلد.
• الجرعة: يتم وضع وحدة واحدة بحجم طرف الإصبع لتغطية مكان الصدفية بالكامل مرة واحدة يوميًا (إما في الصباح أو المساء). هذا الدواء للاستخدام الخارجي فقط. قم بتنظيف وتجفيف المنطقة المصابة ودلك المرهم بلطف.

description.en:
• EMOXCLAV 1gm tablet is a broad spectrum antibiotic used to treat variety of bacterial infections.
• Ingredients: 875 mg of Amoxicillin and 125 mg of Clavulanic acid (total concentration is 1 g).
• Indications: It is used to treat bacterial infections including sinusitis, pneumonia, ear infections, bronchitis, urinary tract infections, and infections of the skin.
• Dosage/Usage Instructions: The usual dose is one tablet every 12 hours or as directed by the physician.
• It is recommended to use it in the middle of food to avoid pain in the digestive system.

• المكونات: 875 مجم من الأموكسيسيلين و 125 مجم من حمض الكلافولانيك (التركيز الإجمالي 1 جم).
• الاستخدامات: يُستخدم لعلاج العدوى البكتيرية بما في ذلك التهاب الجيوب الأنفية، التهاب الرئة، التهابات الأذن، التهاب الشعب الهوائية، التهاب المسالك البولية، والعدوى الجلدية.
• الجرعة/تعليمات الاستخدام: الجرعة العادية هي قرص واحد كل 12 ساعة أو حسب إرشادات الطبيب.
• من المستحسن استخدامه في منتصف الوجبة لتجنب الألم في الجهاز الهضمي.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Amoxicillin+Clavulanic Acid 457mg/5ml

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic
 
●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose For Neonates And Children
25 mg/kg/day in mild to moderate infections
45 mg/kg/day for the treatment of more serious infections

-Note: Reconstitution For Suspensions  And Shake Vigorously To Suspend Powder.
-Shake Oral Suspension Well Before Using
-Once reconstituted, the suspension must be stored in a refrigerator (2°C to 8°C) and used within 7 days.

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

ملحوظات:
