description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Ceftriaxone 1gm

●Intramuscular

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Third Generation Cephalosporin Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose
For Adults:
1-Moderate And Severe Infections:
-1gm Or 2gm Every 24 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
-500mg Or 1g Every 12 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
2-Uncomplicated Gonorrhea:
250mg As A Single Dose Intramuscular.
*There Is Limited Experience With Daily Doses Of 3-4gm Administered As A Single Dose Or Two Equally Divided Doses.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4gm.
For Infants And Children (One Month To 12 Years Of Age):
1-Serious Miscellaneous Infections: 25 Or 37.5 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 2 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.
2-Meningitis: 50 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.

●Special Notes
-Hypersensitivity Test Must Be Made.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Dose To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Reconstitution Tips
-For Intramuscular Use: Solutions Should Be Reconstituted Immediately Before Use. If Storage Is Required, These Solutions May Be Stored Under Refrigeration(Between 2 And 8°C) And Should Be Used Within 48 Hours.
-For Intravenous Bolus Injection (Without Further Dilution): Reconstituted Solutions Should Be Administered Within 24 Hours When Stored At Room Temperature And Within 72 Hours When Refrigerated (Between 2 And 8°C).

●للحقن العضلي

مضاد للبكتريا مثبط لبناء الجدار الخلوي للبكتيريا

●الجرعة
للبالغين:
الالتهابات البكتيرية المتوسطة والشديدة:
1- 1 جم أو 2 جم كل 24 ساعة في العضل أو في الوريد.
2- 500 مجم أو 1 جم كل 12 ساعة فى العضل أو فى الوريد.
السيلان:
250 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في العضل.
* هناك جرعات يومية من 3-4 جم تعطى كجرعة وحيدة أو جرعتين مقسمتين بالتساوي وذلك لبعض الحالات بالرجوع للطبيب.
* يجب ألا تتجاوز الجرعة اليومية الإجمالية 4 جرام.
للرضع والأطفال (من شهر إلى 12 سنة):
1-حالات العدوى البكتيرية الخطيرة: 25 أو 37.5 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 2 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.
2-التهاب السحايا: 50 مجم / كجم كل 12 ساعة.
* يجب ألا تزيد الجرعة اليومية الكلية عن 4 جرام. إذا كان وزن الجسم 50 كجم أو أكثر ، يجب استخدام جرعة البالغين.

● ملاحظات هامة:
- يجب إجراء اختبار حساسية.
- اتبع تعليمات طبيبك حول الجرعة التي يجب استخدامها وأيام العلاج.

● ملحوظات تخص تحليل الحقنة:
- للاستخدام العضلي: يجب تحليل الحقنة مباشرة قبل الاستخدام. إذا كان التخزين مطلوبًا ، يمكن تخزين هذه المحاليل تحت التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات سيليزية) ويجب استخدامها في غضون 48 ساعة.
- بالنسبة للحقن الوريدي:يجب إعطاء الحقنة بعد تحليلها في غضون 24 ساعة عند تخزينها في درجة حرارة الغرفة وخلال 72 ساعة عند التبريد (بين 2 و 8 درجات مئوية).

description.en:
EXTRAUMA FORTE DNA 40GM GEL is an anti-traumatic and anti-inflammatory topical gel. used to treat contusions, distortions, muscular tears, traumatic hematomas, edema, erythema, and varicoses.

How to Use and Dosage:
• ِApply a thin layer of gel to the affected area 2-3 times daily.
• Massage gently until fully absorbed, then wash your hands.

Warnings and Precautions:
• ِAvoid contact with eyes, mucous membranes, or open wounds.
• ِFor external use only.
• Not to be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless specifically prescribed by a physician.



Active Ingredient:
• Recombinant Hirudin 420 IU per 100 grams.

• Avoid concomitant use with CNS depressants.

description.en:
FAST FREEZE MASSAGE SPRAY 200ML is a topical cooling spray for temporary relief of minor muscle and joint aches, including simple backache, arthritis, sprains, and strains. It provides rapid cooling and relaxation without leaving a greasy residue.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Shake well and spray on the affected area 3–4 times daily, holding the nozzle 15–20 cm away; gently massage until absorbed.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, mucous membranes, or open wounds.
• Flammable: Keep away from heat, sparks, open flames, and hot surfaces.
• Discontinue if skin irritation or hypersensitivity occurs.
• Store below 30 °C, away from direct sunlight and out of reach of children.

Active Ingredients:
• Menthol and Camphor.

description.en:
SPASCOLON 100 MG TABLETS are used for the symptomatic treatment of abdominal pain, transit disorders, and intestinal discomfort associated with functional bowel disorders. They help relax intestinal smooth muscles and reduce spasms and discomfort.

How to use:
• Adults: 2 tablets per day (1 tablet in the morning and 1 in the evening).
• Do not chew, suck, or take lying down or just before bedtime.

Warnings and Precautions:
• May cause esophageal irritation if taken incorrectly.
• Not to be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless absolutely necessary.
• Avoid in cases of lactase deficiency, galactose intolerance or malabsorption.
• Possible side effects: nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhea, rash,and urticaria.

Active Ingredient:
• Pinaverium bromide: 100 mg per tablet.

description.en:
TRECZIMUS OINTMENT is a topical ointment used to relieve inflammation and skin irritation in certain chronic skin conditions. It is commonly prescribed for patients who do not respond adequately to other topical treatments. The ointment helps calm the immune response in the skin and reduce redness, itching, and flare-ups in sensitive areas such as the face or folds.

How to use:
• Apply a thin layer to the affected area twice daily (morning and evening)
• Wash hands before and after application

Warnings and Precautions:
• Avoid exposure to sunlight during use
• Do not apply to infected, broken, or irritated skin
• Use only as prescribed by your doctor

Active Ingredient:
• Tacrolimus Monohydrate

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ramipril Heart failure post-myocardial infarction: Treatment of heart failure (HF) after myocardial infarction (MI).
Hypertension: Management of hypertension (monotherapy or in combination with thiazide diuretics).
Reduction in risk of MI, stroke, and death from cardiovascular causes: To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and death in patients ≥55 years at high risk of developing major cardiovascular events.
Guideline recommendations:
Heart failure: The 2013 American College of Cardiology Foundation/American Heart Association (ACCF/AHA) heart failure guidelines recommend the use of ACE inhibitors, along with other guideline-directed medical therapies, to prevent HF in patients with a reduced ejection fraction who have a history of MI (stage B HF), to prevent HF in any patient with a reduced ejection fraction (stage B HF), or to treat those with HF and reduced ejection fraction (stage C HFrEF) (Yancy 2013)
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients:
• Patients ≥60 years of age with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥ 90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP is ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Coronary artery disease (CAD) and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with CAD recommends the use of an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina if there is prior MI, LV systolic dysfunction, diabetes mellitus, or CKD. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents (AHA/ACC/ASH [Rosendorff 2015]).
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines recommend an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) for patients with HTN and diabetes with albuminuria (urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio [UACR] ≥30 mg/g). For patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, thiazide-like diuretics, or dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).
STEMI: The 2013 ACCF/AHA guidelines for the management of patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) state that an ACE inhibitor should be initiated within the first 24 hours after STEMI in patients with anterior MI, heart failure, or left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤0.4. It is also reasonable to initiate an ACE inhibitor in all patients with STEMI (O'Gara 2013).

• Apply a thin layer of the cream to the affected area in dark room once or twice daily as directed by a healthcare professional.
• Wash the area before application and ensure it is dry.

Warnings and Precautions:
• For external use only.
• Avoid contact with eyes, mucous membranes, or open wounds.
• Avoid excessive sun exposure and light during treatment.

Active Ingredients:
• Hydroquinone
• Hydrocortisone Acetate
• Tretinoin.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 500mg

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Adults:
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Exacerbations Of Chronic Bronchitis (Mild To Moderate): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5 Or 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis: 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Genital Ulcer Disease (Chancroid)
Non-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 1 Gram Dose
-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 2 Gram Dose

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Geriatric Use: Elderly Patients May Be More Susceptible To Development Of Torsades De Pointes Arrhythmia.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Children
-Acute Otitis Media (6 Months Of Age And Older): 30 mg/kg As A Single Dose Or 10 mg/kg Once Daily For 3 Days Or 10 mg/kg As A Single Dose On Day 1 Followed By 5 mg/kg/Day On Days 2 Through 5.

Pediatric Use: Safety And Effectiveness In The Treatment Of Patients Under 6 Months Of Age Have Not Been Established.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.

-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.

-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 200mg/5ml

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Children
-Acute Otitis Media (6 Months Of Age And Older): 30 mg/kg As A Single Dose Or 10 mg/kg Once Daily For 3 Days Or 10 mg/kg As A Single Dose On Day 1 Followed By 5 mg/kg/Day On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis (6 Months Of Age And Older): 10 mg/kg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (6 Months Of Age And Older): 10 mg/kg As A Single Dose On Day 1 Followed By 5 mg/kg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (2 Years Of Age And Older): 12 mg/kg Once Daily For 5 Days.

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
Pediatric Use: Safety And Effectiveness In The Treatment Of Patients Under 6 Months Of Age Have Not Been Established.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.
●Need Water For Suspension.
●Shake Well Before Use.
●After Mixing, Store Suspension At 5 To 30C And Use Within 10 Days.
●Discard After Full Dosing Is Completed.
description.ar:
●المادة الفعالة

●دواعي الاستعمال
مضاد حيوي واسع المجال

●كيفية عمل الدواء
دواء مضاد للبكتيريا  ماكرولايد

●الجرعة
للأطفال في حالات الاتهاب البكتيري التالية:
 -التهاب الأذن الوسطى الحاد (6 أشهر من العمر وما فوق): 30 مجم / كجم كجرعة وحيدة أو 10 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يوميًا لمدة 3 أيام أو 10 مجم / كجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول تليها 5 مجم / كجم / اليوم في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التهاب الجيوب الأنفية البكتيري الحاد (من عمر 6 أشهر فأكثر): 10 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يومياً لمدة 3 أيام.
 -الالتهاب الرئوي (من عمر 6 أشهر وما فوق): 10 مجم / كجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول تليها 5 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التهاب القصبة الهوائية/ التهاب اللوزتين (2 سنة فأكثر): 12 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يومياً لمدة 5 أيام

 ●ملحوظات هامة
-العديد من المضادات الحيوية يمكن أن تسبب الإسهال. إذا كان الإسهال شديدًا أو استمر لأكثر من يومين أو ثلاثة أيام، فاتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -يمكن للعديد من المضادات الحيوية أن تسبب حساسية، إذا كان هناك أي رد فعل تحسسي، اتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -لم يتم إثبات الأمان والفعالية في علاج الأطفال الذين تقل أعمارهم عن 6 أشهر.
 -يمكن تناول الدواء مع أو بدون الطعام.
 -عدم تناول مضادات الحموضة المحتوية على الألمنيوم والمغنيسيوم والأزيثروميسين في وقت واحد.
 -اتبع تعليمات طبيبك الخاص لتحديد جرعة ومدة الدواء.
●يحتاج مياه للحل.
●الرجاء رج الزجاجة جيدًا قبل الاستخدام.
●بعد الحل يحفظ في درجة حرارة من 5 إلى 30 سيليزية ويستخدم في خلال 10 أيام من الحل والمتبقي بعد انتهاء الجرعة يتم التخلص منه.

 -التهاب الأذن الوسطى الحاد (6 أشهر من العمر وما فوق): 30 مجم / كجم كجرعة وحيدة أو 10 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يوميًا لمدة 3 أيام أو 10 مجم / كجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول تليها 5 مجم / كجم / اليوم في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التهاب الجيوب الأنفية البكتيري الحاد (من عمر 6 أشهر فأكثر): 10 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يومياً لمدة 3 أيام.
 -الالتهاب الرئوي (من عمر 6 أشهر وما فوق): 10 مجم / كجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول تليها 5 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التهاب القصبة الهوائية/ التهاب اللوزتين (2 سنة فأكثر): 12 مجم / كجم مرة واحدة يومياً لمدة 5 أيام

 ●ملحوظات هامة
-العديد من المضادات الحيوية يمكن أن تسبب الإسهال. إذا كان الإسهال شديدًا أو استمر لأكثر من يومين أو ثلاثة أيام، فاتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -يمكن للعديد من المضادات الحيوية أن تسبب حساسية، إذا كان هناك أي رد فعل تحسسي، اتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -لم يتم إثبات الأمان والفعالية في علاج الأطفال الذين تقل أعمارهم عن 6 أشهر.
 -يمكن تناول الدواء مع أو بدون الطعام.
 -عدم تناول مضادات الحموضة المحتوية على الألمنيوم والمغنيسيوم والأزيثروميسين في وقت واحد.
 -اتبع تعليمات طبيبك الخاص لتحديد جرعة ومدة الدواء.
●يحتاج مياه للحل.
●الرجاء رج الزجاجة جيدًا قبل الاستخدام.
●بعد الحل يحفظ في درجة حرارة من 5 إلى 30 سيليزية ويستخدم في خلال 10 أيام من الحل والمتبقي بعد انتهاء الجرعة يتم التخلص منه.

description.en:
Inhalation powder indicated to help prevent breathing problem such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
• Active ingredient (salmeterol / fluticasone) 50/500 mcg/dose
• Dose: one inhalation twice daily or as prescribed by the physician
• Precaution 
-Tell your doctor if you have Heart disease, including an irregular or fast heart beat  
-After using the medication rinse your mouth with water and spit it out, and/or brush your teeth
• How to use
1-To open your Diskus, hold the outer case in one hand and put the thumb of your other hand on the thumb grip. Push your thumb away from you as far as it will go. You will hear a click. This will open a small hole in the mouthpiece
2-Hold your Diskus with the mouthpiece towards you. you can hold it in either your right or left hand. Slide the lever away from you as far as it will go. You will hear a click. This places a dose of your medicine in the mouthpiece
3- Hold the Diskus away from your mouth, breathe out as far as is comfortable. Do not breathe into your Diskus
4- Put the mouthpiece to your lips; breathe in steadily and deeply through the Diskus, not through your nose. Remove the Diskus from your mouth. Hold your breath for about 10 seconds or for as long as is comfortable. Breathe out slowly
5- Afterwards rinse your mouth with water and spit it out, and/or brush your teeth. This may help to stop you getting thrush and becoming hoarse
6- To close the Diskus, slide the thumbgrip back towards you, as far as it will go. You will hear a click, the lever will return to its original position and is reset

سيريتيد هى بودرة للأستنشاق تستخدم لعلاج حالات الربو و حالات الأنسداد الرئوى المزمن

• الجرعة: جرعة استنشاق مرتين يوميا أو كما يصف الطبيب
• تحذير 
-أخبر الطبيب إذا كنت تعانى من مشاكل فى القلب مثل عدم انتظام ضربات القلب
-قم بالمضمضة وغسل الفم بعد كل مرة أستخدام
• كيفية الأستخدام
1-احمل العبوة بإحدى يديك وباستخدام إبهام اليد الأخرى اسحب مقبض الإبهام حتى تسمع صوت النقرة
2-وجه القطعة الشفوية ناحيتك ثم حرك عتلة إطلاق الجرعة إلى الناحية الأخرى حتى تسمع صوت النقرة (هذا يجهز الجرعة المناسبة ويدير عداد الجرعات
3-ازفر (اخرج الهواء من الفم) بلطف بعيدا عن الجهاز.
4-ضع القطعة الشفوية بين شفتيك واسحب الهواء من الجهاز بثبات وعمق.
5-ابعد الجهاز عن فمك واحبس أنفاسك لمدة تقارب 10 ثوان أو أكثر ثم ازفر ببطء وبشكل تدريجي (وذلك لضمان وصول جرعة مناسبة من الدواء دون فقدان جزء من هذه الجرعة أثناء الزفير).
6-لإغلاق الجهاز حرك المقبض رجوعا إلى وضعه الأولي حتى تسمع صوت النقرة مجددا 
7- احرص علي المضمضة وغسل الفم بعد كل مرة أستخدام لمنع حدوث أى عدوى أو التهاب بالفم

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Atorvastatin Dyslipidemias:
Dysbetalipoproteinemia: Treatment of primary dysbetalipoproteinemia (Fredrickson type III).
Heterozygous familial and nonfamilial hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia: To reduce elevated total cholesterol (total-C), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), apolipoprotein B (apo B), and triglyceride levels, and to increase HDL-C in patients with primary hypercholesterolemia (heterozygous familial and nonfamilial) and mixed dyslipidemia (Fredrickson type IIa and IIb).
Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C, LDL-C, and apo B levels in boys and postmenarche girls 10 to 17 years of age with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia with LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL, LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with positive family history of premature cardiovascular disease (CVD), or LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with two or more other CVD risk factors.
Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C and LDL-C in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia as an adjunct to other lipid-lowering treatments (eg, LDL apheresis) or if such treatments are unavailable.
Hypertriglyceridemia: Treatment of elevated serum triglyceride levels (Fredrickson type IV).
Limitations of use: Has not been studied in conditions where the major lipid abnormality is elevation of chylomicrons (Fredrickson types I and V).
Prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD):
Primary prevention of cardiovascular disease (high-risk for CVD): To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and revascularization procedures and angina in adult patients without clinically evident coronary heart disease (CHD) who have multiple CHD risk factors (eg, age, smoking, hypertension, low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol [HDL-C], family history of early CHD); to reduce the risk of MI and stroke in patients with type 2 diabetes and without clinically evident CHD but with multiple risk factors for CHD (eg, retinopathy, albuminuria, smoking, hypertension).
Secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease: To reduce the risk of nonfatal MI, fatal and nonfatal stroke, revascularization procedures, hospitalization for decompensated heart failure, and angina in patients with clinically evident CHD.

description.en:
Esomeprazole
 
●Concentration: 40 milligram Tablet
●Uses and Indication
Peptic and Duodenal ulcer
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
Heart burn
Adjuvant therapy in Treatment of H. pylori infection
Long-term treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, multiple endocrine adenomas and systemic mastocytosis
●Mode of action
Esomeprazole belongs to a class of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors (PPIs) that reduce stomach acid production
●Dosage and administration
Adult dose: used on empty stomach one hour before breakfast but maybe used twice daily not more than 2 months
Children dose : ages between 1-16 years may take a dose 5-20 Milligram/day prescribed by the physician
●Precautions
consult your physician or the pharmacist if you take another medications especially for chronic diseases
Long time use may lead to long-term inflammation of the stomach called atrophic gastritis

description.en:
Pantoprazole 
  
●Concentration: 40 milligram Tablet 
●Uses and Indication 
Peptic and Duodenal ulcer 
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) 
Heart burn 
Adjuvant therapy in Treatment of H. pylori infection 
Long-term treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, multiple endocrine adenomas and systemic mastocytosis 
●Mode of action 
Esomeprazole belongs to a class of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors (PPIs) that reduce stomach acid production 
●Dosage and administration 
Adult dose: used on empty stomach one hour before breakfast but maybe used twice daily not more than 2 months 
Children dose : ages between 1-16 years may take a dose 5-20 Milligram\day prescribed by the physician 
●Precautions 
consult your physician or the pharmacist if you take another medications especially for chronic diseases 
Long time use may lead to long-term inflammation of the stomach called atrophic gastritis
description.ar:
بانتوبرازول 
●التركيز 40 ملليجرام قرص 
●دواعى الإستخدام: 
قرحة المعدة والإثتنى عشر 
الحموضة الزائدة 
عامل مساعد فى علاج البكتريا الحلزونية 
فى بعض الأمراض مثل متلازمة زولينجر إليسون ومرض كثرة الخلية البدينة 
●طريقة عمل الدواء: 
بانتوبرازول هو أحد مشتقات مجموعة مايعرف بمثبطات مضخات الحمض بالمعدة او Proton pump Inhibitors التى تقلل من انتاج الحمض بالمعدة 
●الجرعة : 
للبالغين يأخذ قرص مرة قبل الفطار بساعة ويمكن أخذ قرص مرتين يوميا قبل الفطار وقبل العشاء بساعة وينصح بعدم إستخدامها أكثر من أسبوعين 
من عمر1-16 سنة يؤخذ جرعة من 5-20 ملليجرام يوميا وتوصف بواسطة الطبيب  
●التحذيرات : 
أستشر طبيبك أو الصيدلى إذا كنت تأخذ أدوية أخرى خاصة للأمراض المزمنة  
الإستخدام المفرط للدواء قد يسبب ضمور بالمعدة

Hero Baby Lf Now With Upgraded Formulation & More Benefits;
• Nutrition Experts In The Swiss Hero Group Have Developed Hero Baby Lf; Lactose-Free Formula Specially Designed For Babies With Lactose Intolerance & Associated Diarhea, Developed With More Than 80 Years Of Experience In Infant Nutrition.  

How Can Hero Baby Lf Support Your Baby? 
• Contributes In Rapid Control Of Diarrhea, Helps To Support Weight Gain, In Addition To Offering Nutrition In Easily Digestible Form. 
• Now With 100% More Omega 3 Dha; Closer To Breast Milk & Compliant With The New European Regulations, To Help Support Your Baby's Cognitive Development. 
•  Nutritionally Complete, Supplemented With Nutrients Naturally Present In Breast Milk; Nucleotides, Vitamins & Minerals That Help Supporting Immunity, Healthy Growth & More Tummy Comfort.  

Always Consult Your Doctor
description.ar:
الرضاعة الطبيعية هي الأفضل لتغذية الطفل وحمايته من الأمراض. توصي منظمة الصحة العالمية بالرضاعة الطبيعية الحصرية فى الستة أشهر الأولى من عمر الطفل والإستمرار حتى عمر سنتين أو لأطول مدة ممكنة.  

هيرو بيبي أل اف الآن بتركيبة أكثر تطوراً وفوائد أكثر؛ 

• طوّر خبراء التغذية فى هيرو السويسرية هيرو بيبى أل اف؛ تركيبة خالية من اللاكتوز، مصممة خصيصاً لحالات عدم تحمل اللاكتوز والإسهال المصاحب، تم تطويره بخبرة أكثر من 80 سنة من الأبحاث فى مجال تغذية الطفل.  كيف يدعم هيرو بيبي أل اف طفلِك؟ 
• يساهم فى الحد من الإسهال، يساعد على دعم زيادة الوزن. بالإضافة  إلى أنه يمنح طفلك تغذية فى صورة سهلة الهضم. 
• الآن  مدعم بــ 100% أوميجا 3 DHA أكثر، أقرب للبن الأم ومطابق لأحدث التوصيات الأوروبية. ليساعد على دعم النمو الإدراكي لطفلِك.   
• تغذية متكاملة، مدعم بمكونات موجودة طبيعياً فى لبن الأم؛ نيوكليوتيدات، فيتامينات ومعادن لمناعة أقوى، نمو صحي وراحة أفضل للجهاز الهضمي.  

 إستشيري طبيبك دائماً.-

الرضاعة الطبيعية هي الأفضل لتغذية الطفل وحمايته من الأمراض. لذا، توصي منظمة الصحة العالمية بالرضاعة الطبيعية الحصرية فى الستة أشهر الأولى من عمر الطفل والإستمرار حتى عمر سنتين أو لأطول مدة ممكنة.  

هيرو بيبي ايه آر الآن بتركيبة أكثر تطوراً وفوائد أكثر؛ 
• طوّر خبراء التغذية فى هيرو السويسرية هيرو بيبى ايه آر؛ تركيبة أكثر كثافة مصممة خصيصاً لحالات الإرتجاع المتكرر، تم تطويره بخبرة أكثر من 80 سنة من الأبحاث فى مجال تغذية الطفل.  كيف يدعم هيرو بيبي ايه آر طفلِك؟ 
• يساعد طفلِك على الإحتفاظ باللبن فى معدته. وبالتالي يساهم فى الحد من الإرتجاع المتكرر حتى يشعر طفلِك براحة أكثر بعد الرضاعة. 
• الآن  مدعم بــ 100% أوميجا 3 DHA أكثر، أقرب للبن الأم ومطابق لأحدث التوصيات الأوروبية. ليساعد على دعم النمو الإدراكي لطفلِك.   
• تغذية متكاملة، مدعم بمكونات موجودة طبيعياً فى لبن الأم؛ نيوكليوتيدات،  ألياف الجالاكتو-أوليجوساكريدات، فيتامينات ومعادن لمناعة أقوى، نمو صحي وراحة أفضل للجهاز الهضمي.  إستشيري طبيبك دائماً-

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Amoxicillin+Clavulanic Acid 642.9mg/5ml

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic
 
●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose For Neonates And Children
25 mg/kg/day in mild to moderate infections
45 mg/kg/day for the treatment of more serious infections

-Note: Reconstitution For Suspensions  And Shake Vigorously To Suspend Powder.
-Shake Oral Suspension Well Before Using
-Once reconstituted, the suspension must be stored in a refrigerator (2°C to 8°C) and used within 7 days.

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

ملحوظات: 
 -الدواء يحتاج إلى الحل بمحاليل حل الدواء ويجب رج الزجاجة جيدًا. 
 -الرجاء رج المعلق دائمًا قبل الاستخدام

 ملحوظات هامة: 
-كثير من المضادات الحيوية تسبب الإسهال، إن تعرضت للإسهال الشديد أو استمر الإسهال أكثر من يومين أو ثلاثة أيام فالرجاء التواصل مع طبيبك الخاص.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Esomeprazole Oral:
Esomeprazole magnesium and esomeprazole strontium:
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (Rx only):
Healing of erosive esophagitis: Short-term (4 to 8 weeks) treatment of erosive esophagitis
Maintenance of healing of erosive esophagitis: Maintaining symptom resolution and healing of erosive esophagitis
Symptomatic gastroesophageal reflux disease: Short-term (4 to 8 weeks) treatment of symptomatic gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
Helicobacter pylori eradication (Rx only): As part of a multidrug regimen for Helicobacter pylori eradication in patients with duodenal ulcer disease (active or history of within the past 5 years)
Risk reduction of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug-associated gastric ulcer (Rx only): Prevention of gastric ulcers associated with continuous NSAID therapy in patients at risk (age ≥60 years and/or history of gastric ulcer)
Pathological hypersecretory conditions, including Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (Rx only): Treatment (long-term) of pathological hypersecretory conditions including Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
Esomeprazole magnesium:
Heartburn (OTC labeling): Treatment of frequent heartburn (≥2 days per week).
IV: Esomeprazole sodium:
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (Rx only): Short-term (≤10 days) treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) with erosive esophagitis in pediatric patients 1 month to 17 years of age and adults when oral therapy is not possible or appropriate
Risk reduction of ulcer rebleeding postprocedure (Rx only): Decrease the risk of rebleeding postendoscopy for acute bleeding gastric or duodenal ulcers in adults

description.en:
•	For Dehydrated, Dry Hair

Details:
Inspired by Skincare- Hyaluron Moisture Night Push Pull Hair Cream the first night cream enriched with hyaluronic acid. Discover an exclusive formula enriched with Hyaluronic Acid, that instantly fills the hair with deep hydration, controls frizz and seals cuticles overnight for fully revitalized hair. Wake up with hair that is 4x hydrated, soft, detangled, and full of life. No residue on hair or pillow and no weigh down. It’s skincare for your hair! 

How to use 
• Step 1: Apply Hyaluron Moisture shampoo to clean and rehydrate your hair
• Step 2: Apply Hyaluron Moisture conditioner to detangle and lock in moisture 
• Step 3: Apply Hyaluron Moisture serum on wet or dry hair, spray all over your lengths to moisture and replump your hair fibers
• Step 4:  Apply Hyaluron Moisture Night Push Pull Hair Cream on your hair length and leave it overnight. You can wash your hair in the morning if you desire.

- Stimulates natural collagen production to reduce fine lines and wrinkles.

- يساعد على تفتيح البقع الداكنة والتصبغات ويمنحك بشرة موحدة.

description.en:
Experience superior sun protection with the Slinky Sun Screen Gel, designed to shield your skin from the harmful effects of UVA and UVB rays. This lightweight, non-greasy gel is perfect for all skin types, especially sensitive skin prone to irritation, redness, and sun damage. Enriched with nourishing ingredients, it keeps your skin hydrated while offering high-level protection.
Apply the sunscreen to exposed areas of the skin 15 minutes before sun exposure.  Reapply every 3 hours, especially during prolonged sun exposure or after swimming, sweating.

Key Features:

- Protect against both UVA and UVB rays.
- Non-greasy formula provides a smooth, matte finish with easy application.
- Enriched with Caviar Extract and Glycerin to keep your skin soft and moisturized.
- Help protect the skin from environmental damage, promoting a radiant complexion.
- Reduces redness and soothes sensitive skin.
- Size: 60 ml

- حماية ضد أشعة UVA وUVB.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Carvedilol Hypertension: Management of hypertension.
The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC 8 [James, 2013]):
• Patients ≥60 years of age, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <150 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
In patients with CKD, regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general non-black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Heart failure: Mild to severe chronic heart failure of ischemic or cardiomyopathic origin (usually in addition to standard therapy [eg, diuretics, ACE inhibitors]).
The ACCF/AHA 2013 heart failure guidelines recommend the use of 1 of the 3 beta blockers (ie, bisoprolol, carvedilol, or extended-release metoprolol succinate) for all patients with recent or remote history of MI or ACS and reduced ejection fraction (rEF) to reduce mortality, for all patients with rEF to prevent symptomatic HF (even if no history of MI), and for all patients with current or prior symptoms of HF with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), unless contraindicated, to reduce morbidity and mortality (Yancy, 2013).
Left ventricular dysfunction following myocardial infarction (MI): Left ventricular dysfunction following MI (clinically stable with LVEF ≤40%)

description.en: Skinova Image Panthenol Lotion, a versatile and effective skin moisturizing and soothing lotion spray that comes in a convenient 150ml spray bottle. This product is designed to provide your skin with the ultimate hydration and nourishment it needs while also soothing and calming any irritation or discomfort. This lotion is perfect for anyone looking to keep their skin hydrated and soft. Its unique formula contains Panthenol, which penetrates deep into the skin to help increase its ability to retain moisture. It also features Allantoin, which is known for its soothing and healing properties, making it ideal for those with sensitive or irritated skin. In addition, Skinova Image Panthenol Lotion is perfect for sunburn relief. Its blend of ingredients works together to soothe and heal sun-damaged skin. So, whether you're lounging on the beach or exploring the great outdoors, this lotion is the perfect addition to your skincare routine. The lotion comes in a 150ml spray bottle, making it easy to apply and perfect for on-the-go use. Its unique formula also includes Aloe Vera Extract, which helps to nourish and soothe the skin, leaving it feeling soft and supple. The lotion is lightly fragranced with lavender oil, giving it a refreshing and calming aroma.
description.ar: Skinova Image Panthenol Lotion، بخاخ لوشن متعدد الاستخدامات وفعال لترطيب البشرة وتهدئتها، يأتي في زجاجة رذاذ مناسبة سعة 150 مل. تم تصميم هذا المنتج لتزويد بشرتك بالترطيب والتغذية القصوى التي تحتاجها مع تهدئة أي تهيج أو إزعاج  مثالي لأي شخص يبحث عن الحفاظ على بشرته رطبة وناعمة. تحتوي تركيبته الفريدة على البانثينول الذي يتغلغل بعمق في الجلد للمساعدة في زيادة قدرته على الاحتفاظ بالرطوبة. كما أنه يحتوي على مادة آلانتوين المعروفة بخصائصها المهدئة والعلاجية، مما يجعلها مثالية لأولئك الذين يعانون من بشرة حساسة أو متهيجة. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يعتبر Skinova Image Panthenol Lotion مثاليًا لتخفيف حروق الشمس. يعمل مزيج المكونات معًا على تهدئة وعلاج البشرة المتضررة من الشمس. لذلك، سواء كنت تستلقي على الشاطئ أو تستكشف الأماكن الخارجية الرائعة، فإن هذا اللوشن هو الإضافة المثالية لروتين العناية بالبشرة. يأتي اللوشن في زجاجة رذاذ بسعة 150 مل، مما يجعله سهل الاستخدام ومثالي للاستخدام أثناء التنقل. تحتوي تركيبته الفريدة أيضًا على خلاصة الصبار التي تساعد على تغذية وتهدئة البشرة، مما يجعلها ناعمة ونضرة. اللوشن معطر بشكل خفيف بزيت اللافندر، مما يمنحه رائحة منعشة ومهدئة.

Active Ingredient: Ciprofloxacin Systemic: Children and Adolescents: Treatment of complicated urinary tract infections and pyelonephritis due to E. coli. Note: Although effective, ciprofloxacin is not the drug of first choice in children.
Infants, Children, Adolescents, and Adults: Prophylaxis to reduce incidence or progression of disease following inhalation exposure to Bacillus anthracis; prophylaxis and treatment of plague (Yersinia pestis).
Adults: Treatment of the following infections when caused by susceptible bacteria: Urinary tract infections; acute uncomplicated cystitis in females, chronic bacterial prostatitis, bone and joint infections, complicated intra-abdominal infections (in combination with metronidazole), infectious diarrhea, typhoid fever (Salmonella typhi), hospital-acquired (nosocomial) pneumonia.
Limitations of use: Because fluoroquinolones have been associated with disabling and potentially irreversible serious adverse reactions (eg, tendinitis and tendon rupture, peripheral neuropathy, CNS effects), reserve ciprofloxacin for use in patients who have no alternative treatment options for acute uncomplicated cystitis.
Ophthalmic: Ocular infections:
Ointment: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Solution: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (corneal ulcers, conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Otic: Acute otitis externa (0.2% solution): Treatment of acute otitis externa caused by susceptible isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa or Staphylococcus aureus
Otitis media (6% suspension): Treatment of bilateral otitis media in pediatric patients with effusion undergoing tympanostomy tube placement

description.en:
HYDROFUSIDIC CREAM is a topical cream combining an antibiotic and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is used to treat various skin conditions by reducing inflammation and combating bacterial infections.
Indications:
• Treatment of eczema and dermatitis with secondary bacterial infections.
• Management of atopic eczema and seborrheic dermatitis.
• Relief from skin inflammation, redness, and itching.
• Treatment of diaper rashes and sunburns.

How to use:
• Apply a thin layer to the affected area 2 to 3 times daily.
• Use for a maximum of two weeks unless directed by a physician.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not use on open wounds or broken skin.
• Prolonged use may lead to skin thinning.
• Not recommended for use in children under one year without medical advice.

Active Ingredients:
• Fusidic Acid 2%
• Hydrocortisone Acetate 1%

• لا يُستخدم على الجروح المفتوحة أو الجلد المتشقق.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Baclofen Spasticity:
Oral: Management of reversible spasticity associated with multiple sclerosis or spinal cord lesions
Intrathecal: Management of severe spasticity of spinal cord origin (eg, spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis) or cerebral origin (eg, cerebral palsy, traumatic brain injury) in patients ≥4 years; may be considered as an alternative to destructive neurosurgical procedures.
Limitations of use: Patients should first respond to a screening dose of intrathecal baclofen prior to consideration for long term infusion via an implantable pump. For spasticity of spinal cord origin, chronic infusion via an implantable pump should be reserved for patients unresponsive to oral baclofen therapy, or those who experience intolerable CNS side effects at effective doses. Patients with spasticity due to traumatic brain injury should wait at least one year after the injury before consideration of long term intrathecal baclofen therapy.

●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 500mg

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Adults:
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Exacerbations Of Chronic Bronchitis (Mild To Moderate): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5 Or 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis: 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Genital Ulcer Disease (Chancroid)
Non-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 1 Gram Dose
-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 2 Gram Dose

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Geriatric Use: Elderly Patients May Be More Susceptible To Development Of Torsades De Pointes Arrhythmia.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●الجرعة
للبالغين في حالات الاتهاب البكتيري التالية:
 -الالتهاب الرئوي (شدة خفيفة)
 التهاب القصبة الهوائية / التهاب اللوزتين
التهاب الجلد (غير معقد): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التفاقم البكتيري الحاد لالتهاب الشعب الهوائية المزمن (خفيف إلى متوسط): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام 2 إلى 5 أو 500 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا لمدة 3 أيام.

description.en:
•	SERETIDE is an inhalation powder indicated to help prevent breathing problem such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
•	Indication: Treatment of asthma (Reversible Obstructive Airways Disease) in adults, adolescents and children aged 4 years and over.
•	Ingredients: 50mcg of Salmeterol and 250 mcg of Fluticasone / dose.
•	Dosage: One inhalation twice daily or as prescribed by the physician.
•	Usage Instructions:
1-To open your Diskus, hold the outer case in one hand and put the thumb of your other hand on the thumb grip. Push your thumb away from you as far as it will go. You will hear a click. This will open a small hole in the mouthpiece 
2-Hold your Diskus with the mouthpiece towards you. you can hold it in either your right or left hand. Slide the lever away from you as far as it will go. You will hear a click. This places a dose of your medicine in the mouthpiece 
3- Hold the Diskus away from your mouth, breathe out as far as is comfortable. Do not breathe into your Diskus 
4- Put the mouthpiece to your lips; breathe in steadily and deeply through the Diskus, not through your nose. Remove the Diskus from your mouth. Hold your breath for about 10 seconds or for as long as is comfortable. Breathe out slowly 
5- Afterwards rinse your mouth with water and spit it out, and/or brush your teeth. This may help to stop you getting thrush and becoming hoarse 
6- To close the Diskus, slide the thumbgrip back towards you, as far as it will go. You will hear a click, the lever will return to its original position and is reset
•	Tell your doctor if you have Heart disease, including an irregular or fast heart beat 
•	After using the medication rinse your mouth with water and spit it out, and/or brush your teeth

CONTAFEVER N oral suspension is indicated for febrile conditions (including fever after vaccination), cold or flu symptoms, headache, toothache, rheumatic pain, or muscle pain.

How to use: 
The daily dose for children is 20-30 mg/kg per day in divided doses.
•        6  to 12 months (8-10 kg): 1.25 ml (50 mg) up to 3 to 4 times in 24 hours. 
•        1  to 4 years (10-15 kg): 2.5 ml (100 mg) up to 3 times in 24 hours.
•        4 to 7 years (15-20 kg): 3.75 ml (150 mg) up to 3 times in 24 hours. 
•        7  to 12 years (20-40 kg): 5 ml (200 mg) up to 3 times in 24 hours.

Precautions and Warnings: 
•        Allow at least 4 hours between each dose.
•        Do not take more than the recommended amount within a 24-hour period.

Active ingredient: Each 5 ml of oral suspension contains 200 mg ibuprofen.

SEBANOIN ANTI ACNE TOPICAL GEL 15GM is an effective treatment for all types of acne to reduce acne and improve skin clarity. This gel is suitable for oily skin due to its fast-absorbing formula.

How to use and dosage:
•Apply a thin layer of the gel to the affected area once or twice daily, as directed by a physician.
•Ensure the skin is clean and dry before application.
•Avoid excessive application to prevent irritation.

Warnings and precautions:
•For external use only.
•Avoid contact with eyes, mouth, or mucous membranes.
•Discontinue use if irritation or sensitivity occurs and consult a physician.
•Not recommended for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding without medical advice.

Active ingredients: Erythromycin 2% and Isotretinoin 0.05%.

BETALLERGE is indicated for symptomatic relief of moderate to severe seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis unresponsive to antihistamines alone or as adjunctive therapy with intranasal corticosteroids. It relieves nasal congestion, sneezing, itching, and rhinorrhea. 

How to Use & Dosage:
• Adults and adolescents ≥ 12 years: One tablet once daily with water after a meal. Do not exceed one tablet per day. Not recommended for children under 12. 

Warnings & Precautions:
• Contraindicated in hypersensitivity to betamethasone, dexchlorpheniramine, or any excipient.
• Use with caution in glaucoma, hypertension, diabetes, osteoporosis, or peptic ulcer; monitor blood pressure and glycemia.
• May cause sedation or dizziness; avoid driving or operating machinery.
• Consult physician before use in pregnancy or lactation.

ENRICH ORAL DROPS 50MG/ML (30ML) is indicated for the treatment of iron deficiency with or without anemia.

Dosage and How to Use:
• Infants up to 1 year
 With anemia:(10–20 drops) once daily.
 Without anemia:  (6–10 drops) once daily.

• Children (1–12 years)
 With anemia: (20–40 drops) once daily.
 Without anemia: (10–20 drops) once daily.

• Adolescents (≥ 12 years) and Adults
 With anemia: (40–120 drops) once daily.
 Without anemia: (20–40 drops) once daily.

• Administer during or immediately after feeding.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not exceed the recommended dose.
• Contains sorbitol and ethanol—avoid in hereditary fructose intolerance or alcohol-sensitive patients.
• May cause gastrointestinal upset (nausea, diarrhea, constipation).
• Use with caution in patients with peptic ulcer disease or inflammatory bowel disorders.

description.en:
VEE ALLURE Micellar Water designed to remove makeup, dirt, and excess oil without stripping your skin’s natural oils. Infused with natural ingredients like Chamomile and Cucumber, it hydrates and soothes your skin, leaving it feeling refreshed, soft, and nourished. 
Shake well. Saturate a cotton pad. Gently wipe pad over skin until completely free of makeup and impurities. Not rinse.

Key Features:

- Effective cleansing with a French-based formulation that removes makeup, oil, and impurities without drying your skin.
- Gentle and safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin, free from sulfates, parabens, and fragrances.
- Hydrates and nourishes with AquaxylTM and Vitamin E, leaving skin soft, supple, and refreshed.
- Soothes and protects with natural ingredients like Chamomile and Cucumber, helping to maintain your skin’s natural moisture barrier.
- Helps prevent dryness and irritation, making it ideal for daily skincare routines.
- Size: 200 ml.
description.ar:
تم تصميم في الور ماء ميسيلار لإزالة المكياج، الأوساخ، والزيوت الزائدة دون تجريد بشرتك من زيوتها الطبيعية. مدعمة بمكونات طبيعية مثل البابونج والخيار، ترطب وتساعد في تهدئة البشرة، مما يتركها منتعشة، ناعمة، ومغذاة.
رجّي الزجاجة جيدًا. اشبعي قطعة قطن بالمنتج. امسحي الوجه بلطف باستخدام قطعة القطن حتى يتم إزالة المكياج والشوائب بالكامل. لا حاجة للشطف.

مواصفات المنتج:

- تنظيف فعال مع تركيبة فرنسية تعمل على إزالة المكياج، الزيت، والشوائب دون تجفيف البشرة.
- لطيف وآمن لجميع أنواع البشرة، بما في ذلك البشرة الحساسة، خالٍ من الكبريتات، البارابين، والعطور.
- يرطب ويغذي بالبشرة باستخدام أكواكسيل™ وفيتامين E، مما يترك البشرة ناعمة ومرنة ومنعشة.
- يهدئ ويحمي باستخدام مكونات طبيعية مثل البابونج والخيار، مما يساعد في الحفاظ على حاجز الرطوبة الطبيعي للبشرة.
- يساعد في منع الجفاف والتهيج، مما يجعله مثاليًا للاستخدام اليومي في روتين العناية بالبشرة.
- الحجم: 200 مل.

name.en: Vee Allure Foam Cleanser For Acne Prone Skin 200ml
name.ar: في الور فوم تنظيف للبشرة المعرضة للحبوب 200مل

description.en:
Cleanse and clear your acne-prone skin with VEE ALLURE Foam Cleanser. This gentle yet effective  formula is designed to help prevent breakouts and control oil production, leaving your skin feeling refreshed and clear without irritation or dryness. This foam cleanser fights acne-causing bacteria and exfoliates your skin, while Aloe Vera and AquaxylTM hydrate and soothe for soft, supple skin.
Use every morning and evening. Apply a dime-size amount to damp skin and gently massage, avoiding the eye area. Rinse well.

Key Features:

- Gentle and effective cleansing action that clears your skin without causing irritation or dryness, suitable for daily use.
- Helps prevent breakouts by controlling excess oil production and keeping skin clean and clear.
- Powerful anti-acne ingredients like LipacideTM reduce acne-causing microorganisms and control sebum production.
- Exfoliating action with Salicylic Acid and Glycolic Acid, gently removing dead skin cells and bacteria.
- Hydrates and soothes with AquaxylTM and Aloe Vera, leaving your skin soft and supple.
-Enriched with Chamomile, Green Tea, and Witch Hazel to further control oil and prevent breakouts, while being free from harsh chemicals and fragrances.
- Size: 200 ml.
description.ar:
نظفي بشرتك المعرضة لحب الشباب بعمق مع VEE ALLURE Foam Cleanser. تم تصميم هذه التركيبة الفعالة واللطيفة للمساعدة في منع ظهور البثور وتنظيم إنتاج الزهم، مما يترك بشرتك منتعشة ونقية دون تهيج أو جفاف. يقاوم هذا المنظف الرغوي البكتيريا المسببة لحب الشباب ويقشر البشرة، بينما يساعد الألوة فيرا وأكواكسيل™ في ترطيب وتهدئة البشرة للحصول على مظهر ناعم ومرن.
استخدميه كل صباح ومساء. ضعي كمية بحجم عملة معدنية على البشرة المبللة ودلكي بلطف مع تجنب منطقة العين. يشطف جيدًا.

مواصفات المنتج:

- تنظيف لطيف وفعال ينظف البشرة دون التسبب في التهيج أو الجفاف، مناسب للاستخدام اليومي.
- يساعد في منع ظهور البثور من خلال التحكم في إفراز الزهم الزائد والحفاظ على البشرة نظيفة وواضحة.
- مكونات قوية ضد حب الشباب مثل ليبا سيد™ تقلل من الكائنات الدقيقة المسببة لحب الشباب وتسيطر على إنتاج الزهم.
- تأثير تقشير باستخدام حمض الساليسيليك وحمض الجليكوليك، مما يساعد في إزالة خلايا الجلد الميتة والبكتيريا بلطف.
- يرطب وتهدئ البشرة باستخدام أكواكسيل™ والألوة فيرا، مما يترك البشرة ناعمة ومرنة.
- غني بـ البابونج، الشاي الأخضر، وزهرة العزراء للتحكم في الزهم ومنع ظهور البثور، كما أنه خالٍ من المواد الكيميائية والعطور.
- الحجم: 200 مل.

name.en: Vee Allure Nail Lotion For Strong Nails 15ml

description.en:
Achieve healthy, strong, and beautiful nails with VEE ALLURE Nail Lotion. This nourishing formula is enriched with a blend of natural ingredients which work together to hydrate, protect, and promote healthy nail growth. Whether you have soft, brittle nails or simply want to maintain their beauty, this lotion provides the nourishment your nails need for a smooth, radiant appearance.

Apply one drop of the lotion to the surface of the nail and evenly distribute the nose of the bottle over the entire surface and along the edge of the nail. Wait (1 – 2) minutes until the liquid is absorbing into the your nail.

Key Features:

- Promotes healthy and beautiful nails by strengthening and improving overall nail health with Keratin and Biotin.
- Quick-absorbing and easy to apply, leaving nails feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated.
- Enriched with Vitamin E moisturize and hydrate nails, while Squalene and nourishing oils prevent dryness and promote growth.
- Free from harsh chemicals and artificial fragrances, making it gentle and safe for your nails.
- Suitable for all skin types.
- Size: 15 ml.
description.ar:
حقق أظافر صحية، قوية، وجميلة مع VEE ALLURE Nail Lotion. تحتوي هذه التركيبة المغذية على مزيج من المكونات الطبيعية التي تعمل معًا لترطيب الأظافر، حمايتها، وتعزيز نموها الصحي. سواء كانت أظافرك ضعيفة وهشة أو كنتِ ببساطة ترغبين في الحفاظ على جمالها، يوفر هذا اللوشن التغذية التي تحتاجها أظافرك لتبدو ناعمة ومشرقة.
ضعي قطرة واحدة من اللوشن على سطح الظفر ووزعيه بالتساوي على كامل سطح الظفر وعلى أطراف الظفر باستخدام فوهة الزجاجة. انتظري من 1 إلى 2 دقيقة حتى يتم امتصاص السائل في ظفرك.

مواصفات المنتج:

- يعزز الأظافر الصحية والجميلة من خلال تقويتها وتحسين صحة الأظافر العامة باستخدام الكيراتين والبيوتين.
- سريع الامتصاص وسهل الاستخدام، مما يترك الأظافر ناعمة، ملساء، ومرطبة.
- غني بـ فيتامين E لترطيب الأظافر، بينما يساعد السكوالين والزيوت المغذية على منع الجفاف وتعزيز النمو.
- خالي من المواد الكيميائية القاسية والعطور الصناعية، مما يجعله لطيفًا وآمنًا على أظافرك.
- مناسب لجميع أنواع البشرة.
- الحجم: 15 مل.

name.en: Tricho Grow Vee Hair Water Anti Frizz Spray 200ml
name.ar: ترايكو جرو في ماء سبراي مضاد لهيشان الشعر 200مل

description.en:
Experience the hydration with Tricho Grow Vee Hair water anti frizz spray, a unique hair care solution that transforms dry, thirsty strands into soft, smooth, and manageable hair.  It features Aquaxyl™, for its instant moisture replenishment. 
Nourish your hair with Keratin, Vitamin A, Vitamin E, and Rosemary Extract  all working together to promote healthier-looking hair, while also helping to control frizz and flyaways for sleek, shiny results. 

Apply 5-6 puffs directly onto damp or dry scalp and hair. Gently massage into your scalp with fingertips for better absorption. Style as usual for soft, sleek, and revitalized hair. 

Key Features:

- Enriched with Aquaxyl™, Keratin, Vitamin A, Vitamin E, and Rosemary that nourish and strengthen hair strands for a healthier appearance.

- Effectively tames frizz, leaving your hair sleek and free of flyaways.

- Light & non-greasy formula won’t leave residue, providing a light, refreshed feel.

- Suitable for all hair types.

- Size: 200 ml
description.ar:
أحصل علي الترطيب الفعال مع ترايكو جرو في ماء سبراي مضاد لهيشان الشعر، الحل الفريد للعناية بالشعر يحول الخصلات الجافة والعطشة إلى شعر ناعم وحريري وسهل التصفيف. يتميز بـ Aquaxyl™، لتجديد الترطيب الفوري.
غذي شعرك بالكيراتين وفيتامين أ وفيتامين هـ ومستخلص إكليل الجبل، لتعزيز صحة الشعر، مع المساعدة أيضًا على التحكم في التجعد والضبابات للحصول على نتائج أنيقة ولامعة.

ضع 5-6 بخاخات مباشرة على فروة الرأس والشعر الرطب أو الجاف. تدلك فروة رأسك بلطف بأطراف الأصابع لتحسين الامتصاص. ثم يصفف الشعر.

مواصفات المنتج:

- مدعم بـ Aquaxyl™، والكيراتين، وفيتامين أ، وفيتامين هـ، وإكليل الجبل الذي يغذي ويقوي خصلات الشعر للحصول على مظهر أكثر صحة.

- يقلل من التجعد بفعالية، مما يترك شعرك أنيقًا.

- تركيبة خفيفة وغير دهنية لا تترك بقايا، مما يوفر شعورًا خفيفًا ومنتعشًا.

- مناسب لجميع أنواع الشعر.

- الحجم: 200 مل

description.en:

name.en: Tricho Grow Vee Anti Dandruff Lotion 200ml
name.ar: ترايكو جرو في لوشن مضاد لقشرة الشعر 200مل

description.en:
Tricho Grow Vee Anti Dandruff lotion specially formulated for complete control of dandruff and  itching, and well moisturized hair.
Enriched with  Green Tea extract, Tea Tree oil, Thyme extract, Ginger extract, Lemon Grass oil, Clotrimazole, Climbazole, Piroctone olamine and salicylic acid, to combats fungal and bacterial overgrowth on the scalp. It soothes the scalp, reducing redness and irritation and  overcome dryness of by Panthenol, Vitamin E and chamomile.

Key features:- 
-  Anti Dandruff lotion.
- Enriched with  Green Tea extract, Tea Tree oil, Thyme extract, Ginger extract, Lemon Grass oil, Clotrimazole, Climbazole, Piroctone olamine and salicylic acid, Panthenol, Vitamin E and chamomile.
- Size: 200 ml
description.ar:
لوسيون ترايكو جرو في المضاد للقشرة مصمم خصيصًا للتحكم الكامل في القشرة والحكة، مع ترطيب جيد للشعر.
غني بمستخلص الشاي الأخضر، زيت شجرة الشاي، مستخلص الزعتر، مستخلص الزنجبيل، زيت الليمون، الكلوتريمازول، الكليمبازول، بيروكتون أولامين، وحمض الساليسيليك، لمكافحة النمو المفرط للفطريات والبكتيريا على فروة الرأس. يهدئ فروة الرأس، ويقلل من الاحمرار والتهيج، ويعالج الجفاف بفضل البانثينول، فيتامين E، والبابونج.

مواصفات المنتج:

- لوسيون مقاوم للقشرة.
- غني بمستخلص الشاي الأخضر، زيت شجرة الشاي، مستخلص الزعتر، مستخلص الزنجبيل، زيت الليمون، الكلوتريمازول، الكليمبازول، بيروكتون أولامين، وحمض الساليسيليك، البانثينول، فيتامين E، والبابونج.
- الحجم: 200 مل.

name.ar: في الور كريم مضاد للهالات السوداء 40مل

description.en:
Revitalize your eye area with VEE ALLURE Eye Contour Cream, a luxurious formula infused with premium active ingredients. Designed to brighten, hydrate, and protect, this cream works to even out skin tone, reduce puffiness, and diminish dark circles. With powerful anti-aging benefits, it smooths fine lines and wrinkles while improving overall skin texture. Experience a refreshed, radiant, and youthful look with every application.

Apply in small dots around the eye contour. Gently blend onto your eye area using upward motions, until completely absorbed.

Key Features:

- Provide brightens & evens skin tone.
- Retinol and caffeine work to depuff and reduces puffiness & dark circles:
- Hyaluronic acid deeply moisturizes and plumps the skin for a smoother appearance.
- Anti-Aging & protection with Vitamin C, Vitamin E, and green tea extract.
- Size: 40 ml
description.ar:
حافظي علي منطقة محيط العين مع في الور كريم لمنطقة حول العين، بتركيبته النشطة حيث صُمم لتفتيح البشرة وترطيبها وحمايتها. يعمل على توحيد لون البشرة، تقليل الانتفاخ، والتخفيف من الهالات السوداء. بفضل فوائده المضادة للشيخوخة، يساعد على تنعيم الخطوط الدقيقة والتجاعيد وتحسين ملمس البشرة بشكل عام، ليمنحكِ مظهرًا مشرقًا وشابًا مع كل استخدام.

ضعي نقاطًا صغيرة من الكريم حول محيط العين، وامزجيه بلطف بحركات تصاعدية حتى يتم امتصاصه بالكامل

مواصفات المنتج:

- يعمل على تفتيح البشرة وتوحيد لونها.
- يحتوي على الريتينول والكافيين لتقليل الانتفاخ والهالات السوداء.
- غني بحمض الهيالورونيك لترطيب البشرة بعمق ومنحها مظهرًا ممتلئًا وناعمًا.
- يوفر حماية مضادة للشيخوخة بفضل فيتامين C، فيتامين E، ومستخلص الشاي الأخضر.
- الحجم: 40 مل

description.en:
A premium cream designed specifically for sensitive areas, VEE ALLURE Whitening Cream, reduce melanin production, gently exfoliate dead skin cells, and reveal a brighter, smoother complexion. Infused with natural extracts and antioxidants, it deeply nourishes and protects the skin from environmental stress.

Dispense it onto your ring finger and apply in small dots around the eye contour. Gently blend onto your entire eye area, using upward motions, until completely absorbed.

Key Features:

- Alpha Arbutin effectively lightens dark areas and promotes a more uniform complexion.
- Licorice extract helps inhibit melanin production to prevent hyperpigmentation.
- Removes dead skin cells to unveil smoother and more radiant skin.
- Enriched with Vitamin E for antioxidant benefits and enhanced hydration.
- Free from harsh chemicals and parabens, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive areas.
- Infused with Natural Extracts; Green Tea, Licorice, Grapeseed Oil, Carrot Seed Oil, and Almond Oil.
- Size: 50 gm
description.ar:
في الور كريم تفتيح للمناطق الحساسة يساعد على تقليل إنتاج الميلانين، وتقشير الخلايا الميتة بلطف، ليكشف عن بشرة أكثر إشراقًا ونعومة. بفضل تركيبته الغنية بالمستخلصات الطبيعية ومضادات الأكسدة، يغذي البشرة بعمق ويحميها من العوامل البيئية الضارة.

ضع كمية كافية على طرف إصبعك، ثم يوزع بلطف على منطقة محيط العين بنقاط صغيرة. يمزج الكريم بحركات تصاعدية حتى يتم امتصاصه بالكامل 

مواصفات المنتج:

-  يساعد في تفتيح المناطق الداكنة وتعزيز توحيد لون البشرة.
- مستخلص العرقسوس يقلل من إنتاج الميلانين لمنع فرط التصبغ.
- يقشر الخلايا الميتة لبشرة أكثر نعومة وإشراقًا.
- غني بفيتامين E لمزايا مضادة للأكسدة وترطيب عميق.
- خالي من المواد الكيميائية القاسية والبارابين، مما يجعله مناسبًا لجميع أنواع البشرة، بما في ذلك المناطق الحساسة.
- غني بالمستخلصات الطبيعية: الشاي الأخضر، العرقسوس، زيت بذور العنب، زيت بذور الجزر، وزيت اللوز.
- الحجم: 50 جم

name.en: Vee Allure Whitenig Cream For Sensitive Area 50ml
name.ar: في الور كريم تفتيح الاماكن الحساسة 50جم

description.en:
VEE ALLURE Whitening Cream for Sensitive Areas is designed specifically for delicate skin. Effectively inhibits melanin production, preventing hyperpigmentation and evening out skin tone. Enriched with powerful brightening agents and nourishing vitamins, it gently hydrates, soothes, and revitalizes sensitive areas for a radiant and youthful appearance.
Apply in small dots where needed around the sensitive area . Gently smooth until thoroughly absorbed. Use nightly before bedtime.

Key Features:

- Helps reduce dark spots and hyperpigmentation.
- Designed for delicate areas like underarms, bikini line, and inner thighs.
- Enriched with niacinamide, vitamin C, vitamin E, and botanical extracts for deep nourishment & hydration.
- Size: 50 ml
description.ar:
في الور كريم تفتيح المناطق الحساسة مصمم خصيصًا للعناية بالبشرة. يعمل بفعالية على تثبيط إنتاج الميلانين، مما يساعد في منع التصبغات وتوحيد لون البشرة. بفضل تركيبته الغنية بمكونات التفتيح القوية والفيتامينات المغذية، يوفر الكريم ترطيبًا وتهدئة عميقة، مما يعزز إشراقة البشرة الحساسة ويمنحها مظهرًا أكثر نضارة وشبابًا.

ضعي نقاطًا صغيرة من الكريم على المناطق الحساسة المطلوبة، ثم وزّعيه بلطف حتى يتم امتصاصه بالكاملاستخدميه ليلاً قبل النوم للحصول على أفضل النتائج.

مواصفات المنتج:

- يقلل من البقع الداكنة والتصبغات.
- مناسب للمناطق الحساسة مثل تحت الإبط، خط البكيني، والفخذين الداخليين.
- غني بالنياسيناميد، فيتامين C، فيتامين E، والمستخلصات النباتية لتغذية وترطيب عميق.
- الحجم: 50 مل

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Amlodipine Coronary artery disease (CAD):
Chronic stable angina: Treatment of symptomatic chronic stable angina. May be used alone or in combination with other antianginal agents.
Vasospastic angina (Prinzmetal or variant angina): Treatment of confirmed or suspected vasospastic angina. May be used alone or in combination with other antianginal agents.
Angiographically documented CAD: Reduce the risk of hospitalization secondary to angina and to reduce the risk of a coronary revascularization procedure in patients with recently documented CAD by angiography (without heart failure or an ejection fraction of <40%).
The ACCF/AHA 2013 guidelines for management of heart failure state that, with the exception of amlodipine, calcium channel blockers should be avoided and withdrawn whenever possible in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). While amlodipine, like other calcium channel blockers, has no benefit on functioning or survival, it may be used for the treatment of hypertension or ischemic heart disease in patients with HFrEF (ACCF/AHA [Yancy 2013]).
Hypertension: Treatment of hypertension. May be used alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents.
Guideline recommendations:
The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (JNC 8) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC8 [James 2013]):
• Patients ≥60 years, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension: In patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general nonblack population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines suggest that for patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, thiazide-like diuretics, dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).

description.en:
ARYTHREX 200MG CAPSULES is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that contains celecoxib. It is used to relieve pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis. It works by selectively inhibiting the COX-2 enzyme, which plays a role in the inflammatory process.

How to use:
• The dose is determined by the physician according to the condition.
• Take the capsule with food or after eating to reduce stomach upset.
• Swallow whole with water — do not open, crush, or chew the capsule.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Contraindicated in patients with active ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, or severe heart, liver, or kidney disease.
• Avoid use in late pregnancy (third trimester).
• Inform your doctor about all other medications you're taking.
• Possible side effects: abdominal pain, indigestion, headache, dizziness, or increased blood pressure.

Active Ingredient:
• Celecoxib: 200 mg

طريقة الاستخدام:
• يحدد الطبيب الجرعة المناسبة حسب الحالة.
• يُفضل تناوله مع الطعام أو بعد الأكل لتقليل اضطرابات المعدة.
• تُبلع الكبسولة كاملة مع كمية كافية من الماء دون فتحها أو سحقها أو مضغها.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Atorvastatin Dyslipidemias:
Dysbetalipoproteinemia: Treatment of primary dysbetalipoproteinemia (Fredrickson type III).
Heterozygous familial and nonfamilial hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia: To reduce elevated total cholesterol (total-C), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), apolipoprotein B (apo B), and triglyceride levels, and to increase HDL-C in patients with primary hypercholesterolemia (heterozygous familial and nonfamilial) and mixed dyslipidemia (Fredrickson type IIa and IIb).
Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C, LDL-C, and apo B levels in boys and postmenarche girls 10 to 17 years of age with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia with LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL, LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with positive family history of premature cardiovascular disease (CVD), or LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with two or more other CVD risk factors.
Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C and LDL-C in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia as an adjunct to other lipid-lowering treatments (eg, LDL apheresis) or if such treatments are unavailable.
Hypertriglyceridemia: Treatment of elevated serum triglyceride levels (Fredrickson type IV).
Limitations of use: Has not been studied in conditions where the major lipid abnormality is elevation of chylomicrons (Fredrickson types I and V).
Prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD):
Primary prevention of cardiovascular disease (high-risk for CVD): To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and revascularization procedures and angina in adult patients without clinically evident coronary heart disease (CHD) who have multiple CHD risk factors (eg, age, smoking, hypertension, low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol [HDL-C], family history of early CHD); to reduce the risk of MI and stroke in patients with type 2 diabetes and without clinically evident CHD but with multiple risk factors for CHD (eg, retinopathy, albuminuria, smoking, hypertension).
Secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease: To reduce the risk of nonfatal MI, fatal and nonfatal stroke, revascularization procedures, hospitalization for decompensated heart failure, and angina in patients with clinically evident CHD.

●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 500mg

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Adults:
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Exacerbations Of Chronic Bronchitis (Mild To Moderate): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5 Or 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis: 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Genital Ulcer Disease (Chancroid)
Non-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 1 Gram Dose
-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 2 Gram Dose

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Geriatric Use: Elderly Patients May Be More Susceptible To Development Of Torsades De Pointes Arrhythmia.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

Sinusitis: Treatment of acute maxillary sinusitis due to susceptible H. influenzae, S. pneumoniae, or M. catarrhalis.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Bisoprolol Hypertension: Treatment of hypertension, alone or in combination with other agents
Guideline recommendations:
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC8 [James, 2013]):
• Patients ≥60 years of age, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <150 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg. Goal of therapy is SBP <140 mm Hg and DBP <90 mm Hg.
Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension: Regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general nonblack population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Coronary artery disease (CAD) and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) recommends the use of a beta blocker as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina with a history of prior MI. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents

●Active Ingredient
Ceftriaxone 1gm

●Intravenous

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Third Generation Cephalosporin Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Cell Wall Inhibitor Antibacterial Agent

●Dose
For Adults:
1-Moderate And Severe Infections:
-1gm Or 2gm Every 24 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
-500mg Or 1g Every 12 Hours Intramuscular Or Intravenous.
2-Uncomplicated Gonorrhea:
250mg As A Single Dose Intramuscular.
*There Is Limited Experience With Daily Doses Of 3-4gm Administered As A Single Dose Or Two Equally Divided Doses.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4gm.
For Infants And Children (One Month To 12 Years Of Age):
1-Serious Miscellaneous Infections: 25 Or 37.5 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 2 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.
2-Meningitis: 50 Mg/Kg Every 12 Hours.
*The Total Daily Dose Should Not Exceed 4 G. If Body Weight Is 50 Kg Or More The Adult Dose Should Be Used.

●Special Notes
-Hypersensitivity Test Must Be Made.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Dose To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●Reconstitution Tips
-For Intramuscular Use: Solutions Should Be Reconstituted Immediately Before Use. If Storage Is Required, These Solutions May Be Stored Under Refrigeration(Between 2 And 8°C) And Should Be Used Within 48 Hours.
-For Intravenous Bolus Injection (Without Further Dilution): Reconstituted Solutions Should Be Administered Within 24 Hours When Stored At Room Temperature And Within 72 Hours When Refrigerated (Between 2 And 8°C).

description.en:
FASTEL 180MG FILM COATED TABLETS are used to relieve symptoms of seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis and chronic idiopathic urticaria in adults and adolescents 12 years and older.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults and adolescents 12 years and older: Take one tablet (180 mg) once daily, with or without food.

Warnings and Precautions:
• May cause headache or dizziness; avoid driving or operating machinery if affected.
• Avoid concomitant use with apple, orange, or grapefruit juice around dosing to prevent reduced absorption.

Active Ingredient: Fexofenadine hydrochloride 180 mg per tablet

طريقة الاستخدام والجرعة:
• البالغون والمراهقون من 12 سنة فما فوق: تناول قرص واحد (180 مجم) مرة واحدة يوميًا، مع أو بدون طعام.
• كبار السن وذوي القصور الكلوي الخفيف إلى المتوسط (تصفية كلوية ≥ 30 مل/د): لا حاجة لتعديل الجرعة.
• القصور الكلوي الشديد (تصفية كلوية < 30 مل/د): يُستخدم بحذر مع مراقبة وظائف الكلى.

التحذيرات والاحتياطات:
• يمنع الاستخدام في حالة الحساسية لفكسوفينادين أو أي من المكونات الأخرى.
• قد يسبب صداعًا أو دوارًا؛ يُنصح بتجنب القيادة أو تشغيل الآلات في حال حدوث هذه الأعراض.
• تجنب استخدامه مع عصائر التفاح أو البرتقال أو الجريب فروت حول وقت الجرعة لتجنب تقليل الامتصاص.

How to use and dosage:
•Adults: Take one tablet (7.5mg) once daily, preferably with food to reduce stomach upset.
•Do not exceed the prescribed dose, and follow your physician's instructions.

Warnings and precautions:
•Avoid use if allergic to Meloxicam or other NSAIDs.

•Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless prescribed by a doctor.

How to use:
• Adults and children over 12 years: 1–2 tablets every 4–6 hours as needed.
• Do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours.
• Swallow with water, with or without food.
• Not recommended for children under 12 years.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not use with other products containing paracetamol.
• May cause drowsiness; avoid driving or using machinery.
• Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding without doctor consultation.

• Paracetamol: 500 mg
• Pseudoephedrine HCl: 30 mg
• Chlorpheniramine maleate: 2 mg

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 500mg

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Adults:
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Exacerbations Of Chronic Bronchitis (Mild To Moderate): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5 Or 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis: 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Genital Ulcer Disease (Chancroid)
Non-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 1 Gram Dose
-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 2 Gram Dose

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Geriatric Use: Elderly Patients May Be More Susceptible To Development Of Torsades De Pointes Arrhythmia.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

 -الالتهاب الرئوي (شدة خفيفة)
 التهاب القصبة الهوائية / التهاب اللوزتين
التهاب الجلد (غير معقد): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التفاقم البكتيري الحاد لالتهاب الشعب الهوائية المزمن (خفيف إلى متوسط): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام 2 إلى 5 أو 500 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا لمدة 3 أيام.
 -التهاب الجيوب الأنفية البكتيري الحاد: 500 مجم مرة واحدة يومياً لمدة 3 أيام.
 -مرض الالتهاب البكتيري التناسلي والتهاب عنق الرحم: جرعة واحدة 1 جرام.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Perindopril Hypertension: Management of hypertension.
Stable coronary artery disease: To reduce the risk of cardiovascular mortality or nonfatal myocardial infarction in patients with stable coronary artery disease (CAD).
Guideline recommendations:
Hypertension: The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (Eighth Joint National Committee [JNC 8]) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients:
• Patients ≥60 years of age with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years of age with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP is ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with diabetes and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years of age with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
CAD and hypertension: The American Heart Association, American College of Cardiology, and American Society of Hypertension (AHA/ACC/ASH) 2015 scientific statement for the treatment of hypertension in patients with CAD recommends the use of an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) as part of a regimen in patients with hypertension and chronic stable angina if there is prior MI, LV systolic dysfunction, diabetes mellitus, or CKD. A BP target of <140/90 mm Hg is reasonable for the secondary prevention of cardiovascular events. A lower target BP (<130/80 mm Hg) may be appropriate in some individuals with CAD, previous MI, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or CAD risk equivalents (AHA/ACC/ASH [Rosendorff 2015]).
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines recommend an ACE inhibitor (or an ARB) for patients with HTN and diabetes with albuminuria (urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio [UACR] ≥30 mg/g). For patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the four classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, thiazide-like diuretics, or dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes (ADA 2017a).
