description.en:
•	KLACID 500mg tablet is a macrolide antibiotic used to treat or prevent infections caused by bacteria susceptible to this medicine’s action. 
•	Ingredients: 500mg of Clarithromycin.
•	Indication It is an antibiotic active against many gram-positive (Staphylococcus aureus, S. pneumoniae, and S. pyogenes) and gram-negative aerobic bacteria (Haemophilus influenzae, H. parainfluenzae, and Moraxella catarrhalis), many anaerobic bacteria, some mycobacteria, and some other organisms including Mycoplasma, Ureaplasma, Chlamydia, Toxoplasma, and Borrelia1. It is also used in the treatment of conditions like acute and chronic bronchitis and pneumonia, sinusitis and pharyngitis, community-acquired pneumonia, atypical pneumonia, skin and soft tissue infection, and duodenal ulcers to eradicate H. pylori.
•	Dosage/Usage Instructions: The usual dosing is 500 mg every 12 hours.
•	If you have liver and/or kidney disease, any heart problems, or low levels of potassium or magnesium, talk to your doctor before taking this drug. 
•	Long term use of this medicine increases the risk of developing secondary infections.
•	This medicine may worsen your Myasthenia Gravis symptoms. 
•	Do not take this medicine if you are pregnant or breast-feeding.

• المادة الفعالة: 500 مجم من الكلاريثروميسين.
• الاستخدام: مضاد حيوي فعّال ضد العديد من البكتيريا إيجابية الجرام (العنقوديات الذهبية، المكورات الرئوية، والعنقوديات البيروجينية) والبكتيريا الهوائية سالبة الجرام (الانفلونزا النزلية، الانفلونزا النزلية الطفيلية، والعينات التنفسية موراكسيلا)، والعديد من البكتيريا اللاهوائية، وبعض البكتيريا السلبية الهوائية، وبعض الميكوبكتيريا، وبعض الكائنات الأخرى بما في ذلك الميكوبلازما، واليورابلازما، والكلاميديا، والتوكسوبلازما، والبوريليا. يُستخدم أيضًا في علاج الحالات مثل التهاب الشعب الحاد والمزمن والتهاب الرئة، والتهاب الجيوب الأنفية والتهاب الحلق، والتهاب الرئة غير النمطي، والتهاب الجلد والأنسجة الرخوة، وقرحة الاثنى عشر للاستئصال H. pylori.
• الجرعة/تعليمات الاستخدام: الجرعة العادية هي 500 مجم كل 12 ساعة.
• إذا كان لديك أمراض في الكبد و/أو الكلى، أو أي مشاكل في القلب، أو مستويات منخفضة من البوتاسيوم أو المغنيسيوم، تحدث مع طبيبك قبل تناول هذا الدواء.
• يزيد استخدام هذا الدواء على المدى الطويل من خطر تطور العدوى الثانوية.
• قد يسوء هذا الدواء أعراض الذئبة العضلية لديك.
• لا تتناول هذا الدواء إذا كنت حاملاً أو ترضعين.

ALFACARENO ORAL DROPS 2MCG/ML are prescribed to support conditions related to calcium and phosphate metabolism such as osteoporosis, osteomalacia, and hypoparathyroidism. They help maintain healthy bones and improve mineral balance in patients with impaired vitamin D activation.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Typical adult starting dose: 1–2 mcg daily (equivalent to 0.5–1 ml), adjusted according to blood levels and medical advice.
• Drops should be taken orally, preferably at the same time each day.
• Dosage must be strictly individualized by the healthcare professional.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Regular monitoring of blood calcium is essential during treatment.
• Caution in patients with kidney disorders or hypercalcemia.
• Keep refrigerated and out of reach of children.

• Active Ingredient:

description.en:
VENDEXINE Syrup is a combination medication used for managing allergic conditions and inflammation in children.

How to Use and Dosage:
• The dosage should be determined by a healthcare professional based on the child's age, weight, and medical condition.
• Preferably taken after meals to reduce the risk of stomach upset.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Use with caution in children with a history of gastrointestinal ulcers.
• Prolonged use may lead to side effects such as suppression of growth in children; consult a healthcare professional for long-term use.

Active Ingredients:
• Dexamethasone, a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation
• Chlorpheniramine, an antihistamine that alleviates allergy symptoms

description.en:
Protect your skin from harmful sun exposure with Vacation's Pure Touch Hydro Sun Screen Gel. Offering SPF 50, this gel delivers powerful broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays, while keeping your skin hydrated and refreshed. Its lightweight, fast-absorbing formula helps fight fine lines and wrinkles, making it perfect for those with oily skin.
Apply a sufficient amount evenly over your face and body 20 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply as needed.
Key Features:

- Shields your skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays.
- Infused with Vitamin E for nourishment and moisture.
- Fast-absorbing, non-greasy formula that leaves a matte, shine-free finish.
- Prevents fine lines and helps combat the appearance of wrinkles for a smoother complexion.
- Size: 60 ml

ZARROPRAZOLE 20/1100MG CAPSULES are indicated for the treatment of gastric and duodenal ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and as part of combination therapy for Helicobacter pylori eradication to reduce the risk of ulcer recurrence. The combination enhances gastric acid suppression and provides mucosal protection.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults: One capsule once daily, usually before meals,or as prescribed by physician.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to proton pump inhibitors or bismuth salts.
• Avoid long-term unsupervised use, as it may lead to vitamin B12 deficiency.
• Possible side effects include headache, diarrhea, abdominal pain, darkened stool, and nausea.

• Sodium Bicarbonate 1100 mg

description.en:
TRYPSALIN PLUS TABLETS is used to reduce inflammation and swelling caused by surgery, trauma, or chronic venous disorders. It promotes faster healing after operations, reduces post-surgical edema, and supports recovery in gynecological and ENT conditions. Also helps relieve pain and improve circulation in soft tissue injuries and post-partum inflammation.

How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults and adolescents: 1–2 tablets once daily after meals or as directed by a physician.
• Swallow tablets whole without chewing.
• Not recommended for children unless prescribed by a healthcare provider.

Warnings and Precautions:
• Do not use in case of known allergy to any enzyme ingredients.
• Consult your doctor if pregnant, breastfeeding, or taking anticoagulants.

Active Ingredients:
• Bromelain 125mg
• Papain 62.5mg 
• Pancreatin 50mg
• Trypsin 37.5mg

description.en:
GASTROPEXY 20 mg Tablets are used to reduce stomach acidity and treat gastrointestinal disorders related to excess acid secretion, such as erosive esophagitis, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and gastric ulcers. They are also used in combination with antibiotics to eradicate Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori).

How to use:
• The recommended dose for adults is 20 mg once daily, with or without food
• The duration of treatment is determined by the prescribing physician according to the patient's health condition.

Warnings and precautions:
• Not recommended for patients with known hypersensitivity to vonoprazan
• Use with caution in patients with severe hepatic or renal impairment
• Long-term use may lead to vitamin B12 deficiency, or hypomagnesemia.

Active ingredient: Each tablet contains 20 mg of vonoprazan.

description.en:
Protect your skin effortlessly with INFINITY Care Sunscreen Mist SPF 50+, designed for the whole family and all skin types. This broad-spectrum sunscreen shields against UVA and UVB rays, preventing sunburn, premature aging, and skin damage. With its hydrating and soothing formula, it keeps your skin soft and protected throughout the day. Water-resistant, hypoallergenic, and fragrance-free, it's perfect for everyday use and easy reapplication.
Apply sunscreen 15-20 minutes before sun exposure evenly to all exposed skin before going outside. Reapply sunscreen every two hours, or more often if you are sweating or swimming.

Key Features:

- Broad-spectrum SPF 50+ protection against UVA & UVB rays.
- Water-resistant and dermatologist-tested, ensuring long-lasting defense.
- Hypoallergenic and fragrance-free, making it suitable for all skin types.
- Hydrating and soothing, leaving the skin soft and nourished.
- Pack of two.
- Size: 120 ml for each.
description.ar:
احمِ بشرتك بسهولة مع انفينيتي كير ميست بخاخ مقاوم للشمس 50+، المصمم ليناسب جميع أفراد العائلة وجميع أنواع البشرة. يوفر هذا الواقي حماية واسعة النطاق من أشعة UVA و UVB، مما يساعد في الوقاية من حروق الشمس، الشيخوخة المبكرة، وتلف البشرة. بفضل تركيبته المرطبة والمهدئة، يحافظ على بشرتك ناعمة ومحمية طوال اليوم. كما أنه مقاوم للماء، هيبوالرجينيك وخالٍ من العطور، مما يجعله مثاليًا للاستخدام اليومي وإعادة التطبيق بسهولة.
يُوضع واقي الشمس قبل التعرض لأشعة الشمس بـ 15-20 دقيقة، مع توزيعه بالتساوي على جميع مناطق الجلد المكشوفة. يُعاد تطبيقه كل ساعتين، أو بشكل أكثر تكرارًا في حالة التعرق أو السباحة.

مواصفات المنتج:

- حماية واسعة النطاق SPF 50+ ضد أشعة UVA و UVB.
- مقاوم للماء ومُختبر من أطباء الجلد لضمان حماية طويلة الأمد.
- خالي من العطور ومضاد للحساسية، مما يجعله مناسبًا لجميع أنواع البشرة.
- يرطب البشرة ويهدئها، مما يمنحها نعومة ونضارة.
- العرض من عبوتين.
- الحجم: 120 مل لكل عبوة.

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Azithromycin 500mg

●Indication And Use
Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

●Mode Of Action
Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Adults:
-Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Mild Severity)
Pharyngitis/Tonsillitis (Second-Line Therapy)
 Skin/Skin Structure (Uncomplicated): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5.
-Acute Bacterial Exacerbations Of Chronic Bronchitis (Mild To Moderate): 500 mg As A Single Dose On Day 1, Followed By 250 mg Once Daily On Days 2 Through 5 Or 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Acute Bacterial Sinusitis: 500 mg Once Daily For 3 Days.
-Genital Ulcer Disease (Chancroid)
Non-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 1 Gram Dose
-Gonococcal Urethritis And Cervicitis: One Single 2 Gram Dose

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
-Geriatric Use: Elderly Patients May Be More Susceptible To Development Of Torsades De Pointes Arrhythmia.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.

●دواعي الاستعمال
مضاد حيوي واسع المجال

●كيفية عمل الدواء
دواء مضاد للبكتيريا ماكرولايد

●الجرعة
للبالغين في حالات الاتهاب البكتيري التالية:
 -الالتهاب الرئوي (شدة خفيفة)
 التهاب القصبة الهوائية / التهاب اللوزتين
التهاب الجلد (غير معقد): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام من 2 إلى 5.
 -التفاقم البكتيري الحاد لالتهاب الشعب الهوائية المزمن (خفيف إلى متوسط): 500 مجم كجرعة وحيدة في اليوم الأول ، تليها 250 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا في الأيام 2 إلى 5 أو 500 مجم مرة واحدة يوميًا لمدة 3 أيام.
 -التهاب الجيوب الأنفية البكتيري الحاد: 500 مجم مرة واحدة يومياً لمدة 3 أيام.
 -مرض الالتهاب البكتيري التناسلي والتهاب عنق الرحم: جرعة واحدة 1 جرام.
 -التهاب عنق الرحم بالمكورات البنية (النَيْسَرِيّة البُنِّيّة): جرعة واحدة 2 جرام. 

●ملحوظات هامة
-العديد من المضادات الحيوية يمكن أن تسبب الإسهال. إذا كان الإسهال شديدًا أو استمر لأكثر من يومين أو ثلاثة أيام، فاتصل بطبيبك الخاص.
 -يمكن للعديد من المضادات الحيوية تفاعلات فرط الحساسية. إذا كان هناك أي رد فعل تحسسي لفرط الحساسية ، اتصل بطبيبك.
 -قد يكون كبار السن أكثر عرضة للإصابة باضطراب ضربات القلب.
 -يمكن تنوال الدواء مع أو بدون الطعام.
 -عدم تناول مضادات الحموضة المحتوية على الألمنيوم والمغنيسيوم والأزيثروميسين في وقت واحد.
 -اتبع تعليمات طبيبك الخاص لتحديد جرعة ومدة الدواء.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Atorvastatin Dyslipidemias:
Dysbetalipoproteinemia: Treatment of primary dysbetalipoproteinemia (Fredrickson type III).
Heterozygous familial and nonfamilial hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia: To reduce elevated total cholesterol (total-C), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), apolipoprotein B (apo B), and triglyceride levels, and to increase HDL-C in patients with primary hypercholesterolemia (heterozygous familial and nonfamilial) and mixed dyslipidemia (Fredrickson type IIa and IIb).
Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C, LDL-C, and apo B levels in boys and postmenarche girls 10 to 17 years of age with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia with LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL, LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with positive family history of premature cardiovascular disease (CVD), or LDL-C ≥160 mg/dL with two or more other CVD risk factors.
Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: To reduce total-C and LDL-C in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia as an adjunct to other lipid-lowering treatments (eg, LDL apheresis) or if such treatments are unavailable.
Hypertriglyceridemia: Treatment of elevated serum triglyceride levels (Fredrickson type IV).
Limitations of use: Has not been studied in conditions where the major lipid abnormality is elevation of chylomicrons (Fredrickson types I and V).
Prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD):
Primary prevention of cardiovascular disease (high-risk for CVD): To reduce the risk of MI, stroke, and revascularization procedures and angina in adult patients without clinically evident coronary heart disease (CHD) who have multiple CHD risk factors (eg, age, smoking, hypertension, low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol [HDL-C], family history of early CHD); to reduce the risk of MI and stroke in patients with type 2 diabetes and without clinically evident CHD but with multiple risk factors for CHD (eg, retinopathy, albuminuria, smoking, hypertension).
Secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease: To reduce the risk of nonfatal MI, fatal and nonfatal stroke, revascularization procedures, hospitalization for decompensated heart failure, and angina in patients with clinically evident CHD.

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Ciprofloxacin Systemic: Children and Adolescents: Treatment of complicated urinary tract infections and pyelonephritis due to E. coli. Note: Although effective, ciprofloxacin is not the drug of first choice in children.
Infants, Children, Adolescents, and Adults: Prophylaxis to reduce incidence or progression of disease following inhalation exposure to Bacillus anthracis; prophylaxis and treatment of plague (Yersinia pestis).
Adults: Treatment of the following infections when caused by susceptible bacteria: Urinary tract infections; acute uncomplicated cystitis in females, chronic bacterial prostatitis, bone and joint infections, complicated intra-abdominal infections (in combination with metronidazole), infectious diarrhea, typhoid fever (Salmonella typhi), hospital-acquired (nosocomial) pneumonia.
Limitations of use: Because fluoroquinolones have been associated with disabling and potentially irreversible serious adverse reactions (eg, tendinitis and tendon rupture, peripheral neuropathy, CNS effects), reserve ciprofloxacin for use in patients who have no alternative treatment options for acute uncomplicated cystitis.
Ophthalmic: Ocular infections:
Ointment: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Solution: Treatment of superficial ocular infections (corneal ulcers, conjunctivitis) due to susceptible strains of bacteria
Otic: Acute otitis externa (0.2% solution): Treatment of acute otitis externa caused by susceptible isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa or Staphylococcus aureus
Otitis media (6% suspension): Treatment of bilateral otitis media in pediatric patients with effusion undergoing tympanostomy tube placement

description.en:
CONJYCLEAR FORT 0.2% 5ML EYE DROP is an ophthalmic antihistamine solution used to relieve itching and redness caused by allergic conjunctivitis. 

How to use and dosage:
•Instill 1 drop in the affected eye(s) once daily.
•For topical ophthalmic use only.
•Avoid touching the dropper tip to any surface to prevent contamination.

Warnings and precautions:
•Do not use if the solution is cloudy, leaking, or has particles.
•Avoid wearing contact lenses during use.
•Store at a temperature not exceeding 30°C and use within 30 days of opening.
•If irritation, redness, or changes in vision occur, discontinue use and consult a physician.

description.en:
DERMOFIX CREAM 15GM is a topical antifungal medication used for the treatment of fungal skin infections such as athlete's foot, ringworm, and yeast infections.

How to use and dosage:
•Apply a thin layer of the cream to the affected area once or twice daily, as directed by your physician.
•Ensure the skin is clean and dry before application.
•Continue using the cream for the full prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve.

Warnings and precautions:
•For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, mouth, or mucous membranes.
•If irritation or allergic reaction occurs, discontinue use and consult a physician.
•Keep out of reach of children.

Active ingredient: Sertaconazole.

description.en:
EFEMYO EYE DROPS 10ML are sterile ophthalmic drops used to relieve non-infectious eye inflammation and associated redness or irritation.

• How to Use and Dosage:
• Adults and children over 6 years: 1–2 drops in the affected eye(s), 2–4 times daily, or as prescribed by the physician.
• Shake well before use.
• Do not touch the dropper tip to any surface to avoid contamination.
• Not recommended for children under 6 years unless directed by a doctor.

• Warnings and Precautions:
• For ophthalmic use only
• Prolonged use may increase intraocular pressure—monitor regularly in long-term therapy.
• Contraindicated in viral, fungal, or untreated bacterial eye infections.
• Remove contact lenses before application and wait at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

• Active Ingredients:
• Fluorometholone Micronized 0.1%
• Tetrahydrozoline Hydrochloride 0.025%

description.en:
Esomeprazole
 
●Concentration: 40 milligram Capsule
●Uses and Indication
Peptic and Duodenal ulcer
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
Heart burn
Adjuvant therapy in Treatment of H. pylori infection
Long-term treatment of pathological hypersecretory conditions like Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, multiple endocrine adenomas and systemic mastocytosis
●Mode of action
Esomeprazole belongs to a class of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors (PPIs) that reduce stomach acid production
●Dosage and administration
Adult dose: used on empty stomach one hour before breakfast but maybe used twice daily not more than 2 months
Children dose : ages between 1-16 years may take a dose 5-20 Milligram/day prescribed by the physician
●Precautions
consult your physician or the pharmacist if you take another medications especially for chronic diseases
Long time use may lead to long-term inflammation of the stomach called atrophic gastritis

description.en:
●Active Ingredient
Paracetamol 1000mg

●Indication And Use
Analgesic And Antipyretic 

●Dose
*Below 6 Years:
15mg/kg
*6 - 12 Years
250Mg To 500Mg Repeated If Necessary 3-4 Times A Day To A Maximum Of 2000 Mg In Any 24 Hour Period
*12 Years – Adults
1000mg Repeated If Necessary 3-4 Times A Day To A Maximum Of 4000mg In Any 24 Hour Period

●Special Notes
-Should Not Be Taken With Other Products Containing Paracetamol At The Same Time
-Do Not Take This Medicine If You Are Allergic To Paracetamol Or Any Other Ingredient In This Product
-If Symptoms Persist, Please Consult Your Doctor Or Pharmacist
-If You Have Any Liver Or Kidney Problems, Please Consult Your Doctor 
-If You Have Glutathione Depleted States Such As Sepsis, Please Consult Your Doctor 
-Paracetamol Overdose May Cause Liver Failure. Immediate Medical Management Is Required In The Event Of An Overdose, Even If Symptoms Of Overdose Are Not Present
-Prolonged Daily Use Of Paracetamol With Warfarin And Other Coumarins Used To Thin The Blood May Increase The Risk Of Bleeding; Consult Your Doctor Before Taking These Medicines Together

●الجرعة
*الأطفال(أقل من 6 سنوات):
15مجم/كجم
*الأطفال (من 6 الي 12 عام ) :
من 250مجم لـ500مجم يكرر عند الضروره بمعدل 3:4 مرات يوميا بحد أقصي 2000مجم في خلال 24 ساعة.
*للكبار ( بما في ذلك كبار السن ) :
2000مجم يكرر عند الضرورة بمعدل 3:4 مرات يوميا بحد أقصي 4000مجم في خلال 24 ساعة

●ملحوظات هامة
-لا تتناول هذا الدواء مع أي من المنتجات الأخرى التي تحتوي على مادة الباراسيتامول في الوقت نفسه
-لا تتناول هذا الدواء إذا كنت تعاني من حساسية لمادة الباراسيتامول أو أية مكونات أخرى يحتويها هذا المنتج
-إذا استمرت الأعراض بعد تناول الدواء، يرجى مراجعة الطبيب أو الصيدلي
-إذا كنت تعاني من أية مشاكل في الكبد أو الكلى، يرجى استشارة طبيبك قبل تناول بانادول
-إذا كنت تعاني من حالة نقص الجلوتاثيون مثل تلوث الدم ، يرجى استشارة طبيبك قبل تناول بانادول
-قد يؤدي تناول جرعة زائدة من الباراسيتامول إلى قصور كبدي. في حال تناول جرعة زائدة، يجب التدخل الطبي الفوري، حتى في غياب الأعراض التي تدل على ذلك
-يزيد الباراسيتامول من تأثير الأدوية المضادة لتجلط الدم - مثل الوارفارين- عند استخدامه لفترات طويلة وبشكل منتظم، مما يزيد من خطر النزيف، لذا يرجى استشارة الطبيب قبل تناول هذه الأدوية

description.en:
Active Ingredient: Felodipine Hypertension: Treatment of hypertension
Guideline recommendations:
The 2014 guideline for the management of high blood pressure in adults (JNC 8) recommends initiation of pharmacologic treatment to lower blood pressure for the following patients (JNC8 [James, 2013]):
• Patients ≥ 60 years, with systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥150 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure (DBP) ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients <60 years, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with diabetes, with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
• Patients ≥18 years with chronic kidney disease (CKD), with SBP ≥140 mm Hg or DBP ≥90 mm Hg.
Chronic kidney disease (CKD) and hypertension: In patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD), regardless of race or diabetes status, the use of an ACE inhibitor (ACEI) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) as initial therapy is recommended to improve kidney outcomes. In the general nonblack population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic, calcium channel blocker, ACEI, or ARB. In the general black population (without CKD) including those with diabetes, initial antihypertensive treatment should consist of a thiazide-type diuretic or a calcium channel blocker instead of an ACEI or ARB.
Diabetes and hypertension: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines suggest that for patients with hypertension and diabetes without albuminuria, any of the 4 classes of blood pressure medications (eg, ACE inhibitors, angiotensin receptor blockers, thiazide-like diuretics, dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers) may be used and have shown beneficial cardiovascular outcomes

Broad Spectrum Antibiotic

Macrolide Antibacterial Drug

●Dose
For Children

●Special Notes
-Many Antibiotics Can Cause Diarrhea. If Diarrhea Is Severe Or Lasts More Than 2 Or 3 Days, Call Your Doctor.
-Many Antibiotics Can Hypersensitivity Reactions. If There Is Any Hypersensitivity Reaction Call Your Doctor.
Pediatric Use: Safety And Effectiveness In The Treatment Of Patients Under 6 Months Of Age Have Not Been Established.
-Can Be Taken With Or Without Food.
-Not To Take Aluminum- And Magnesium-Containing Antacids And Azithromycin Simultaneously.
-Follow Your Doctor’s Instructions About The Amount To Use And The Days Of Treatment.
●Need Water For Suspension.
●Shake Well Before Use.
●After Mixing, Store Suspension At 5 To 30C And Use Within 10 Days.
●Discard After Full Dosing Is Completed.

Active Ingredient: Azathioprine Renal transplantation: Adjunctive therapy in prevention of rejection of kidney transplants
Guideline recommendations: While azathioprine is FDA approved for adjunctive therapy in prevention of rejection after renal transplantation, it is no longer recommended as a first-line agent. The KDIGO clinical practice guidelines for care of kidney transplant recipients recommend a combination of maintenance immunosuppressive medications as maintenance therapy, including a calcineurin inhibitor and an antiproliferative agent (mycophenolate preferred) with or without corticosteroids. Azathioprine is recommended as a second-line antiproliferative agent for prevention of acute rejection

description.en:
• Esomeprazole Eva-pharma 40mg coated tablet is a proton pump inhibitor medication used for the treatment of gastrointestinal conditions such as GERD and erosive esophagitis.
• Active Ingredient: Esomeprazole 40mg per capsule.
• Indication: Treatment of conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and erosive esophagitis. Helps in reducing stomach acid production.
• Dosage: 1 tablet (40mg) daily before a meal, or as prescribed by the physician.

• الجرعة: 1 قرص (40 مجم) يوميًا قبل الأكل، أو كما يصف الطبيب.

• HISATRUP 1mg/1ml Syrup 120ml is a medication used to relieve allergic symptoms.
• Active ingredient: Rupatadine 1mg/ml. 
• Indication: Relieve allergic symptoms such as urticarial, allergic rhinitis, sneezing, hives, and itching.
• Dose: Always take exactly as your doctor has told you.
Dosage in children weighing 25 kg or more: 5 ml (5 mg of rupatadine) of oral solution once a day, with or without food.
Dosage in children weighing equal or more than 10 kg to less than 25 kg: 2.5 ml (2.5 mg of rupatadine) of oral solution once a day, with or without food.
